title: Environmental Technician
description:
WHO WE ARE

Kinsley Construction is a full-service construction company committed to doing right by our people, right by our roots, and right by you. Operating throughout the Mid-Atlantic Region, we serve clients in a variety of industries. From Building, Civil, and Industrial construction, we do what it takes to get the job done and done right. If you want to leave your mark, take pride in what you do each day, and create something to show off to your family - then join ours.


WHY KINSLEY CONSTRUCTION?

  • Competitive salary and benefits package; including Single and Family Medical Insurance/Dental/Vision, Short/Long Term Disability, Life Insurance, 401K Plan with company match, (9) paid holidays, and up to (20) days PTO.
  • Opportunities for career advancement and professional development.
  • A collaborative and inclusive work environment.
  • A company committed to safety, quality and efficiency in all projects.
  • The chance to be part of a respected construction company with a long history of excellence.


SUMMARY OF POSITION

We are looking for a full-time, hard-working, and responsible individual to join our Environmental Technician Crew. In this position you will be responsible for assisting operators, installing stabilization matting, seeding, strawing, hydroseeding, planting trees, shrubs, and bio engineering materials.

Successful candidates should be physically fit with the ability to work outdoors in a mix of weather conditions.


Please note that this position is considered safety sensitive in accordance with Kinsley Construction policies and procedures.


TYPICAL RESPONSIBILITIES/ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

  • Transports and installs large rolls of stabilization matting in all types of terrain and soil -including wetlands, hill slopes and stream banks.
  • Responsible for seeding, strawing and hydroseeding.
  • Efficiently transports and plants trees and shrubs.
  • Interprets and reads blueprints, project plans and other specifications for jobsite layout.
  • Safely operates power tools and large equipment to dig, load and unload trees/plants.
  • Ensures equipment and tools are clean and stored away properly.
  • Maintains a safe and clean working environment while following all construction site safety rules and procedures.
  • Follows all project instructions from Foreman.


REQUIREMENTS

    • Has prior landscaping, labor, and supervisory experience.
    • High School or equivalent educational experience; vocational school or trade apprenticeships is a plus.
    • Must be at least 18 years of age.
    • Must be able to work in all weather conditions, including prolonged walking or standing on various terrains for up to 10+ hours.
    • Must be self-motivated and able to work independently while meeting necessary deadlines.
    • Must be able to physically stand, bend, squat, and carry at a minimum of 75 pounds.
    • Must follow all company rules, regulations, policies, and guidelines.


    HOW TO APPLY

    If you are interested in a position at Kinsley Construction, please apply on our website at https://careers.kinsleyconstruction.com/ or mail, fax, or email a resume including salary requirements to:


    KINSLEY CONSTRUCTION, LLC.

    PO BOX 2886

    YORK PA 17405

    717-815-6909 (Fax)

title: Strategic Solutions Engineer I
description:
Location: Remote


Turn the world’s most complex shipping data into insights customers can act on.


At Green Mountain Technology, we help large, complex shippers reduce costs, enhance delivery experiences, and build sustainable competitive advantages through technology, analytics, and logistics expertise.

We are seeking a Strategic Solutions Engineer I to build customer reporting, support parcel and transportation analysis, and serve as the conduit between our customers’ data and the team that advises them. The ideal candidate brings early analytics experience, advanced Excel skills, and the curiosity to chase a data problem to its root cause. This is a development role: you will learn the parcel industry alongside a Strategic Solutions Manager who invests in your growth, and you will wear several hats along the way — project coordinator, solution architect, business analyst.


What You’ll Do

  • Build, clone, and modify customer reports to Green Mountain Technology standards, and create on-demand reporting for client requests.
  • Pull and shape data from our data warehouse for ad hoc analysis, from routine data pulls to one-off questions from a client’s finance team.
  • Run re-rate analyses — service changes, DIM changes, surcharges, CWT, re-zoning, GRI validation — to show clients what a change actually costs them.
  • Support carrier RFP analysis and modeling for both national and regional carriers.
  • Produce monthly savings and performance reports, and know every customer-facing report well enough to explain it.
  • Help interpret and write business requirements for GL coding, cost allocation, and data labeling based on what clients need.
  • Learn the parcel industry from the ground up: carrier file types, invoice translation, audit flags, and the UPS, FedEx, USPS, and regional carrier contracts that drive everything we do.
  • Quality-check every deliverable before it leaves your hands, and partner with other engineers to check theirs.
  • Take notes and document client conversations, keep your Jira and Confluence action items current, and flag timeline or expectation risks to your manager early.
  • Find better ways to do the work — process improvements, error-proofing, and system requests that make the whole team faster.


What You’ll Bring

  • 1–2 years of experience in an analytics role.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills — formulas, data cleansing, and data manipulation.
  • A bachelor’s degree in Industrial Engineering, Supply Chain, Data Analytics, Math, MIS, or a similar discipline.
  • An innovative mind with strong analytical problem-solving ability.
  • Sharp critical thinking and a habit of chasing problems to their root cause.
  • Self-motivation and an outcome orientation, driven by timelines and quality — you work well with very limited supervision.
  • Fluency in spoken and written English.


What Will Set You Apart

  • Entry-level understanding of SQL queries and relational databases.
  • Knowledge of transportation and supply chain systems and concepts.
  • Exposure to business intelligence tools such as Tableau, or to data warehousing concepts.
  • Comfort presenting your work and explaining it to people who did not build it.


Why Green Mountain Technology

Green Mountain Technology is a technology-enabled parcel logistics management and advisory firm. Large, complex shippers turn to us to continuously improve customer delivery experiences and the cost to make them possible.

Innovation isn’t an initiative, it’s our culture. We were founded on a belief in using technology paired with talented and knowledgeable professionals in shipping, logistics, data analytics, and technology to create meaningful financial outcomes for our customers. We believe in continuously innovating differentiated value and empowering our people to lead with curiosity, creativity, and ownership.


Green Mountain Technology offers eligible team members medical coverage with two options, along with dental and vision benefits. Our HSA-qualified high-deductible health plan includes a generous company contribution, with optional health care and dependent care flexible spending accounts. Company-paid basic life insurance and short- and long-term disability coverage are available from day one, with voluntary supplemental plans also offered. Additional benefits include fully remote work options in many US states, paid holidays, PTO, Summer Hours with no waiting period, and a 401(k) plan with an automatic company contribution.


Green Mountain Technology is an equal opportunity employer that embraces inclusion and does not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, or disability status.


We Participate in E-Verify.


Applications submitted through third-party automated services or trained AI bots will be disqualified. Only applications completed by intentional human candidates will be considered.

title: Data Engineer / BI Developer
description:
Salary: $120,000 to $130,000 p.a. plus super

Good decisions in care start with good data. Right now, Kanda's data foundations are being built — and this role is at the centre of it.

As a Data Engineer / BI Developer on a 12-month fixed term contract (with possibility for extension) in Brisbane, you'll work closely with the Data Business Analyst to translate operational requirements into governed semantic models and Power BI solutions that people across the organisation can actually trust and use. It's technical, it's meaningful, and the reporting you build underpins decisions that affect real clients, workers and services every day.

What you'll be doing
  • Designing and maintaining Gold layer data models and reporting structures that support decision-making across community and service delivery programs
  • Developing trusted datasets covering clients, workers, properties and shifts to provide a clear view of operational activity
  • Building and maintaining Power BI reports and measures that deliver consistent, accurate and accessible insights
  • Ensuring data quality, consistency and governance across all reporting and data assets
  • Supporting the migration of legacy reports and spreadsheets into a governed, structured data environment
  • Working with stakeholders to translate operational needs into practical data and reporting solutions
  • Documenting data models and reporting processes to support shared understanding and continuous improvement
You're the right person if...
  • You hold a qualification in Computer Science, IT, Data Engineering or similar
  • You have experience with Microsoft Fabric or similar platforms — Databricks, Synapse or Snowflake
  • You're proficient in Power BI including data modelling, DAX and dashboard development
  • You have strong SQL skills for complex queries, CTEs and dimensional modelling across Gold and Silver layers
  • You translate business needs into data models and communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • You hold a current Working with Children Check and NDIS Worker Screening Clearance
  • Experience in health, aged care or disability sectors and familiarity with Git and deployment pipelines is a bonus
Why Kanda
We believe the people who care for others deserve to be genuinely looked after too. Here's what that looks like in practice:
  • Monthly RDO - an extra 12 days of leave per year
  • Wellness initiatives plus 24/7 access to the Sonder wellbeing app
  • Access to an employee rewards hub providing savings and cashback across everyday purchases
  • Employee recognition initiatives, including gift vouchers for Employee of the Month and service anniversaries
  • Enjoy free Orbit World Travel Club membership - $100 travel voucher, exclusive offers, and dedicated support
  • Genuine long-term career opportunities as Kanda continues to grow
Want to chat about this role?
Reach out to Charlotte – Talent Acquisition Specialist
Email: jobs@kandacare.com.au 

Kanda is committed to creating and maintaining a child safe organisation.

We’re dedicated to building an inclusive environment where everyone feels safe, respected, and comfortable to be themselves. At Kanda, every voice matters, every culture is valued, and we believe that diverse perspectives aren’t just welcome — they’re essential to who we are and what we do.

title: Senior Digital Product Designer (UX)
description:
itsme® has fundamentally changed how people lead their digital lives in Belgium, but we are not stopping there! Do you want to be a driving force to help expand on this success story as part of a talented team that is making a positive impact on society? Then keep on reading, you’ll probably like what you’ll see.

We are itsme®, one of Europe’s fastest-growing scale-ups, with 150 team members and growing. Our mission: to provide a state-of-the-art digital identity solution for all people, enabling them to interact securely in the digital space. Now, only nine years after being founded, close to 8 million citizens use the itsme® app to identify themselves and sign documents online. Starting in Belgium, we successfully launched the itsme app in 32 European countries, with the ambition of becoming an internationally leading player.

As a Senior Digital Product Designer (UX) at itsme®, you will play a crucial role in shaping the user experience for its more than 8 million users. You will work collaboratively with cross-functional teams, including product managers, developers, marketerrs, to create intuitive and accessible designs that meet the needs of our users.

What your job looks like

  • Collaborate with product managers, solution architects, developers, and stakeholders to shape new features from concept to launch

  • Clearly document and communicate design decisions to stakeholders across all levels, including leadership and development teams

  • Contribute to the overall product experience and long-term design vision

  • Translate user needs and business goals into clear, intuitive, and engaging designs

  • Create wireframes, wireflows, and high- and low-fidelity prototypes (primarily in Figma)

  • Ensure consistency with our design system while driving innovation where appropriate

  • Identify gaps in the design system and build new or updated components

  • Plan and conduct user research and usability testing, together with our (external) UX research partners, to inform and validate design decisions

  • Leverage user insights and data to guide and support design choices

  • Advocate for user needs while balancing technical constraints and business goals

  • Work closely with product managers and functional analysts during the feature refinement phase to ensure all business and user needs are clear

  • Work closely with developers during implementation to ensure high-quality execution of designs

  • Stay up to date with trends and best practices in UX/UI, product design, and user behaviour

  • Apply meaningful placeholder copy in designs to support copywriting

  • Design with accessibility in mind, ensuring compliance with European Accessibility Guidelines

  • Proven experience (5+ years) as a Digital Product Designer or similar role.

  • Capable of collaborating effectively within a team while also demonstrating the ability to independently manage your workload

  • Solid understanding of user-centered design principles and UX best practices

  • Profound knowledge of mobile-first design patterns

  • Strong portfolio showcasing a range of digital design projects, including mobile app design.

  • Proficiency in design tools such as Adobe CS and Figma.

  • Ability to effectively communicate design concepts and rationalize cross-functional teams

  • Experience working in an agile development environment

  • Excellent collaboration and communication skills

What we offer

  • Being welcomed by an informal, enthusiastic, and ambitious team that is revolutionising how we safely manage our digital identity, in Belgium & beyond.

  • Offices within walking distance from Brussels Central Station, with the possibility to work remotely 3 days a week.

  • A contract of indefinite duration, with an attractive compensation package.

  • An environment where we care a lot about our core values:

    • Impact: Lead by example and create positive influence.

    • Resourcefulness: Connect, mobilise, and collaborate across ecosystems.

    • Curiosity: Explore, learn, and challenge the status quo.

    • Scale: Build strong foundations for sustainable growth.

    • Humble: Respect, listen, and embrace feedback for growth.

description:

We are seeking a highly motivated and detail-oriented Powder Handler to join our team at 3330 Palmer, Janesville, WI. As a Powder Handler, you will be responsible for ensuring the safe and efficient handling of powders and other materials used in our production process. You will work closely with our production team to ensure that all materials are properly stored, labeled, and transported to the appropriate areas. Your attention to detail and commitment to safety will be critical to the success of our operations.

1st Shift: 6:25am-2:30pm Monday - Friday

  • High school diploma or equivalent
  • Experience working in a manufacturing or production environment
  • Ability to operate forklifts and other material handling equipment
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills
  • Ability to lift up to 30 pounds

  • Must be able to pass medical evaluation in order to meet the requirements of wearing a respirator during blending functions
  • Ability to pass background check and drug screen required

Responsibilities:

  • Receive and inspect incoming powders and materials
  • Ensure that all powders and materials are properly labeled and stored
  • Transport powders and materials to the appropriate areas using forklifts and other equipment
  • Maintain accurate records of all powders and materials received and transported
  • Follow all safety procedures and guidelines to ensure a safe working environment

Skills:

You will also use your experience operating forklifts and other material handling equipment to safely and efficiently move materials throughout our facility. Your ability to follow safety procedures and guidelines will be critical to maintaining a safe working environment. See attached job description for more detail.

title: Material Workpack Engineer
description:
UGL is seeking a highly motivated and detail-oriented Materials Workpack Engineer to join our Perth-based team. This role is critical in supporting the effective planning, management and reporting of project materials across major construction and maintenance projects, with a particular focus on Electrical & Instrumentation (E&I) and Structural, Mechanical & Piping (SMP) disciplines.

Working closely with engineering, procurement, construction and site teams, you will play a key role in ensuring material availability, Workpack readiness and accurate materials reporting to support successful project execution. This position offers an excellent opportunity for a collaborative professional who enjoys working with data, solving problems and driving efficient project outcomes.

Key Responsibilities
• Support materials management activities across E&I and SMP scopes for construction and maintenance projects.
• Coordinate material planning, expediting, receipting, warehousing, kit preparation, allocation and reconciliation activities.
• Monitor material status and availability to ensure workpacks are complete and ready for execution.
• Develop and maintain materials tracking tools, reports and dashboards to provide accurate project status information.
• Analyse material shortages, procurement delays and inventory issues, implementing solutions to minimise schedule impacts.
• Work closely with engineering, procurement, construction and site teams to resolve material-related challenges.
• Maintain accurate inventory records and material management databases.
• Support forecasting, reporting and project controls activities through data analysis and performance reporting.
• Assist in identifying risks, trends and opportunities to improve materials management processes and project delivery.
• Ensure compliance with project procedures, client requirements and quality standards.

About You

title: At Your Service Center Associate, Oak Park - Full Time
description:
Be Part of an Amazing Story

Macy’s is more than just a store. We’re a story. One that’s captured the hearts and minds of America for more than 160 years. A story about innovations and traditions…about inspiring stores and irresistible products…about the excitement of the Macy’s 4th of July Fireworks, and the wonder of the Thanksgiving Day Parade. We’ve been part of memorable moments and milestones for countless customers and colleagues. Those stories are part of what makes this such a special place to work.

Job Overview

As an At Your Service Center Colleague, you are at the heart of delivering a seamless and personalized shopping experience. You’ll support all At Your Service activities, including Buy Online Pickup In Store (BOPS), merchandise returns, order pickups, and other assigned tasks - all while upholding Macy’s service standards.

This role requires strong multitasking abilities, problem-solving, attention to detail, and a customer-first mindset. You’ll thrive in a fast-paced environment where flexibility is key, including working a variety of shifts such as nights, weekends, and holidays.

This role goes far beyond just being a cashier. Here, the customer is at the heart of everything we do - every day, all day. If you're passionate about selling, reaching goals, working as a team, and creating amazing experiences through genuine hospitality, this could be the perfect fit for you! You’ll also help keep the shopping space clean, organized, and inviting so every customer feels welcome the moment they walk in.

How Our At Your Service Colleagues Spend Their Day…

  • Every day starts with a positive example. As an At Your Service Colleagues (AYS), you come in energized and ready to make an impact - wearing your name badge with pride, greeting teammates with warmth, and helping ensure the At Your Service areas is clean, organized, and ready for customers. You help set the pace by reviewing sales goals, learning about new arrivals and top-selling items, and staying up to date on trends and promotions - so you’re prepared to support the team and engage customers confidently.
  • In the At Your Service area, you lead through action - welcoming customers with genuine hospitality, making eye contact, and starting friendly, personal conversations that build lasting relationships. Assist customers in all aspects of total store fulfillment, including By Online and Pick Up in Store, be proficient in all systems needed to complete transactions, and ensure the collection area is organized so the customer pick-up experience is friction-free
  • You help maintain a shoppable space by recovering merchandise and keeping the pickup and return areas clean while ensuring timely completion and curbside delivery of Buy Online Pickup In Store (BOPS) orders.
  • They always Finish Strong - sharing our Loyalty program benefits, making sure customers have all they need, and ending with a sincere thank-you, often walking the package around and using the customer’s name.
  • We believe service starts with each other - supporting one another with honesty, care, and collaboration so we can better serve our customers and communities.
  • And we know that excellence is a journey - we strive to improve every day, take pride in our work, achieve sales goals and learn from each other to deliver individual and store results.

Full-time colleagues are typically scheduled to work 30 or more hours per week, while part-time colleagues are typically scheduled 12-24 hours per week. All schedules contain weekend shifts as part of the requirements. Hours are dependent on business needs and colleague availability. Information regarding hours per week needed for benefit eligibility purposes can be found here.

Who You Are

  • Flexible availability, including days, evenings, weekends and holidays with regular, dependable attendance and punctuality
  • Must be able to:
    • Understand and communicate effectively with customers, co-workers, and supervisors
    • Read and understand employment policies and safety rules/procedures in English
  • Makes prompt, sound decisions in real time to effectively address customer needs and resolve issues
  • Be comfortable communicating and collaborating with customers and colleagues
  • Meeting daily sales goal challenges
  • Responsible for acquiring new customers by opening credit accounts and sharing loyalty benefits
  • Enjoy meeting people, learning about them, and sharing information
  • Resourceful and eager to start a new venture and can adapt to changing priorities; you can work on your own but are great with team dynamics
  • You can handle electronic devices with no problem

Essential Physical Requirements You Will Perform

  • This position requires talking, lifting, constant moving, standing, and reaching with arms and hands.
  • Standing for at least two consecutive hours, lifting at least 25lbs. stooping, kneeling, crouching, and climbing ladders, reaching, including above eye level.
  • Requires close vision, color vision, depth perception, and focus adjustment.
  • Frequent use of computers and other technology, necessary to perform job functions, including handheld equipment, cash register and ability to process register transactions.

What We Can Offer You

Join a team where work is as rewarding as it is fun! We offer a dynamic, inclusive environment with competitive pay and benefits. Enjoy comprehensive health and wellness coverage and a 401(k) match to invest in your future. Prioritize your well-being with paid time off and eight paid holidays. Grow your career with continuous learning and leadership development. Plus, build community by joining one of our Colleague Resource Groups and make a difference through our volunteer opportunities.

Some additional benefits we offer include:

  • Merchandise discounts
  • Performance-based incentives
  • Annual merit review
  • Employee Assistance Program with mental health counseling and legal/financial advice

Access the full menu of benefits offerings here.

About Us

This is a great time to join Macy’s! Whether you’re helping a customer find the perfect gift, streamlining operations in one of our distribution centers, enhancing our online shopping experience, buying in-style and on-trend merchandise to outfit our customers, or designing a balloon for the Thanksgiving Day Parade, we offer unique opportunities to be part of some of the most memorable moments in people’s lives.

Join us and help write the next chapter in our story - Apply Today!

This job description is not all-inclusive and may not apply to colleagues covered by a collective bargaining agreement. Macy's Inc. reserves the right to amend this job description at any time. Macy's Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to an inclusive work environment.

title: Senior Data Engineer / Data Architect - Databricks & AWS
description:
Salary: $168k - $250k p.a. + Superannuation

TECHNICAL LEAD / PRINCIPAL ENGINEER / HANDS-ON ARCHITECT - DATA ENGINEERING (PLATFORM & INFRASTRUCTURE)

Sydney, NSW (on-site) | Full Australian working rights required - we're unable to progress candidates without them.

You've built a Databricks and AWS data platform from nothing before: medallion architecture, Delta Lake, real pipelines and real tradeoffs, not a diagram someone else handed you. If that's familiar, keep reading. Sydney-based, Technical Lead through to Hands-on Architect, genuinely hands-on at every level.

SEEK SELLING POINTS

  • You've built a platform from nothing before. This role needs that again.
  • Haven't led a team yet? If you're ready to, this is where you start.
  • Join a 500+ strong data and AI practice, backed by tier-one vendor alliances.

ABOUT THE CLIENT

A top-tier global professional services firm delivering large-scale data and AI transformation programs for major enterprise and government clients across Australia. This is deep, complex platform and infrastructure build work, not light analytics or reporting. You get total ownership of the platforms you build, structured investment in advanced technical training, and direct access to the vendors behind the stack, not just a licence and a support ticket.

ABOUT THE TEAM

You'd be joining a data and AI practice of 500+ specialist practitioners nationally, sitting inside tier-one vendor alliances spanning AWS, Databricks, Google Cloud, dbt Labs, Snowflake, Salesforce and Informatica. The programs here run at genuine scale: think large transport-network digital twin builds, national-scale public health rollout automation, and sustainability data initiatives delivered across Australia and the wider region. Career development is coaching-led, with benefits including dedicated wellbeing leave, paid volunteering and market-leading parental leave.

ABOUT THE ROLE

If you've built a data platform from the ground up before, you already know the difference between that and being handed one to extend. This is the first kind. You'll be designing and building end-to-end Databricks Lakehouse platforms including medallion architecture, batch and streaming pipelines, and Delta Lake at the core, backed by AWS (Glue or Redshift), not a single layer someone else designed around you.

How much of that you own depends on where you sit, and leadership experience isn't a prerequisite at every level. As a Technical Lead, you might already be leading a team, or you might be ready to step into that for the first time with real support behind you. As a Principal Engineer or Hands-on Architect, you're setting technical direction and coaching engineers through the complexity yourself. Either way, you own the platform, not a slice of it.

DUTIES

  • Architect end-to-end Databricks Lakehouse platforms, including medallion architecture, on AWS (Glue or Redshift).
  • Design and build batch, streaming and real-time pipelines feeding AI and advanced analytics workloads.
  • Own distributed systems performance: Spark tuning, query optimisation, and cost and cluster right-sizing at scale.
  • Improve CI/CD, infrastructure as code (Terraform) and automated deployment practice across the platform.
  • Technical Lead level: own delivery of your components directly, whether you're already leading others or ready to step into that for the first time.
  • Principal Engineer / Hands-on Architect level: set technical direction across the build and coach engineers through the complexity, not just review their output.
  • Get direct access to advanced vendor training and close working relationships with the platform partners behind the stack.

REQUIREMENTS

  • Proven experience building data platforms end to end, infrastructure through to data lake, not one layer in isolation.
  • Deep hands-on Databricks and Delta Lake, including medallion architecture and PySpark or Scala, with AWS (Glue or Redshift at minimum).
  • Advanced SQL and performance tuning across distributed systems, with real Spark and cloud troubleshooting experience.
  • Databricks certifications (Certified Data Engineer / Certified Professional) and AWS certifications highly regarded, not mandatory.
  • Technical Lead level: strong individual delivery on complex builds. Prior leadership experience is valued but not required, clear potential to lead is enough.
  • Principal Engineer / Hands-on Architect level: demonstrated ownership of technical direction and coaching engineers through delivery, not just managing tickets.
  • Comfortable in genuine ambiguity on large, complex programs, not tightly scoped analytics or reporting projects.
  • Full Australian working rights required. We are unable to progress applications without them.

HOW TO APPLY

If the platforms you've built, or are ready to lead, are the reason people call you when things go wrong, we should talk.Send me your CV!!

KEY SKILLS

Databricks, Delta Lake, Apache Spark, PySpark, Scala, Medallion Architecture, AWS, Glue, Redshift, Terraform, CI/CD, Data Engineering, Data Architecture, Data Platform, Data Lake, Sydney.

A note from the consultant running this search: I've placed engineers into this practice who came in as builders and ended up leading their own workstreams within a year. The ones who thrive aren't chasing a title, they're chasing the platform work that's actually hard. If your CV reads like tidy dashboards and light reporting, this isn't your role. If it reads like you've fought with Spark cluster configs at 11pm and won, let's talk.

In the Resident Coordinator role, you'll be responsible for maintaining a safe and secure living environment for clients of one or more of Interfaith’s programs. Working alongside a comprehensive team of skilled professionals, the Resident Coordinator engages with case managers and other team members to support individuals in regaining self-sufficiency.


ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Assist with client intakes, transfers, coordination of services, and discharges.

  • Accompany clients to appointments for support under the guidance of qualified personnel as needed.
  • Review and update daily logbooks, brief incoming shift staff on relevant issues.
  • Accurately record emergencies, disciplinary actions, incidents, and other notable events during shifts.
  • Escalate operational concerns and client needs to supervisory staff in a timely manner.

What’s Next

Apply now if you share our values of Energy, Integrity, Generosity of Spirit and Excellent Outcomes, and want to make a meaningful impact supporting investment delivery for our members.

Important Information

AustralianSuper uses AI to review resumes and conduct initial phone interviews. When invited, candidates may opt for a traditional phone screening instead.

title: Data Engineer
description:
In 2025, Outcomes First Group were officially certified as a ‘Great Place to Work’ for the sixth year running.


Job Title: Data Engineer

Location: Hybrid – Manchester City Centre (1-2 days per week office-based)

Salary: Up to £49,000 per annum

Contract: Permanent

Please note: UK applicants only | No sponsorship available


About Us

Outcomes First Group is the UK's largest independent provider of specialist education and care. Through our divisional brands, we work across education, care and children's services to deliver high-quality support and improve outcomes for children and young people.


As we continue to grow and invest in technology, we're looking for a Data Engineer to join our IT team and play a key role in developing and supporting modern data platforms, integrations and automation technologies that enable data-driven decision-making across the organisation.


About the Role

This is an exciting opportunity to join a growing technology function where you'll be responsible for designing, developing and supporting enterprise-scale data solutions using Microsoft Fabric.


Acting as a technical specialist, you'll work closely with business stakeholders, SaaS providers and internal technology teams to deliver secure, reliable and scalable data solutions that support reporting, analytics and operational performance across the Group.


You'll play a key role in building and maintaining modern data platforms, developing robust data pipelines and delivering governed data solutions that enable colleagues to access trusted and meaningful information.


Alongside data engineering responsibilities, you'll support integrations and automation technologies across the organisation, helping to improve business processes and support our ongoing digital transformation programme.


We're looking for someone with strong technical expertise, excellent problem-solving skills and a passion for building scalable, high-quality data solutions that deliver meaningful business outcomes.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, maintain and support secure integrations between business applications and systems.
  • Design, build and optimise data pipelines, transformation processes and data solutions using Microsoft Fabric.
  • Develop and manage Lakehouse and Warehouse solutions using OneLake, Delta tables, SQL and PySpark.
  • Deliver scalable and governed data solutions that support reporting, analytics and business intelligence requirements.
  • Implement engineering best practices across data platforms, including testing, deployment, documentation and support processes.
  • Manage source control, deployment pipelines and application lifecycle activities for data solutions.
  • Monitor platform performance through logging, alerting and proactive troubleshooting.
  • Investigate and resolve data, integration and platform-related issues, ensuring high availability and reliability.
  • Ensure all solutions meet security, governance and compliance requirements.
  • Work closely with stakeholders, software vendors and technical teams to understand requirements and deliver effective solutions.
  • Support continuous improvement across data engineering, reporting, analytics and integration capabilities.
  • Provide technical guidance and expertise to internal teams and third-party suppliers.


Experience, Skills & Qualifications

Essential

  • Proven experience in a Data Engineer or similar data-focused role.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Fabric, including Data Factory, Dataflows Gen2, Lakehouse and Warehouse solutions.
  • Experience designing and developing ETL/ELT processes, enterprise data pipelines and transformation workflows.
  • Strong SQL and Python skills, including experience with PySpark.
  • Experience working with OneLake, Delta tables and modern cloud-based data platforms.
  • Experience developing and supporting integrations using APIs and authentication methods such as OAuth and Entra ID.
  • Strong understanding of data architecture, governance and security principles.
  • Experience implementing engineering best practices including testing, deployment and support processes.
  • Excellent troubleshooting, analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences.


Desirable

  • Experience with Microsoft Power Platform technologies, including Power Automate.
  • Knowledge of Azure data and analytics services.
  • Experience implementing CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices.
  • Knowledge of Microsoft Purview and data governance frameworks.
  • Experience supporting enterprise-scale analytics and reporting platforms.
  • Relevant Microsoft certifications, including Fabric Data Engineer Associate or equivalent.
  • Experience working within a multi-site or complex organisational environment.


Why Join Us?

You'll be joining a growing organisation where technology plays a critical role in improving services, supporting colleagues and driving innovation.


Outcomes First Group is the UK's largest independent provider of specialist education and care, operating across England, Scotland and Wales through our divisional brands including Acorn Education, Options Autism, Blenheim Schools and Momenta Connect.


By joining our central technology team, you'll have the opportunity to work on exciting transformation projects, shape the future of data and analytics within the organisation, and make a meaningful impact across the business. We value collaboration, innovation and continuous improvement, providing an environment where your ideas and expertise can make a real difference.


Benefits

  • Life Assurance
  • Pension scheme with flexible contribution options
  • \"Your Wellbeing Matters\" – mental and physical health support
  • Family Growth Support, including enhanced maternity and paternity leave
  • Flexible benefits via Vista (Cycle to Work, Electric Car Scheme, discounts, critical illness cover and more)


We are committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people. All applicants will be subject to social media checks and successful applicants to a fully enhanced DBS check.


We are an Equal Opportunities Employer.


We reserve the right to close the vacancy early if a high volume of suitable applications is received. Outcomes First Group is committed to a fair, thorough and efficient recruitment process in line with Keeping Children Safe in Education. While we aim to keep applicants informed, we do not accept liability for any loss of earnings or costs incurred due to delays or changes in compliance processes. All stages are subject to safeguarding checks and statutory requirements, which may affect timescales.

title: Product Growth Coordinator
description:

Eucalyptus is now part of Hims & Hers, the global leader in personalised health and wellness.

Euc is the company behind Juniper, one of the world's largest weight-management programs combining GLP-1 medication with personalised nutrition, movement support, and clinician-led care from prescribers, nurses, health coaches, pharmacists, and dietitians. Our published clinical research shows that our combined clinical and behavioural approach helps patients lose significantly more weight during their treatment with Juniper by four times.

Our Growth Story:

  • Supporting patients living with obesity across our 5 markets
  • Received selective NICE endorsement to provide services to the NHS
  • Tailored our offering to thousands of patients in Australia, the UK, Germany, Japan and Canada.

About the Role

We're looking for a Product Growth Coordinator to support our Growth team across CRM, Quiz, and Landing Page workstreams. This is a hands-on, cross-functional role for someone early in their career who wants to build broad growth marketing and lifecycle experience across a fast-moving healthcare business.

What You'll Do

CRM (60%)

  • Support building and maintaining CustomerIO flows, campaigns and segments, setting up experiments and rolling out new features like Help Centre, WhatsApp, and RAF (roughly 2-3 days of work per week)
  • Own an organised source of truth for our always-on flows, and lead the migration of all emails from Figma into CIO

Landing Pages (10%)

About You

  • Early career marketer or growth generalist, ideally with 1-2+ years' experience in a fast-paced digital, growth, or CRM environment

  • Detail-oriented, organised, and able to keep a clean source of truth across tools
  • Familiarity with tools like Customer.io, Figma, or similar CRM/design platforms is a plus, but not required
  • Curious, proactive, and excited to grow in a high-ownership Growth role

Why join Eucalyptus?

Euc is also behind a growing family of digital healthcare clinics (Pilot, Kin, Software, Compound) across men’s health and well-being, fertility, skincare, and preventative health.

Here’s what makes joining Euc unique:

  • What’s next - Our goal for the next three years is to support 1 million patients globally to live better for longer. We’re launching into new conditions, demographics, and geographies as we build a truly preventive healthcare ecosystem.
  • Build something world-changing - We’re on the path to becoming the world’s largest international digital healthcare company. It will be challenging, fast-paced, and deeply rewarding.

  • Accelerate your growth - You will have high ownership, continuous feedback, and dedicated development support.
  • Join a motivated team - You will collaborate with talented peers to solve complex clinical and operational problems at scale.

What’s ahead in the Philippines?

  • Grow with us globally - Get mentorship from leaders across Australia, the UK, Germany, and Japan while collaborating with top-tier teams in the Philippines and South Africa.
  • Shape your career - Access learning budgets, conferences, certifications, peer shadowing, and a global knowledge-sharing culture.
  • Work where wellbeing matters - Enjoy wellness budgets, social clubs, hybrid work arrangement, and initiatives that help you stay balanced and connected.
  • Innovate with purpose - Use state-of-the-art tools and contribute to bold, impactful solutions in healthcare.
  • Support at every stage - Benefit from comprehensive health coverage (including up to 2 dependents), vacation, sick, and parental leaves, 13th-month pay, statutory benefits, and transport allowance.

At Eucalyptus, we value individuals from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives, and we embrace the unique qualities each person brings. When you apply, please let us know of any reasonable adjustments you may need during the interview process. We use AI-assisted tools across our business to help our teams work more efficiently, including within our recruitment process. These tools support our team — all hiring decisions are made by real people, and every application is reviewed by a member of our recruitment team.

title: Intermediate/Senior Full Stack Software Engineer
description:
About the Company
Our client is building a real-time financial operating system that helps Kiwi business owners understand what they can actually afford to spend after tax obligations are accounted for.

The platform connects directly with banks through Open Banking and with Inland Revenue, bringing financial data together to give business owners and their advisors greater real-time certainty.

The company combines automation, AI and human expertise to remove repetitive financial work while keeping people in control where judgement matters.

About the Role
This is one core engineering role with flexibility around level. Depending on your experience, you could join as an Intermediate or Senior Full Stack Software Engineer.

You’ll work across the stack and own features from understanding the customer problem through design, build, release and running them in production. Expect to work on third-party and Open Banking integrations, financial data pipelines, platform growth and the services that keep production healthy.

The stack includes Python/FastAPI, PostgreSQL and Redis, with Jinja moving toward TanStack/React. Infrastructure is containerised and self-hosted in New Zealand.

Skills & Experience
You’ll bring:
  • 3+ years’ experience building and shipping production software, ideally across the stack
  • Strong software engineering fundamentals, including design, data modelling and problem-solving
  • Experience integrating with third-party APIs and handling real-world issues such as authentication, rate limits, retries, failures and inconsistent data
  • Confidence with relational databases and SQL
  • Exposure to containers, CI/CD and deploying and operating the software you build
  • An understanding of application security and the judgement to critically review AI-generated code
  • A product mindset, genuine interest in customer problems and clear written communication
For Senior-level candidates, the team will look for deeper experience in software architecture and system design, solving difficult problems and making technical trade-offs under ambiguity, and building systems through periods of scale or growth.

You’ll also be expected to bring stronger production ownership across deployment, monitoring and reliability, alongside experience mentoring engineers or helping raise engineering standards.

Experience with Open Banking, IRD, payments, accounting or other financial integrations, data pipelines, React, self-hosted infrastructure or early-stage startups is useful, but not essential.

Why Work Here
  • End-to-end ownership: Help shape requirements and technical decisions rather than simply picking up tickets
  • Real customer impact: Build software that directly affects how businesses understand and manage their finances
  • Interesting engineering problems: Work with Open Banking, IRD integrations, financial data pipelines and a platform preparing for growth
  • Own what you ship: Stay involved through deployment, monitoring and optimisation rather than throwing work over the fence
  • Practical approach to AI: Work with AI embedded into real workflows with human oversight, while engineers remain accountable for architecture, security and production quality
  • Remote across New Zealand: Work from anywhere in NZ as part of a distributed team that still makes time to get together
  • Trust and autonomy: The team cares about outcomes rather than hours and gives engineers room to structure their work
If you’re a product-minded engineer who enjoys working across the stack, solving real customer problems and taking responsibility for what you put into production, we’d like to hear from you.

You don’t need to meet the Senior-level expectations to apply. The role can be shaped at Intermediate or Senior level based on the experience and strengths you bring.

title: QC Technician, Fragrance
description:
Who we are at Osmo:

Osmo is a digital olfaction company, on a mission to give computers a sense of smell to improve the health and wellbeing of human life. Why? Our sense of smell both enriches and saves lives, and has a deep and direct connection to our emotions and memory.

Olfactory Intelligence has applications across industries including fragrance, manufacturing, security, medicine, and more. We believe in the power of automation and thoughtfully applied AI/ML to solve problems beyond the reach of human intuition alone.

We're headquartered in Elizabeth, NJ, with an additional office in Somerville, MA. We provide complimentary shuttle service from Brooklyn and Newark, NJ.

About the Role

Osmo's QC function is being built from the ground up, and this seat is where day-to-day quality judgment lives. You'll run testing and sampling on raw materials coming in and finished fragrance going out, using real fragrance-industry judgment that automated testing alone can't provide. You'll have the standing to make real-time accept/reject calls independently, and the experience to step in and cover QC decisions when the QC Manager is out.

What You'll Do:

  • Judge incoming raw material results from automated testing, deciding when an out-of-spec reading is a real defect versus normal variation in a natural material

  • Apply trained olfactive judgment to evaluate raw materials and finished goods using sensory skill the equipment can't replicate

  • Run triangulation testing on outgoing product to confirm it matches prior batches before it reaches a customer

  • Make accept/reject calls in real time, multiple times a day, escalating only genuinely ambiguous cases to the QC Manager

  • Step in and cover QC sign-off when the QC Manager is unavailable, keeping finished-goods flow moving rather than stalling

  • Maintain and run lab instrumentation (GC/MS, photosampler, flash point testing, colorimeters), including calibration checks and upkeep

  • Maintain audit-ready lab records: test logs, certificates of analysis, and equipment records

  • Mentor QC Tech staff on fragrance-specific testing and olfactive judgment

  • Partner across the floor with Purchasing, Warehouse, Shipping/Receiving, and Fragrance Development on sample flow and testing turnaround

Who You Are:

  • Fragrance industry experience or exposure required — adjacent industries (coffee, beer, wine, alcohol roasting, flavor, cosmetics, specialty chemicals) don't clear the bar

  • Comfortable making high-frequency accept/reject calls independently, without over-escalating routine judgment

  • Trained nose — sensory and olfactive evaluation skill specific to fragrance raw materials and finished goods

  • Strong hands-on experience with lab instrumentation; GC/GCMS familiarity is a plus, not a requirement

  • Strong documentation habits

  • Comfortable stepping into a QC decision-making role in the Manager's absence

  • Technical degree preferred (Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, or related); equivalent hands-on fragrance-industry lab experience accepted in place of a degree

  • On-site in Elizabeth, NJ, 5 days a week

What We Offer:

  • Real Growth Path — A senior technician track with real, independent QC decision-making authority, inside a quality function being built from the ground up

  • Catered Lunch — Mon/Wed/Fri; Newark, NJ and Brooklyn shuttles

  • 401(k) savings plan and employer match

  • Competitive salary and meaningful equity in a high-growth company

  • Flexible PTO and paid family leave

  • Commuter benefits (pre-tax transit and parking)

If this role inspires you we’d encourage you to apply. We are committed to recruiting, developing, and retaining an incredible team optimized for a diversity of thought, background, and approaches.

For all Full-Time Employees, compensation is just one component of Osmo’s total rewards approach, which is designed to support the well-being, growth, and long-term success of our team members. Depending on the role, this may include base salary or contract-based pay, along with access to health, dental, and vision coverage; a 401(k) retirement savings plan with company match; flexible paid time off and company holidays; and equity or incentive compensation for eligible roles. Actual compensation will vary based on factors such as experience, skills, location, internal equity, and other relevant business considerations. Osmo regularly reviews pay ranges and compensation structures to ensure they remain competitive, equitable, and aligned with current market data.

All employment decisions and responsibilities are determined based on current ability and your ability to grow, without regard to race, color, gender identity, sex, sexual orientation, religion, age, marital status, physical, mental, or sensory disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Recruitment & Staffing Agencies: Osmo does not accept unsolicited resumes from any source other than candidates. The submission of unsolicited resumes by recruitment or staffing agencies to Osmo or its employees is strictly prohibited unless contacted directly by the Osmo Talent Acquisition team. Any resume submitted by an agency in the absence of a signed agreement will automatically become the property of Osmo and Osmo will not owe any referral or other fees with respect thereto.

In compliance with federal law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work in the United States and to complete the required employment eligibility verification form upon hire

title: Requirements Management Lead
description:
The Requirements Management Lead is responsible for establishing and maintaining the complete requirements framework for the LRT program, ensuring traceability from concept design through testing, commissioning, and operations. This role ensures that all project requirements—technical, functional, operational, safety, and regulatory—are captured, verified, and validated in alignment with systems engineering principles and client objectives. The Requirements Management Lead acts as the single point of accountability for requirements configuration control, change management, and compliance demonstration across all project disciplines.

  • Develop and implement the Requirements Management Plan (RMP) defining processes, tools, roles, and interfaces for managing requirements throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Establish and maintain the Requirements Traceability Matrix (RTM) linking high-level project objectives to design outputs, verification evidence, and acceptance criteria.
  • Ensure all requirements are structured, measurable, and verifiable, aligned with EN 50126/50128/50129 systems assurance standards.
  • Coordinate with Systems Lead, Interface Manager, and Integration Manager to ensure consistent requirement flow down to subsystems (Rolling Stock, Signaling/TSP, OCS/TPSS, Telecom/SCADA, Fare System, OMSF).
  • Facilitate requirements capture workshops with stakeholders to translate operational needs into technical and functional specifications.
  • Govern configuration control and change management for requirements baselines in coordination with the Configuration Manager.
  • Monitor contractor compliance with requirements and verification plans; track status and deviations.
  • Review and approve requirements management deliverables from design consultants and contractors.
  • Ensure verification and validation (V&V) activities are linked to requirements and that all evidence is properly documented and auditable.
  • Support the Safety and RAMS teams in tracing safety and performance requirements through the Safety Case and certification process.
  • Develop dashboards and reporting mechanisms to track requirement completion, V&V status, and compliance performance.
  • Provide training and mentorship to PMC and client teams on requirements management processes and tool usage.
  • Lead readiness reviews, audits, and regulatory submissions to demonstrate compliance and system assurance.
  • Coordinate with Integration and Testing teams to ensure validation test cases fully satisfy operational requirements.
  • Maintain a controlled database of all project requirements and verification evidence.

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in Systems Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.
  • 12-18 years of experience in requirements management and systems engineering within major rail or transit infrastructure programs.
  • Demonstrated expertise in requirements lifecycle management across design, testing, commissioning, and operational phases.
  • Strong knowledge of systems engineering processes and the V-model lifecycle in accordance with EN 50126.
  • Experience applying EN 50126, EN 50128, and EN 50129 standards within complex infrastructure environments.
  • Expertise with requirements management platforms including IBM DOORS, Jama Connect, or Polarion.
  • Proven capability establishing and maintaining end-to-end requirements traceability across multidisciplinary engineering teams.
  • Extensive experience with Verification and Validation (V&V) methodologies, compliance assessments, and audit activities.
  • Knowledge of safety assurance and RAMS frameworks and their integration with project requirements.
  • Strong configuration management, baseline control, analytical, and technical documentation skills.
  • Ability to interpret complex engineering documentation and develop structured, traceable requirements.
  • Excellent stakeholder coordination, communication, and technical leadership capabilities.

Assets

  • Master's degree in Engineering or a related technical discipline.
  • Professional Engineer (P.Eng.) designation.
  • INCOSE ASEP or INCOSE CSEP certification.
  • Experience supporting rail system certification and regulatory approval processes.
  • Prior leadership responsibility for mentoring systems engineering or requirements management teams.
  • Experience delivering requirements governance within large-scale multidisciplinary program management environments.

title: Senior RAMS/Systems Assurance Engineer
description:
RAMS Engineer is responsible for supporting the delivery of Reliability, Availability, Maintainability, and Safety (RAMS) activities for Light Rail Transit (LRT) infrastructure projects in Toronto, Ontario, Canada.

The role contributes across the design, construction, testing, commissioning, and operational readiness phases of rail systems, with a focus on Rolling Stock, Signaling and Control, Power Infrastructure, and Operations, Maintenance and Storage Facility (OMSF) assets. Working within a multidisciplinary engineering environment, the position supports compliance with CENELEC railway safety standards, project safety requirements, and regulatory expectations through technical analyses, hazard management, and performance verification activities.

The ideal candidate possesses a minimum of five years of railway RAMS experience, strong knowledge of functional safety and risk assessment methodologies, and demonstrated involvement in hazard analysis, safety case development, reliability engineering, and commissioning support on transit or metro projects.

Key Responsibilities

  • Conduct reliability prediction studies, availability modeling, and maintainability assessments using fault tree analysis (FTA), reliability block diagrams (RBD), and FMEA/FMECA methodologies.
  • Perform Preliminary Hazard Analysis (PHA), System Hazard Analysis (SHA), and Subsystem Hazard Analysis (SSHA) to identify and assess technical risks across railway systems.
  • Maintain the project hazard log and coordinate hazard mitigation tracking, verification, and closure activities.
  • Support the preparation of safety cases and safety justification reports for regulatory submissions and project approvals.
  • Review contractor and supplier RAMS deliverables, including reliability analyses, FMECA reports, and safety documentation for compliance verification.
  • Ensure RAMS activities comply with EN 50126, EN 50128, EN 50129, and applicable regulatory requirements.
  • Develop and maintain safety requirements traceability matrices linking hazards, design controls, validation activities, and verification evidence.
  • Participate in design reviews and technical assessments to confirm RAMS requirements are incorporated into system and subsystem designs.
  • Collect, analyze, and report failure data, MTBF, MTTR, and operational availability metrics during testing and commissioning activities.
  • Verify RAMS acceptance criteria during system integration testing, trial running, and pre-revenue service validation.
  • Support incident investigations and root cause analysis activities during commissioning and early operational phases.
  • Prepare RAMS performance reports, technical documentation, and stakeholder presentations for project leadership and clients.
  • Interface with Independent Safety Assessors (ISA) and support safety audits, reviews, and regulatory assessments.
  • Contribute to operational safety procedures covering normal operations, degraded operation modes, and emergency response scenarios.

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Systems Engineering, Safety Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • Professional Engineer (P.Eng.) designation.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in RAMS engineering within rail, metro, LRT, transit, or railway infrastructure projects.
  • Working knowledge of CENELEC railway safety standards including EN 50126, EN 50128, and EN 50129.
  • Demonstrated experience conducting hazard analysis, risk assessment, and safety case development activities.
  • Experience performing reliability prediction, availability analysis, maintainability assessments, and statistical failure analysis.
  • Knowledge of Safety Integrity Level (SIL) requirements and functional safety principles associated with signaling and control systems.
  • Proficiency with RAMS tools such as PTC Windchill, Isograph Reliability Workbench, ITEM ToolKit, or equivalent platforms.
  • Experience reviewing technical documentation, safety deliverables, and compliance evidence generated by contractors and suppliers.
  • Strong analytical, technical reporting, and stakeholder communication skills.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with multidisciplinary engineering teams, contractors, clients, and regulatory authorities.

Assets

  • Master's degree in Engineering or a related discipline.
  • Familiarity with CSM-RA (Common Safety Method for Risk Assessment) methodologies.
  • Knowledge of Canadian rail safety regulatory frameworks and transit authority requirements.
  • Certified Reliability Engineer (CRE) designation.
  • Functional Safety certification or progress toward certification.
  • Experience supporting Independent Safety Assessor (ISA) audits and safety certification programs.
  • Exposure to system integration testing, trial running, and operational readiness activities.

Role: Data Engineer


Role Summary

The Data Engineer designs, builds, and operates the ingestion, transformation, and Lakehouse solutions that power Masco's enterprise POS and adjacent commercial data. This role delivers high-quality, reliable, and secure data pipelines against the standards and specifications set by the Enterprise Data Architect and the direction of the Data Engineering Leader. The engineer contributes across the full pipeline lifecycle — ingestion, data quality, transformation, and enrichment — including the pipeline-side execution of the enterprise attribution crosswalk. Depending on assignment, the Data Engineer may focus more heavily on ingestion or on quality and pipeline development, but the role covers all aspects.


What You'll Own


Ingestion & Pipeline Development

  • Design, build, and maintain automated ingestion pipelines and multi-source integration for retailer, HQ, and BU data on the Databricks and Azure data stack.
  • Develop RESTful APIs and API-based integrations for retailer and third-party data acquisition.
  • Deliver critical-path pipelines and validation for priority data feeds.
  • Integrate with orchestration tools and cloud or hybridstorage systems to enable end-to-end data workflows.
  • Contribute to Lakehouse solutions using ACID-compliant storage layers, schema enforcement, and versioning for reliable data management.


Data Quality, Validation & Monitoring

  • Run data-quality checks at the pipeline level — missing values, outliers, consistency, and cross-source reconciliation.
  • Implement monitoring, validation, and automated notifications within the data lifecycle to protect performance, quality, and availability.
  • Support pipeline monitoring, incident response, and continuous improvement in partnership with the Data Engineering Leader.
  • Maintain change control and testing processes for modifications to pipelines and data models.


Attribution & Master Data Support

  • Build the ingestion side of the attribution crosswalk and master data foundations against the Enterprise Data Architect's documented spec.
  • Support maintenance of hierarchy mappings and attribute relationships through pipeline work.
  • Surface data-quality issues, mapping exceptions, and structural gaps back to the Data Engineering Leader and Architect.


DevOps, Automation & Data Preparation

  • Implement CI/CD pipelines for data engineering workflows and automate testing, deployment, and monitoring of data solutions.
  • Develop, maintain, and secure tables, relationships, metrics, and calculations for analytical models supporting reporting and advanced analytics.
  • Contribute to research and recommendations on data management products, services, and standards.


Documentation &Knowledge Management

  • Document ingestion patterns, pipelines, validation rules, and metric definitions as part of the definition of done.
  • Contribute pipeline lineage and technical metadata to the enterprise catalog.
  • Follow the documentation standards established by the Data Engineering Leader and Enterprise Data Architect.


Education & Experience


  • Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, Engineering, Data Analytics, or a related field; equivalent professional experience considered.
  • Substantial hands-on experience designing and building data engineering solutions on a major cloud platform, with emphasis on the Azure ecosystem.
  • Experience delivering production pipelines and supporting them in an operational setting.


Technical Skills

  • Advanced hands-on expertise with Databricks and the Azure data stack(Data Factory, Data Lake, Synapse, Analysis Services).
  • Strong working knowledge of the medallion architecture (bronze / silver/ gold) for structuring Lakehouse solutions.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Fabric and how it fits alongside Databricks in a modernenterprise data platform.
  • Advanced SQL / T-SQL (queries, stored procedures, functions, indexes, partitions, DDL, DML) and strong ETL/ELT design and build experience.
  • Strong proficiency in Python (or Scala)for data engineering.
  • Experience with RESTfulAPI development for data acquisition and ingestion from retailer and third-party sources.
  • Working knowledge of distributed processing (Apache Spark) and Lakehouse principles — ACID storage, schema enforcement, versioning.
  • Solid understanding of CI/CD,DevOps, and automation for data workflows.
  • Strong understanding of Kimball dimensional modeling, including snapshot/transactional fact tables and conforming dimensions.
  • Working knowledge of data constructs including keys, constraints, data types, normalization, referential integrity, and data quality analysis.
  • Understanding of data governance, security, and compliance as they apply to data engineering.


Skills & Competencies

  • Detail-oriented and thorough. Considers all aspects of a data problem, including how the small pieces relate to the larger picture.
  • Highly self-motivated and self-directed. Operates with minimaloversight on complex,hands-on data work.
  • Delivery-focused. Owns commitments and follows through.
  • Willingness to exploreand understand new and moderndata tools to add value to the enterprise POS and POS-related engineering space.
  • Collaborative with the Data Engineering Leader, Enterprise Data Architect, and BI Developers on shared pipelines, models, and metric definitions.
  • Continuous learner who stays current on modern data engineering practices and tools.
  • Strong communicator who can explain technical detail clearly to both engineering and analytics peers.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in retail, consumer goods, or manufacturing analytics environments where POS, sell-in, inventory, and third-party retail data are core.
  • Experience with Databricks Unity Catalog, data lineage, and observability tools.
  • Familiarity with ML/AI integration (MLflow, Azure ML) and DataOps/MLOps practices.
  • Experience with Microsoft Tabular models and the DAX language.
  • Experience with at least one data analysis tool such as Power BI, Tableau, etc.


Other Mandatory Requirement:


  • Must Have Broadband Availability: Minimum 30 MBPS -Only connections from national service providers such as Jio, Tata, Airtel, or Hathway Fiber are acceptable. Local or unverified internet providers are not aligned with MHPI IT policy and should not be used for official work.
  • Home Office Setup (Mandatory): working space to accommodate two monitors +1 laptop (necessary equipment will be provided.)
  • The candidate must have access to a quiet and dedicated home office environment that supports productive remote work.
  • IT Asset Arrangement: All necessary equipment (based on the role)- including monitors, laptop, and supporting accessories will be provided by the company. Candidates must ensure safe and secure setup and usage of these assets.


This setup is non-negotiable and essential to ensure uninterrupted workflow, secure data handling, and effective collaboration. Candidates who do not meet this requirement will not be considered.

title: Quality Control Inspector
description:
Who will you be working with?

Bloom Engineering, a Wabtec Company improves the environmental sustainability of industrial heating applications, particularly focused on the aluminum and steel industries. Headquartered in Pittsburgh, USA since 1934, Bloom serves its global customers from subsidiaries in the Germany, India, and China.

Bloom Engineering’s knowledge and experience in furnace and heating applications provides meaningful competitive advantage to our customers by reducing CO2 and NOX, conversion to sustainable fuel sources, increasing production capacity, improving temperature uniformity, reducing fuel consumption, and enhancing operating flexibility.

How Will You Make a Difference?

The Quality Control Inspector is responsible for verifying that materials, fabricated components, welded assemblies, coatings, refractory installations, and finished products meet all customer, engineering, industry, regulatory, and company quality requirements. The inspector conducts inspections throughout the manufacturing process, reviews quality documentation, identifies nonconforming conditions, and supports corrective actions to ensure products are delivered safely, reliably, and in compliance with applicable specifications.

This is a union position with a pay rate of $38.11/hour.

What Do We Want to Know About You?

Education

  • High School Diploma or GED required.
  • Technical school training, manufacturing certification, or related education preferred.

Experience

  • Minimum 3-5 years of quality inspection experience in a manufacturing environment.
  • Experience interpreting engineering drawings and specifications.
  • Experience inspecting fabricated weldments, assemblies, and industrial equipment preferred. Prior welding experience is a plus.
  • Experience with material traceability and quality documentation preferred.

Technical Skills

  • Ability to read and interpret:
    • Engineering drawings
    • Blueprints
    • Specifications
    • Bills of Material (BOMs)
    • Welding documents
    • Quality procedures
  • Knowledge of:
    • Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing (GD&T)
    • Welding inspection principles
    • Material certifications
    • Manufacturing processes
    • Dimensional inspection techniques

Inspection Equipment - Must be proficient in using tape measures, calipers, micrometers, height gauges, thread gauges, thickness gauges, dual indicators, surface profile gauges, weld gauges, and precision measuring instruments.

Computer Skills – Familiarity with Microsoft Office Suite products, Microsoft Outlook, ERP/MRP systems, electronic quality management systems, and digital inspection reporting systems.

What Will Your Typical Day Look Like?

Incoming Material Inspection

  • Inspect incoming raw materials, components, purchased parts, and outsourced machined and fabrication components and assemblies.
  • Verify welding activities are performed in accordance with approved Welding Procedure Specifications (WPS).
  • Perform visual weld inspections in accordance with applicable codes and standards.
  • Identify weld discontinuities and ensure corrective actions are implemented and documented.
  • Verify material certifications, heat numbers, traceability records, and compliance with purchase order requirements.
  • Review Mill Test Reports (MTRs), Certificates of Compliance (COCs), and supplier quality documentation.
  • Confirm proper identification and storage of incoming materials.
  • Document and report material discrepancies or supplier quality issues.

In-Process Inspection

  • Work with the group leaders and shop employees to perform dimensional inspections of assemblies and components during in-shop fabrication (when required), refractory, assembly, and paint.
  • Verify compliance with manufacturing drawings, specifications, work instructions, and quality plans.
  • Conduct visual inspections of assemblies throughout production.
  • Monitor compliance with established manufacturing and quality procedures.
  • Work with the group leaders to perform first article, in-process, and final inspections as required.
  • Assist/support in burner repair inspection in coordination with engineering and production.

Final Inspection

  • Conduct comprehensive final inspections prior to shipment.
  • Verify product configuration, dimensions, labeling, documentation, and customer-specific requirements.
  • Ensure all quality documentation is complete and accurate.
  • Approve products for shipment when requirements are satisfied.

Documentation and Records

  • Maintain accurate physical and electronic inspection records, reports, and quality documentation.
  • Complete inspection checklists and reports in a timely manner.
  • Review manufacturing travelers, routers, and quality packages for completeness.
  • Ensure traceability and record retention requirements are maintained.
  • Assist in preparing quality data for customer reviews and audits.

Nonconformance Management

  • Identify, document, and segregate nonconforming materials and products.
  • Generate nonconformance reports (NCRs).
  • Participate in root cause investigations and corrective action activities.
  • Verify effectiveness of corrective actions when implemented.

Customer/Vendor Inspection Support

  • Perform quality inspections at vendor facilities as required.
  • Verify vendor compliance with approved drawings, specifications, purchase order requirements, and quality expectations.
  • Review vendor manufacturing and inspection records.
  • Ensure vendor documentation packages are complete prior to shipment.
  • Assist during customer audits and regulatory audits.
  • Interface professionally with customers, suppliers, inspectors, and regulatory representatives.

Continuous Improvement

  • Participate in quality improvement initiatives.
  • Recommend improvements to inspection methods, processes, and quality systems.
  • Support Lean Manufacturing and continuous improvement activities.
  • Promote a culture of quality and product compliance throughout the organization.

Physical Requirements

  • Frequent standing and walking throughout production areas.
  • Frequent bending, climbing, kneeling, and reaching.
  • Ability to lift up to 40 pounds occasionally.
  • Ability to work in manufacturing, warehouse, and outdoor environments.

Working Conditions

  • Manufacturing and industrial shop environment.
  • Exposure to welding operations, machining, grinding, paint operations, and material handling activities.
  • May require overtime, weekends, or off-shift work based on production schedules and customer requirements.
  • Occasional travel to suppliers or customer sites may be required.

Our job titles may span more than one career level. The hourly rate for this role is $38.11/hour. More information on offered benefits, which include health, welfare, and retirement, are available at mywabtecbenefits.com.

What could you accomplish in a place that puts People First?

At Wabtec, it’s not just about a job - it’s about the impact you make. When our people come together, we’re Expanding the Possible by continuously improving what we do and how we do it - for our clients and each other.

If you’re ready to revolutionize how the world moves for future generations, Wabtec is the place for you.

Who are we?

Wabtec is a leading global provider of equipment, systems, digital solutions, and value-added services for the freight and transit rail sectors. Drawing on more than 150 years of experience, we are leading the way in safety, efficiency, reliability, innovation, and productivity. Whether it’s freight, transit, ports, logistics, mining, industrial, or marine, our expertise, technologies, and people together – are accelerating the future of transportation. With roots that date back to George Westinghouse, Thomas Edison, and Louis Faiveley, Wabtec has always built technologies and implemented solutions for a variety of sectors that are critical to meeting the needs of customers and governments alike.

Our global team of about 30,000 employees worldwide delivers performance that moves the world forward. We’re lifelong learners, obsessed with better. Learn more at www.WabtecCorp.com.

Summary:
The Sourcing Coordinator owns the transactional side of sourcing: purchase orders, service contract records, entitlement data, vendor administration, and the follow-through that turns an approved request into a delivered part or a booked vendor visit.

This role is hybrid (2-3 days onsite). The work is transactional and needs to be handled the same way every time, so it sits centrally under sourcing rather than with any one account or site.
The role reports to the Sourcing Manager and works closely with account and operations managers, field service teams, Accounts Payable, and the master data and systems function.
