Maintain service contract records, including terms, coverage dates, covered assets, pricing, and renewal triggers.

Maintain entitlement records in the system of record and flag anything that does not match the contract.
Track renewal and expiry dates and prompt the Sourcing Manager well ahead of term.
Handle contract documentation, filing, and version control so the current version is always the one people find.
Build quote comparisons and coverage summaries when a contract is up for renewal or replacement.
Vendor administration:
Support vendor onboarding, including documentation, banking details, and system setup, working with Finance.
Maintain vendor records, contacts, and agreed pricing.
Follow up with vendors on overdue quotes, parts, service reports, and credits.
Confirm scheduling and access arrangements with the account before committing a vendor to a service date.
Coordination and support:
Answer purchasing questions from accounts and field teams on order status, coverage, and pricing.
Support the Sourcing Manager with spend data, savings tracking, and reporting.
Partner with Accounts Payable on invoice matching and clearing blocked items.
Follow the documented sourcing and payments workflow without local variation.

High school diploma or equivalent required. Associate degree or higher preferred.
2+ years of purchasing, procurement support, contract administration, or transactional coordination experience.
Experience with an enterprise resource planning, purchasing, or contract management system required.
Working Excel skills required, including lookups and pivot tables.
Strong attention to detail and the ability to keep many open items moving at once.
Experience with service contracts or vendor administration preferred.
Able to work independently in a remote setting with minimal day to day supervision.
Education/Special Training:
High school diploma or equivalent required; associate degree or higher preferred.
Training in purchasing, procurement administration, or contract administration preferred.
A reliable home working setup with internet suitable for video calls and system access is required.

Accountability - takes ownership of assigned work and responsibilities, follows through, and closes the loop.

Organization - manages a high volume of transactions without losing track.

Audit outcomes on purchasing and contract records

title: Global Director, ELIS Program
description:
Why Renovo?
Renovo Solutions is a nationwide healthcare and life sciences technology management company. We offer a range of opportunities for employees to grow within the company. With a presence in 40+ states and a growing international footprint, we provide comprehensive solutions for managing and maintaining the equipment our clients depend on. We prioritize investing in our employees’ development, offering various phases and advancement paths. Through ongoing training, mentorship programs, and a supportive work environment, we foster professional growth and promote from within. Join our team to make a difference while advancing your career with Renovo.

Summary:
The Global Director owns the Enterprise Laboratory Instrument Services (ELIS) program end to end across North America and Europe. The role is accountable for one operating model across both regions, contractual performance at program level, and the senior client relationship above site and regional level.

The program covers roughly 35,000 assets across twenty sites in five countries, on four systems of record, under two entirely different workforce transfer regimes. North America has no automatic transfer and every seat is a posted requisition. Belgium and the Netherlands transfer automatically under the Acquired Rights Directive, and Switzerland is terminate and rehire. The role has to hold one service standard across all of that rather than allowing a regional variant to form.

What you will do:
Program ownership:

• Own one operating model across both regions, including intake, entitlement, dispatch, verification and payment, so a site does not run a local variant because of its size or history.

• Own program-level contractual performance against the master service agreement and every executed addendum.

• Hold the program governance rhythm, including steering meetings, checkpoint reviews and executive reporting to the client.

• Own the transition plan through to go-live and the stabilisation period after it.

• Own the global data standard so a single reporting position exists across four systems of record.

Regional leadership:

• Lead both Regional Directors of Operations and hold them to one set of standards rather than two.

• Arbitrate where a regional constraint conflicts with the global model, and decide rather than allowing the difference to persist unresolved.

• Own the global workforce position across both transfer regimes, partnering with Human Resources on automatic transfer obligations in Europe and on the posted requisition process in North America.

• Own succession and bench depth for regional and site leadership across both regions.

• Own retention for the program, with named plans for critical and hard-to-replace individuals, including sole coverage at small sites.

Commercial ownership:

• Own the program-level change order and material scope change position, including any change that crosses both regions.

• Own program profit and loss, including forecast accuracy at global level.

• Own the commercial position on entitlement strategy jointly with the Global Director, Sourcing and Payments, so a sourcing decision and a delivery consequence are never separated.

• Approve deferment and coverage decisions that carry compliance or contractual consequence at program level.

• Grow the program through scope expansion, third-party conversion and additional site onboarding.

Client relationship:

• Hold the senior client relationship above site and regional level, and present at executive reviews.

• Partner with client executive stakeholders to align the Renovo asset management strategy with their priority business goals.

• Present current state of service delivery, key performance indicator performance and forward goals at program governance and quarterly business reviews.

Vendor management and safety:

• Escort is a standing expectation of every role on this program, not a task assigned to a subset of the team. Anyone in this role escorts and hosts OEM and third-party engineers where the assignment requires it.

• Maintain a safe working environment for self and others when visiting client sites.

• Complete required safety and compliance training on time.

Qualifications:

• Fifteen years or more in laboratory, scientific or medical equipment service, with significant experience leading multi-country operations.

• Proven accountability for a global or multi-region managed service program at contract level.

• Experience operating across more than one workforce transfer regime, including automatic transfer jurisdictions.

• Experience holding a commercial position at contract level, including change orders and scope change.

• Experience in a pharmaceutical, biotechnology or research environment required.

• Experience of a large service transition or contract mobilisation required.

Education/Special Training:

• Bachelor's degree required, in a scientific, technical or business discipline. Advanced degree preferred.

• Training in laboratory safety, GxP and data integrity provided or required.

• Platform and CMMS training provided after hire.

• Training on any site-specific system of record used across the program provided after hire.

Required Competencies:

• One Program, Two Regions - holds a single standard across regions with different laws, systems and histories.

• Decision Making - arbitrates regional conflict and closes it rather than letting it persist.

• Commercial Ownership - holds the change order position at program level.

• Executive Presence - credible with client executive leadership and gives straight answers.

• Talent Building - develops regional leadership and builds succession depth.

• Priority Setting - directs effort across regions where it counts.

• Sense of Urgency - possesses and displays a sense of urgency to internal and external customers.

• Integrity - can admit mistakes, is direct and truthful, and acts in the best interest of clients, employees and Renovo.

• Escort Readiness - treats escort as part of the job at every level, and does not decline it.

Success Measures:

• Program-level contractual key performance indicator attainment across both regions

• Program profit and loss performance to plan, including forecast accuracy

• One operating model adopted at every site, measured on process conformance rather than intent

• Global data standard adoption across all systems of record

• Retention of regional and site leadership, and bench depth behind both

• Transition delivered to go-live without a lapse in service coverage

• Client executive satisfaction at program level

• Program growth through scope expansion and third-party conversion

Safety Requirements:

• Abide by and follow Renovo safety policies, procedures, and injury and illness prevention expectations.

• Maintain a safe working environment for self and others when visiting customer sites, laboratories, offices, or operational environments.

• Follow applicable customer site safety requirements, OSHA guidelines, and laboratory or facility-specific procedures as required.

• Complete required safety training assignments on time.

Physical Requirements:

• Predominantly remote, office-based work.

• When on client sites, presence in active laboratory environments including areas with biological, chemical, electrical and cryogenic hazards.

• Ability to wear required personal protective equipment when on site.

• Travel approximately 30 to 50 percent, across both regions.

Classification:
FLSA: Exempt

**Note: This position description does not list every activity, duty, and responsibility of the position and may be altered by RENOVO at any time.

EEO Statement
RENOVO Solutions provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, or genetics. In addition to federal law requirements, RENOVO Solutions complies with applicable state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment in every location in which the company has facilities. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training. Employee is an at-will employee, and this does not act as a contract of employment.

The ALTO high-speed rail project aims to improve the quality of life of our citizens, strengthen ties between communities, and stimulate economic growth.

Are you convinced that a more sustainable world is possible and that mobility is an integral part of thinking about the future of our planet? Come aboard with SYSTRA Canada and be part of the project that will revolutionize the railway industry in Canada!

Independently leads systems engineering tasks and contributes to multidisciplinary project delivery.

The detailed responsibilities include:

  • Support system architecture activities by providing structured engineering input, maintaining consistency across related artefacts, and contributing to readiness for future Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) implementation.
  • Maintain key system engineering structures, including the System Breakdown Structure (SBS) and Functional Breakdown Structure (FBS), ensuring consistency with project documentation and engineering activities.

Years of experience: Minimum 10 years of experience.

  • Familiarity with systems engineering standards and frameworks such as ISO/IEC/IEEE 15288.
  • Understanding of system architecture concepts, functional analysis, and system decomposition in complex multidisciplinary projects.
  • Familiarity with MBSE principles and systems modelling approaches; experience with related tools would be an asset.
  • Ability to apply structured and methodical engineering practices to support technical coordination, documentation consistency, and cross-functional alignment.

Bilingualism is therefore fundamental to building strong relationships with our customers, understanding their specific needs, communicating effectively in their preferred language and facilitating strategic meetings.

Personal and soft skills:

They are responsible for leading the planning and delivery of web and intranet enhancements to ensure solutions meet nominated requirements and user needs, and management of all projects in alignment with budgets and timing in conjunction with any nominated project manager.

Position Duties

  • Oversee and contribute to the delivery of digital content and platform administration, providing expert advice and hands-on support where required.
  • Establish and maintain digital governance, operational processes, publishing and quality assurance practices that support the delivery of high-quality digital content and service
  • Lead the planning and delivery of web and intranet enhancements, ensuring solutions meet business requirements and user needs; and, for larger initiatives, act as the business lead, working closely with project managers, vendors and technical specialists to deliver successful project outcomes.
  • Manage contracts, procurement activities and vendor performance ensuring value for money and delivery of contracted services.
  • Provide authoritative advice on digital publishing, accessibility, content design, content governance, search optimisation and digital service delivery.
  • Monitor emerging technologies, digital trends and developments in artificial intelligence, assessing opportunities and risks and providing advice on their potential application to websites, intranets within the role's area of responsibility.

Selection Criteria

1. Digital platform leadership and governance

  • Demonstrated experience managing and continuously improving websites, intranets and associated digital applications, including substantial experience with Squiz DXP and familiarity with GovCMS, or similar content management systems.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of Australian Government digital policies, standards and best practice, including accessibility, content design, information architecture, search optimisation and content governance principles.
  • Experience establishing and maintaining operational processes, governance and standards that ensure digital services are secure, accessible, compliant, reliable and user focused.
  • Understanding of emerging digital technologies and trends, including the opportunities and risks associated with artificial intelligence in digital service delivery.

2. Leadership and people management

  • Demonstrated stakeholder engagement and management experience in a high-volume environment , including balancing competing priorities, allocating resources effectively, managing workloads, and fostering capability development.

3. Strategic thinking, judgement and continuous improvement

  • Highly developed analytical, problem-solving and decision-making skills, with the ability to exercise sound judgement in a complex operating environment.
  • Proven ability to use data, analytics, user insights and business requirements to inform strategic decisions and drive continuous improvement in digital services.

4. Project, procurement and contract management

  • Demonstrated experience managing and coordinating the delivery of digital enhancements and service improvements, including working with specialist project managers, vendors and technical specialists to implement solutions that meet business and user needs.
  • Proven experience managing vendors, contracts and procurement activities, including monitoring performance, managing risks and achieving value-for-money outcomes.

Qualifications

  • Tertiary qualifications in digital management, information technology, information management or a related discipline, and/or extensive experience managing digital platforms and services.
  • Experience in the legal or justice sector and government experience will be highly regarded.

description:
One‑on‑One or Small‑Group Pet Therapy Visits

Bring comfort, connection, and pure joy to residents in aged care by sharing the company of your friendly dog or gentle, tame bird or rabbit. This ongoing pet‑therapy role invites volunteers to move room‑to‑room and spend time in common spaces, offering residents the chance to enjoy the warmth, calm, and companionship that only animals can bring.

Your visits create beautiful moments — a wagging tail, a soft feathered friend, a quiet cuddle, or a shared smile. Many residents light up when they see an animal, and your presence helps spark conversation, reduce loneliness, and bring a sense of comfort and connection.

If you have a well‑behaved pet who loves people and enjoys gentle interactions, this role offers a meaningful way to brighten someone’s day, again and again.

Volunteering as a social visitor can be a rewarding experience, both for the person you visit as well as yourself. Regular visits from volunteers can help to improve quality of life and help people feel less isolated.





HammondCare

HammondCare is an independent Christian charity and we're passionate about improving the quality of life for people in need. We have a wonderful group of volunteers that partner with us to enhance the lives of the clients cared for by HammondCare.

HammondCare is a provider of The Aged Care Volunteer Visitors Scheme funded by the Australian Government and is established to promote links between elderly people and volunteers in their local community.

title: Enrollment Operations & Process Lead
description:
ABOUT ALU

At the African Leadership University (ALU), we're more than just an institution—we're a catalyst for transformation. Our mission is to develop a new generation of ethical and entrepreneurial leaders who will shape Africa's future. Through our innovative curriculum, focus on experiential learning, and vibrant pan-African community, we empower students to become changemakers, problem-solvers, and innovators. At ALU, we're not just teaching; we're nurturing the leaders who will drive Africa's progress and prosperity in the 21st century

We are dedicated to fostering an open yet secure environment, balancing the safety of students, staff, and visitors with respect for individual rights, and safeguarding responsibilities.

HOW WE WORK

The ALU Team works in starkly different ways to traditional academic bureaucracies. We approach education from first principles, empower individuals to design, test, and implement creative new ideas, and work closely together to craft transformative learning experiences. We are deeply passionate about our students and excited by the challenge of building something entirely new.

The African Leadership University is committed to ensuring the safety and Well-being of all students under our care. As part of this commitment , we have a comprehensive safeguarding policy in place , which outlines our Zero-tolerance approach to any violation of safeguarding.

ABOUT THE TEAM

The International Student Admissions team is ALU's primary engine for recruiting fee-paying students from across the African continent, with a particular focus on international schools, elite private school networks, and the families who invest in world-class education for their children. We are a regionally connected, culturally fluent, and commercially sharp team that combines deep local market knowledge with a continent-wide perspective. We build relationships that last — with school counselors, administrators, and families — and hold ourselves to ambitious enrollment targets, because every fee-paying student we bring to ALU strengthens ALU's ability to deliver on its mission at scale.

ABOUT THE ROLE

The International Admissions Manager – East Africa leads ALU's fee-paying student recruitment strategy across the East African region, with primary responsibility for international schools and private school networks in key markets including Kenya, Tanzania, Uganda, Rwanda, Ethiopia, and neighbouring countries. Reporting to the Admissions Director, this is a mid-to-senior level role focused on building relationships with international and private school communities — including students, parents, and school counselors — to drive a strong pipeline of tuition-paying students. The Manager also provides guidance and coordination support to associate-level colleagues in other regional markets.

  • Develop and execute a targeted annual recruitment strategy for East Africa focused on fee-paying students, with particular emphasis on international schools, private schools, and premium school networks across the region.
  • Own and manage the full admissions pipeline for East African fee-paying applicants — from initial outreach and lead generation through application, interview, offer, and enrollment confirmation.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with international school counselors, heads of sixth form, private school administrators, and parent communities across East Africa.
  • Plan, coordinate, and attend targeted recruitment events including international school fairs, private school visits, parent information evenings, and virtual engagement sessions.
  • Develop a deep understanding of the international school landscape in East Africa — including IB, A-Level, AP, and IGCSE school networks — to ensure ALU is well-positioned as a destination for their graduating students.
  • Use CRM systems to manage applicant records, track pipeline health, monitor conversion rates, and produce regular reporting for the Admissions Director.
  • Contribute to the development of regionally tailored recruitment materials, digital content, and outreach messaging targeted at international school students and their families.
  • Coordinate with the Enrollment Manager to ensure smooth handoffs from offer acceptance through to confirmed enrollment, including immigration and travel support for incoming students.
  • Provide regional market intelligence and trend analysis — including international school enrolment trends, competitor university positioning, and family decision-making dynamics — to inform strategic planning.
  • Mentor and support junior team members and associates, sharing best practices and contributing to team capability development.
  • Represent ALU at international school fairs, university counselor conferences, and regional education sector events.

Qualifications & Experience

REQUIRED EXPERIENCE
  • Experience (typically 5+ years) in student recruitment, university admissions, or education-sector business development, with a focus on international or private school markets in East Africa.
  • Demonstrated track record of recruiting fee-paying students and meeting enrollment targets.
  • Strong existing networks with international school counselors, private school administrators, or parent communities across East Africa.
  • Familiarity with international curricula (IB, A-Level, IGCSE, AP) and how students from these systems approach university selection.
  • Experience using CRM systems for pipeline management and recruitment reporting.
  • Willingness to travel extensively within East Africa and occasionally beyond the region.
REQUIRED COMPETENCIES

Functional Skills

  • Fee-paying student recruitment strategy — understanding of how international school families evaluate and select universities.
  • School counselor and administrator relationship management.
  • Pipeline management and CRM proficiency.
  • Data analysis — ability to interpret regional trends and translate them into actionable recruitment plans.
  • International school fair and recruitment event planning across multiple in-country locations.

Soft Skills & Mindset

  • Polished and credible — confident engaging with international school leadership, counselors, and discerning families.
  • Entrepreneurial and self-directed — able to build and grow a premium recruitment market with limited precedent.
  • Collaborative and team-oriented — comfortable mentoring junior colleagues and working cross-functionally.
  • Mission-driven — believes in ALU's vision and can articulate its value proposition compellingly to families making significant financial investments in their child's education.
  • Bachelor's degree required; Master's degree preferred.

• Responsible for deploying, administering and supporting endpoint technologies for NSW Parliament.
  • Ongoing full-time - Sydney CBD based.

About the role:

The End User Computing Specialist is responsible for deploying, administering and supporting endpoint computing devices and associated technologies for the NSW Parliament. This includes desktops, laptops, mobile devices, tablets, printers, monitors and other peripherals.

The role ensures workplace technologies are secure, current, and responsive to user needs, enabling Members, their staff, and Parliamentary departments to operate effectively. The role is hands-on and technically focused.


About us:

Based in NSW Parliament, the Department of Parliamentary Services (DPS) is a specialist service department working to support the operation of the Parliament of NSW by providing logistical support and advice to members, the Departments of the Legislative Council and Legislative Assembly and the people of New South Wales. Our office is found close to public transport in the heart of Macquarie Street CBD, next to the State Library and Sydney’s Botanic Gardens.

Enabling the Parliament, serving New South Wales: We demonstrate and foster in others a commitment to the five values of the Department of Parliamentary Services: collaboration, innovation, excellence, integrity and service.

Our commitment to diversity: We welcome applications from people from diverse backgrounds and encourage women, Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples, LGBTQIA+, people with disability, mature-age people, and people from culturally diverse backgrounds to apply for this role.

Our people:

Our people have access to a range of benefits that help balance life at work and at home. Some of the benefits available when you join Parliament include:

  • Competitive salary and annual leave loading
  • 35-hour week and flexible work options
  • Corporate Wellbeing programs including seminars and Fitness Passport
  • Free annual Influenza vaccination
  • Salary packaging options via superannuation contributions or a novated vehicle lease
  • On-site fitness facilities, pool, restaurant, cafes, and post office


About you

In this role you would require experience in deploying endpoint computing devices, including desktops, laptops, tablets and mobile devices; and providing quality user support in a decentralised, high demand organisation. Experience supporting Windows-based environments, Microsoft 365 applications and mobile devices in enterprise or government environments. Familiarity with device imaging, SOE management, patching and endpoint security practices. Experience with asset management and equipment lifecycle practices.

Essential Requirements

Copies of qualifications, certificates or documentation (other than requested) is not required at this stage in the recruitment process and will not be included with application documents.

  • Provide an example of how you resolved, or helped resolve, a user’s technology issue. What was the issue, what steps did you take, how did you communicate with the user and what did you document afterwards?

Technical assistance: Should you encounter any technical problems, please contact ‘I work for NSW’ helpdesk 1800 562 679 (Monday - Friday).

To be eligible to apply for this role, you must meet one of the following criteria:

Come and explore the Parliament online with our 360-degree Virtual Tour.

You will build systems where Large Language Models can reason, plan, use external tools, and execute complex multi-step tasks with limited human intervention. The role covers agent orchestration, API and enterprise-system integration, memory management, evaluation, and safety engineering. You will work with modern agentic AI frameworks and emerging approaches to build reliable and scalable AI applications. This is an opportunity to contribute to advanced generative AI initiatives in a technically ambitious engineering environment.   • Design short-term and long-term memory mechanisms that allow agents to maintain relevant context throughout extended workflows and interactions.
  • Develop automated evaluation frameworks to assess agent performance, reliability, task completion, reasoning quality, and failure scenarios.
  • Monitor and optimize token consumption, latency, execution costs, and overall system performance.
  • Implement safety mechanisms and guardrails to reduce hallucinations, constrain unintended actions, and prevent unsafe or uncontrolled agent behavior.
  • Collaborate with engineering and AI teams to translate complex business requirements into scalable, production-ready agentic AI solutions.

    • Requirements:

    • 3–7 years of professional experience in software engineering, AI development, machine learning, or a closely related field, including hands-on experience with generative AI or agentic systems.
    • Advanced proficiency in Python, including asynchronous programming and the development of scalable AI services.
    • Strong practical knowledge of major LLM provider APIs, such as OpenAI, Anthropic, Mistral, or equivalent platforms.
    • Hands-on experience developing agentic applications using LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, or similar agent orchestration frameworks.
    • Good understanding of multi-agent architectures, tool calling, workflow orchestration, prompt design, context management, and LLM-based application development.
    • Working knowledge of vector databases such as Pinecone, Qdrant, or Weaviate, as well as relational databases and data-access patterns.
    • Experience with Docker and containerized application development.
    • Strong understanding of software engineering fundamentals, including modular architecture, clean code, unit testing, version control, and production-quality development practices.
    • Experience establishing rigorous testing and evaluation methodologies for AI systems, including handling edge cases and failure modes.
    • Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in a fast-moving AI engineering environment.
    • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or a related technical discipline.

      • Benefits:

      • Remote-friendly working model with flexibility across India.

      • Opportunity to work on advanced agentic AI, multi-agent systems, LLM applications, and intelligent automation.
      • Exposure to modern AI frameworks, LLM platforms, vector databases, APIs, and cloud-ready engineering practices.
      • Opportunity to contribute to production-grade AI systems designed to automate complex workflows and real-world business processes.

Job Description

Honey Homes is hiring the best handymen and remodelers in San Jose! You'll work near where you live, either on a dedicated territory of 40 to 50 homes or on our larger projects crew. No client hunting, no unpredictable schedules, no weekends. Just steady, well paid work close to home. We serve over 4,000 homeowners across California, Texas, and Illinois, and we're growing fast, so there's real room to move up. We're offering a $1,500 sign on bonus for qualified candidates, paid out in full after you complete training and remain onboard for 30 days.

Two Ways To Work With Us

1. Dedicated Handyman

You work with a small group of homeowners to help them maintain their homes, about 40 to 50 homes in a small territory near where you live. You visit on a regular schedule, get to know every house, and become the trusted handyman each homeowner calls. Not a different face every visit.

2. Remodeling Technician

You work on multi day residential projects: exterior repaints, dry rot repair, decks and fences, doors and trim, bathroom refreshes with plumbing and electrical. A project lead scopes the job and sets the plan, so you just build.

Same pay, same hours, same benefits either way. Tell us which one fits you and we'll match you to it. The work is sold and scheduled before you show up. No bidding, no invoicing, no chasing clients.

What You Get

  • Great pay: $37/hr ($77,000 per year) plus equity in the business.

  • Sign on bonus: $1,500, paid in full after training and 30 days onboard.

  • Great hours: Monday to Friday, 8:30am to 5:00pm. No nights, weekends, required overtime, or on call.

  • Work close to home: your territory is a small area, not the whole metro. Less driving, more working.

  • Generous time off: 12 paid holidays plus 13 PTO/sick days.

  • Benefits and perks: 100% company paid health, vision, and dental; 401(k); life insurance; flexible spending accounts; and a company phone.

  • Real growth opportunities: roles like field trainer, senior handyman, and project lead as we expand.

  • Mileage reimbursement: paid for all local driving between jobs.

What You'll Do

  • Perform residential repair, maintenance, and remodel work across multiple trades:

    • Carpentry (doors, trim, framing, dry rot, decks, fences)

    • Painting and drywall patching

    • Plumbing (toilets, faucets, valves, minor pipe repairs)

    • Electrical (fixtures, outlets, switches, ceiling fans, small wiring tasks)

    • Smart home device installation

  • Provide outstanding customer service and build strong relationships. You're in members' homes, and they need to trust you.

  • Use our app to track jobs, tasks, and schedules.

What Homeowners Say

“I love having a personal handyman, not just someone random every visit. The quality of his work is wonderful.” (Honey Homes member)

“The team is so kind and proactive. They get so much done every visit and are really resourceful and creative problem solvers.” (Honey Homes member)

Job Requirements

  • 5+ years of handyman, maintenance technician, remodeling, or multi-trade experience.

  • Hands on skill across carpentry, plumbing, electrical, painting, and drywall.

  • Prior work as a maintenance technician, carpenter, plumber, or electrician strongly preferred.

  • Experience in residential home repair and upkeep across multiple trade areas.

  • Strong troubleshooting and problem solving ability. You can independently assess and fix most issues in a home.

  • Attention to detail (clean caulk lines, professional patching and painting).

  • Customer friendly attitude: great listener, strong communicator, proactive.

  • Reliable vehicle, valid driver's license, and your own tools.

  • Ability to lift and carry up to 50 pounds regularly (with or without reasonable accommodation).

  • Comfortable working on ladders or scaffolding at heights up to 12 feet.

You do not need a contractor's, electrical, or plumbing license. Permitted work is handled separately.

title: Java Microservices Engineers
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Java Microservices Engineer based in India.

We are seeking an experienced Java engineer to design, develop, and maintain scalable distributed backend systems for enterprise applications. You will build high-performance microservices using the Java and Spring ecosystem, with a strong focus on reliability, security, and maintainability. The role involves developing APIs, integrating distributed services, optimizing databases, and supporting modern AI-enabled application components. You will work with cloud-native technologies including Docker, Kubernetes, messaging platforms, and automated CI/CD pipelines. The position offers the opportunity to solve complex distributed-systems challenges in a collaborative, agile engineering environment. Your work will contribute to resilient backend platforms capable of supporting demanding workloads and evolving business requirements.

Accountabilities:

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable, modular, and decoupled microservices using Java and the Spring Boot ecosystem.
  • Build enterprise-grade backend services following established software architecture principles, design patterns, security standards, and engineering best practices.
  • Develop, document, and secure high-performance REST and GraphQL APIs for communication between internal services, external applications, and AI-enabled endpoints.
  • Design resilient distributed systems using techniques such as circuit breaking, fault tolerance, rate limiting, retries, and distributed tracing.
  • Monitor and optimize application performance, scalability, availability, and resource utilization under high-volume workloads.
  • Design efficient database schemas, manage transaction boundaries, and optimize queries across SQL and NoSQL data stores.
  • Develop event-driven architectures using messaging technologies such as Kafka and RabbitMQ.
  • Implement caching strategies using technologies such as Redis to improve application performance and reduce system load.
  • Containerize applications using Docker and support deployment and orchestration through Kubernetes.
  • Maintain and improve automated CI/CD pipelines supporting reliable build, testing, deployment, and release processes.
  • Write comprehensive automated tests using tools such as JUnit and Mockito and contribute to strong code quality and maintainability standards.
  • Collaborate with architects, product teams, developers, DevOps engineers, and other cross-functional stakeholders within agile engineering squads.
  • Contribute to technical discussions, architecture decisions, code reviews, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement initiatives.

    • Requirements:

    • 4–8 years of professional enterprise software engineering experience, with strong hands-on expertise in Java.
    • Advanced knowledge of Java 11/17+, Spring Boot, and Spring Cloud.
    • Proven experience designing and developing distributed systems and production-grade microservices architectures.
    • Strong experience building and securing REST APIs, with GraphQL experience considered valuable.
    • Practical knowledge of messaging and event-streaming technologies such as Kafka and RabbitMQ.
    • Experience with caching technologies such as Redis and an understanding of distributed caching patterns.
    • Strong database knowledge across relational SQL and NoSQL technologies, including schema design, transactions, query optimization, and data access patterns.
    • Hands-on experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud-native application deployment.
    • Experience designing and maintaining automated CI/CD pipelines.
    • Strong understanding of software design patterns, clean architecture, secure coding practices, and enterprise engineering standards.
    • Experience with automated testing frameworks such as JUnit and Mockito.
    • Understanding of observability and distributed-system concepts, including logging, monitoring, tracing, resilience, and performance optimization.
    • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to troubleshoot complex backend and integration issues.
    • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with experience working within agile and cross-functional engineering teams.
    • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related technical discipline.

      • Benefits:

      • Annual compensation of approximately INR 2,200,000–3,500,000 CTC, depending on experience and skills.
      • Full-time, mid-to-senior-level employment opportunity.
      • Remote-friendly working model with flexibility across India.
      • Location options including Bangalore, Pune, hybrid, or remote across India.
      • Opportunity to work on enterprise-scale distributed systems and modern microservices architectures.
      • Hands-on exposure to Java, Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, Kafka, RabbitMQ, Redis, Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD technologies.
      • Opportunity to contribute to AI-enabled backend integrations and modern cloud-native application architectures.
      • Collaborative agile environment involving engineers, architects, product teams, and DevOps professionals.
      • Opportunities to work on high-throughput, resilient, and security-focused software platforms.
      • Professional development through exposure to modern engineering practices, distributed systems, and cloud-native technologies.

title: Data Engineer
description:

Job Title: Data Engineer

Location: Hybrid – Manchester City Centre (1-2 days per week office-based)

Salary: Up to £49,000 per annum

Contract: Permanent

Please note: UK applicants only | No sponsorship available


About Us

Outcomes First Group is the UKs largest independent provider of specialist education and care. Through our divisional brands, we work across education, care and childrens services to deliver high-quality support and improve outcomes for children and young people.


As we continue to grow and invest in technology, were looking for a Data Engineer to join our IT team and play a key role in developing and supporting modern data platforms, integrations and automation technologies that enable data-driven decision-making across the organisation.


About the Role

This is an exciting opportunity to join a growing technology function where youll be responsible for designing, developing and supporting enterprise-scale data solutions using Microsoft Fabric.


Acting as a technical specialist, youll work closely with business stakeholders, SaaS providers and internal technology teams to deliver secure, reliable and scalable data solutions that support reporting, analytics and operational performance across the Group.


Youll play a key role in building and maintaining modern data platforms, developing robust data pipelines and delivering governed data solutions that enable colleagues to access trusted and meaningful information.


Alongside data engineering responsibilities, youll support integrations and automation technologies across the organisation, helping to improve business processes and support our ongoing digital transformation programme.


Were looking for someone with strong technical expertise, excellent problem-solving skills and a passion for building scalable, high-quality data solutions that deliver meaningful business outcomes.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, maintain and support secure integrations between business applications and systems.
  • Design, build and optimise data pipelines, transformation processes and data solutions using Microsoft Fabric.
  • Develop and manage Lakehouse and Warehouse solutions using OneLake, Delta tables, SQL and PySpark.
  • Deliver scalable and governed data solutions that support reporting, analytics and business intelligence requirements.
  • Implement engineering best practices across data platforms, including testing, deployment, documentation and support processes.
  • Manage source control, deployment pipelines and application lifecycle activities for data solutions.
  • Monitor platform performance through logging, alerting and proactive troubleshooting.
  • Investigate and resolve data, integration and platform-related issues, ensuring high availability and reliability.
  • Ensure all solutions meet security, governance and compliance requirements.
  • Work closely with stakeholders, software vendors and technical teams to understand requirements and deliver effective solutions.
  • Support continuous improvement across data engineering, reporting, analytics and integration capabilities.
  • Provide technical guidance and expertise to internal teams and third-party suppliers.


Experience, Skills & Qualifications

Essential

  • Proven experience in a Data Engineer or similar data-focused role.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Fabric, including Data Factory, Dataflows Gen2, Lakehouse and Warehouse solutions.
  • Experience designing and developing ETL/ELT processes, enterprise data pipelines and transformation workflows.
  • Strong SQL and Python skills, including experience with PySpark.
  • Experience working with OneLake, Delta tables and modern cloud-based data platforms.
  • Experience developing and supporting integrations using APIs and authentication methods such as OAuth and Entra ID.
  • Strong understanding of data architecture, governance and security principles.
  • Experience implementing engineering best practices including testing, deployment and support processes.
  • Excellent troubleshooting, analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences.


Desirable

  • Experience with Microsoft Power Platform technologies, including Power Automate.
  • Knowledge of Azure data and analytics services.
  • Experience implementing CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices.
  • Knowledge of Microsoft Purview and data governance frameworks.
  • Experience supporting enterprise-scale analytics and reporting platforms.
  • Relevant Microsoft certifications, including Fabric Data Engineer Associate or equivalent.
  • Experience working within a multi-site or complex organisational environment.


Why Join Us?

Youll be joining a growing organisation where technology plays a critical role in improving services, supporting colleagues and driving innovation.


Outcomes First Group is the UKs largest independent provider of specialist education and care, operating across England, Scotland and Wales through our divisional brands including Acorn Education, Options Autism, Blenheim Schools and Momenta Connect.


By joining our central technology team, youll have the opportunity to work on exciting transformation projects, shape the future of data and analytics within the organisation, and make a meaningful impact across the business. We value collaboration, innovation and continuous improvement, providing an environment where your ideas and expertise can make a real difference.


Benefits

  • Pension scheme with flexible contribution options
  • "Your Wellbeing Matters" – mental and physical health support
  • Family Growth Support, including enhanced maternity and paternity leave
  • Flexible benefits via Vista (Cycle to Work, Electric Car Scheme, discounts, critical illness cover and more)

We are at the forefront of precision engineering and innovation, specializing in the development and manufacturing of vital components for medical markets such as Robotic Assisted Surgery, Orthopedics, Surgical Instruments, Dental, and more. Our teams work in unison, collaborating and problem-solving to serve the manufacturing needs of the top Medical Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEMs) around the globe. Making a difference in the lives of patients and their families drives us to go above and beyond every day. With a steadfast commitment to advancing medical technology, we take immense pride in the work we do – and have a lot of fun doing it.

Hobson & Motzer is a vertically integrated manufacturer of precision metal components and assemblies serving the needs of the medical device market and other advanced industries. We operate two manufacturing plants with primary operations—and headquarters—centrally located in Durham, CT; our Advanced Manufacturing Center is just a few miles away in Wallingford, CT. Description. Join an organization that has a reputation for outstanding leadership, innovation, and expertise. Our employees use their creativity and talent to invent new solutions, meet new demands, and offer the most effective services and solutions in the industry.




About this Opportunity:

The Mechatronics Operator is responsible for safely operating automated manufacturing equipment while ensuring the highest standards of quality, productivity, and equipment performance. This role combines traditional machine operation with entry-level technical responsibilities, including first-level troubleshooting, machine resets, basic mechanical adjustments, and routine preventive maintenance. Mechatronic Operators serve as the first line of support for automated production cells by resolving routine equipment issues and minimizing downtime. More complex mechanical, electrical, PLC, or automation issues are escalated to Mechatronic Technicians.



Responsibilities:

  • Safely operate automated assembly equipment and production cells in accordance with work instructions and standard operating procedures.
  • Consistently achieve production, quality, and efficiency targets.
  • Monitor equipment performance and respond to routine machine alarms and faults.
  • Perform basic machine resets and recover equipment from minor stoppages.
  • Perform approved Mechatronic Operator level mechanical adjustments including sensor alignment, fixture adjustments, brush station adjustments, deburring station adjustments and routine machine resets
  • Perform daily preventive maintenance activities and equipment inspections.
  • Replace worn or damaged tooling and pre-stage replacement tools during scheduled downtime.
  • Perform visual inspections and basic dimensional gauging using approved inspection equipment.
  • Prepare quality samples, including weld penetration sections when required.
  • Complete all production documentation accurately, including product traceability records and MES labor reporting.
  • Maintain product identification and traceability throughout the manufacturing process.
  • Identify quality concerns and perform approved process adjustments when appropriate.
  • Monitor machine performance and immediately report recurring equipment abnormalities
  • Escalate complex mechanical, electrical, controls, or automation issues to Mechatronic Technicians.
  • Support Group Leads with workflow, training, and production activities as needed.
  • Participate in Lean Manufacturing and Continuous Improvement initiatives by identifying opportunities to improve safety, quality, equipment reliability, and productivity.
  • Maintain a clean, organized work area utilizing 5S principles.
  • Follow all company safety procedures, PPE requirements, quality standards, and work instructions.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

description:
POSITION: Maintenance Director

REPORTS TO: Executive Director

FLSA: Exempt

OUR MISSION: We are united in our mission to offer seniors an elevated way of life, where comfort, connection, and joy thrive.

POSITION SUMMARY

We are seeking an experienced and dedicated maintenance director to lead our facilities management team. The maintenance director will oversee all aspects of maintenance, repairs, and upkeep for our properties, ensuring a safe and well-maintained environment. This role is essential to our operations, providing leadership and expertise in facility management.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Hires, evaluates, coordinates, motivates, monitors performance, schedules, and supervises department staff in accordance with company policy and state law.
  • Makes recommendations to the Executive Director with respect to staff evaluations, merit pay increases, reprimands, disciplinary actions, and terminations.
  • Coordinates maintenance and housekeeping services and activities with other departments.
  • Assures that the building and grounds are always clean.
  • Flexibility to remain on-call 24 hours per day, including evenings and weekends to respond to emergencies if needed.
  • Works within legal scope of local and state codes.
  • Participates in property surveys (inspections) made by authorized government agencies. Maintains positive communications with local fire marshal, building inspector, state elevator inspector, and any other jurisdiction governing the property.
  • Conducts daily inspection of the properties outside grounds. Immediately corrects any needed items to assure property is always tour-ready.
  • Supervises safety and fire protection and prevention programs by inspecting work areas and equipment regularly.
  • Schedules and oversees quarterly fire drills and semi-annual disaster drills. Acts as safety coordinator and attends meeting of Quality Assurance/Safety/Infection Control Committee.
  • Ensures compliance with policies and procedures to identify appropriate safety precautions and equipment to use when performing tasks that could result in bodily injury.
  • Ensures that containers of hazardous chemicals in the department are properly labeled and stored.
  • Ensures that all necessary Safety Data Sheets (SDS) are obtained, maintained and stored in areas accessible to all employees.
  • Responsible for implementation of all OSHA policies.
  • Assists in establishing an effective preventive maintenance program of cleaning, painting, maintaining equipment, etc., as necessary and approved.
  • Maintains TELS system to include automated work order system.
  • Checks the maintenance request log daily. Coordinates maintenance requests by residents and employees for items needing repair in their apartments, including repairing plumbing, electrical, heating, and replacing light bulbs. Repairs should be made promptly.
  • Maintains scheduled maintenance on: H.V.A.C., elevator, fire equipment, sprinkler equipment, generator, landscape, kitchen equipment, and emergency pull-cord equipment. Replaces filters in air conditioning units on a regular basis, tests the emergency lighting equipment, fire sprinkler device, smoke detectors and other equipment as required, and participate in emergency drills. Maintains the preventative binder reflecting completed work.
  • Maintains a current list of emergency vendors and their telephone numbers so that other facility personnel can coordinate repairs when the Director of Plant Operations is not on-site.
  • Keeps maintenance room clean at all times. Responsible for tool organization and organization of assigned storage areas.
  • Coordinates repair of walls, floor coverings, doors and woodwork in the common areas of the Property. Assess all plumbing and electrical problems within the property and determines the best course of action to take to correct the problem. Works within legal scope of local and state codes.

  • Encourages teamwork through cooperative interactions with co-workers and other departments.

That fighting spirit lives on in Ford Racing today. We're the engineers, strategists, and competitors who bring Ford's track-tested edge into every vehicle we build. Every track, every stage, every proving ground—that's where we prove ourselves.

Program Delivery

You'll have...

No matter what you choose, we offer a work life that works for you, including:

  • Data Lakehouse Architecture: Design and optimize a high-performance lakehouse pattern utilizing Microsoft Fabric OneLake and Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2 (ADLS Gen2).
  • Data Zone Management: Maintain architectural segregation between raw storage (immutability, landing) and curated data zones (cleansed, conformed business layers) while securely handling identifiable data.
  • Scalable Data Processing: Develop, tune, and monitor large-scale batch processing pipelines using Azure Databricks (Spark-based processing) and PySpark.
  • Orchestration & Workflow: Build automated data workflows using Microsoft Fabric Data Factory and Azure Data Factory to move data efficiently across the platform.

  • Platform Security & Governance: Implement enterprise-grade security baselines including data-at-rest/in-transit encryption, structured logging, automated audit trails, and strict access controls (RBAC, ABAC, and row/column-level security).
  • Future-Proof Analytics: Structure data foundations to readily support future analytical workloads, advanced reporting, and data science use cases.

Required Technical Skills

  • Cloud Platform & Fabric: 3+ years of dedicated hands-on experience in Microsoft Azure, with practical exposure to the Microsoft Fabric ecosystem (OneLake, Data Factory, Fabric Lakehouse).
  • Big Data Processing: Deep technical expertise with Apache Spark / Azure Databricks for distributed compute, memory optimization, and Delta Lake formats.
  • Data Engineering Languages: Advanced proficiency in SQL (T-SQL, SparkSQL) and Python (PySpark).
  • Security & Compliance: Direct experience implementing security controls for sensitive or identifiable data, utilizing Azure Key Vault, Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, and Microsoft Purview.
  • Data Integration: Proven track record of migrating, refactoring, or connecting legacy SQL/stored procedure logic and existing pipelines into modern cloud formats.

Preferred Qualifications & Certifications

  • Certifications: Microsoft Certified: Azure Data Engineer Associate (DP-203) or Microsoft Certified: Fabric Analytics Engineer Associate (DP-600) is highly advantageous.
  • DevOps/IaC: Experience deploying data infrastructure as code using Terraform, Bicep, and managing deployments via Git/Azure DevOps.
  • Soft Skills Exceptional analytical and root-cause debugging skills for distributed Spark jobs and multi-stage pipelines. Ability to collaborate with compliance and security teams to validate data privacy baselines. Strong communication skills to bridge technical delivery with business intelligence requirements.

title: Assistant - Student Records and Data
description:
ABOUT KTF:

KTF is an Australian international aid and development organisation working in Papua New Guinea (PNG).

We work with people and communities to improve the lives and futures of Papua New Guineans. We do this by: assisting remote and rural communities with access to elementary and primary education; improving access to quality and accessible healthcare; improving equality and access to sustainable income-generation opportunities, especially for women; and by fostering the next generation of leaders.

KTF is a member of the Australian Council for International Development and is accredited with the Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade’s Australian Not-for-Profit Cooperation Program.

ABOUT THE ROLE:

The role is open to applicants who are either based in Port Moresby or Balimo. It is a short-term position supporting the FODE program through to the end of 2026. The role will provide additional capacity during a busy period of student records processing, end-of-year administration and program activity.

The Student Records and Data Assistant will support the review, verification and maintenance of student education records and supporting documentation. This includes checking digitised student records against original source documents, correcting clear data-entry errors, identifying missing or inconsistent information, and maintaining accurate records of work completed.

The role will also provide general administrative support to the FODE team, including invoice and payment processing, maintaining administrative records, and assisting with other program administration tasks as required.

The work is detailed and requires exceptional attention to accuracy, good computer skills, strong organisation and the ability to work independently. The position works closely with KTF’s FODE teams and directly supports the effective delivery of FODE Centres and services to students.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Review digitised student certificates, Statements of Results and other education records against original source documentation.
  • Verify that student names, dates, schools, subjects, grades and other recorded information have been captured accurately.
  • Correct clear transcription or data-entry errors where source documentation provides definitive evidence.
  • Classify and reclassify documents in accordance with KTF procedures and approved document categories.
  • Cross-check records against existing student information to identify duplicates, missing documentation and inconsistencies.
  • Maintain accurate records of documents reviewed, corrections made, outstanding issues and items requiring follow-up.
  • Escalate incomplete, conflicting or ambiguous records with clear supporting notes.
  • Apply KTF data-entry, formatting, naming and document-management standards consistently.
  • Maintain the confidentiality and security of student information and records.
  • Assist with the processing and recording of invoices, payments and associated documentation.
  • Support routine FODE administrative tasks, including maintaining records, preparing information, following up documentation and assisting with administrative processes as required.
  • Report on progress against agreed work priorities and deadlines.
  • Participate in regular team meetings and maintain effective communication with relevant KTF staff.
  • Undertake other data entry, records and administration duties reasonably required within the scope of the role.
  • Comply with all KTF safeguarding policies, procedures and codes of conduct.

SKILLS & ATTRIBUTES:

  • Exceptional attention to detail and demonstrated accuracy when working with data and records.
  • Good computer literacy, including confident use of spreadsheets and web-based systems.
  • Strong personal organisation and the ability to manage a high volume of detailed work while maintaining accuracy.
  • Ability to follow established processes and apply rules consistently.
  • Good written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal day-to-day supervision and contribute effectively as part of a team.
  • Ability to accurately process and maintain basic financial and administrative records, including invoices and payment documentation.
  • Familiarity with the PNG education system and secondary school certification, or a strong willingness and ability to learn.
  • Previous experience in data entry, records administration, finance administration or a similar detail-focused role is desirable.
  • Willingness to be based in Port Moresby or Balimo and eligibility to work in PNG.

Closing date: 30th September 2026 or earlier if filled. Applications will be reviewed as they are received.

For queries only, email admin@kokodatrackfoundation.org, with the position title as subject. Please note that applications received via this email will not be considered.

KTF is a child safe organisation committed to the protection of people we serve. Our recruitment and selection procedures are designed to ensure we only recruit people who are suitable and aligned with our policies that ensure the safety of children and protection of all from sexual exploitation, abuse and harassment. All appointments are subject to appropriate background checks and screening, and the successful candidate will be required to get a Police Clearance Certificate. We promote diversity and equality in all our practices and strongly encourage those with diverse backgrounds and/or disabilities and or those who identify as LGBTQI+ to apply for positions with KTF.

title: Manufacturing Assembler
description:
Summary

The Manufacturing Assembler is responsible for using various hand and power tools to assemble parts according to work instructions to meet customer specifications and quality standards in a safe manner.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  1. Prepare work to be accomplished by studying work instructions, blueprints, customer drawings and parts lists; gathering parts, subassemblies, hand tools and materials needed to complete tasks
  2. Follow detailed assembly instructions, processes and procedures to manufacture sub-assemblies per customer and quality requirements
  3. Calculate dimensions and tolerances using mathematics and measuring instruments including but not limited to calipers, micrometers, height gauges, measuring tapes, etc.
  4. Verify dimensions, alignments and clearances of finished parts for conformance to specifications using measuring instruments
  5. Report problems with quality, processes, equipment and materials to Supervisor or applicable personnel (i.e. Management, Quality Control Inspectors, Engineering staff, etc.) to obtain clarification, minimizing scrap and error rate
  6. Keep equipment operational by completing preventive maintenance requirements, following manufacturer's instructions, troubleshooting malfunctions and calling for repairs when necessary (i.e. oiling pneumatic air tools, etc.)
  7. Comply with policies, procedures, guidelines and regulatory guidelines per company quality system notifying applicable personnel of quality issues
  8. Complete all administrative functions related to business or quality systems (i.e. Production Logs, etc.)
  9. Maintain continuity among work shifts and/or departments by documenting and communicating actions taken, irregularities that occurred and continuing needs
  10. Ensure work assignments are carried out to the highest quality ensuring customer specifications are met
  11. Provide hands-on job function training to co-workers as needed
  12. Conserve resources by using equipment and supplies as needed to accomplish job results
  13. Maintains supplies inventory by checking stock to determine inventory levels, anticipating needed supplies, reporting shortages to applicable personnel
  14. Carry out all orders of Management efficiently while harmoniously working as part of a team to meet company goals
  15. Follow all company policies and procedures, maintaining a professional relationship with colleagues, customers, vendors and associates
  16. Maintain a clean and organized work area in order to facilitate manufacturing functions
  17. Utilize computerized data entry equipment and various word processing, spreadsheet and file maintenance programs to enter, store and/or retrieve information
  18. Maintain and update filing and database systems either manually or using a computer
  19. Manage time to determine priorities in order to effectively accomplish a broad range of activities
  20. Continuously evaluate and identify opportunities to drive process improvements that positively impact the customer’s experience
  21. Communicate in a professional, respectful, and courteous manner with all employees, customers, management, and others with whom we may work.
  22. Contribute to a successful work group and foster a team-oriented culture through positive interactions, active listening, meaningful collaborations, high employee engagement, and the constructive exchange of ideas designed to meet or exceed the organization’s strategic goals.
  23. Other duties will be assigned during the course of employment.

title: Signal Integrity Engineer
description:
About the job

Delart is home to a team of world-class engineers and project leaders dedicated to developing the next generation of advanced networking technologies, consumer devices, and innovative technology solutions. Trusted by some of the world’s leading technology companies, we deliver highly scalable, mission-critical solutions that power both consumer and business applications globally. Since our founding in 2017, we have been at the forefront of designing cutting-edge networking, telecommunications, and consumer products, while driving end-to-end project execution and creating transformative technology applications.

Overview

Drive advanced signal and power integrity initiatives for next-generation high-speed digital interfaces by leveraging deep simulation expertise and in-depth PCB design knowledge. This role is responsible for ensuring robust performance of interfaces up to 448Gbps through comprehensive electromagnetic modeling, analysis, and the development of practical design guidelines.

Responsibilities

  • Perform high-frequency electromagnetic simulations for high-speed interfaces (224Gbps, 448Gbps) using Ansys HFSS and Keysight ADS.
  • Execute comprehensive power delivery network (PDN) analysis using industry-standard simulation tools.
  • Analyze signal integrity for advanced interfaces such as PAM4 (56Gbps, 112Gbps) and NRZ (minimum 25Gbps), focusing on simulation-based validation and correlation with measurement data, including eye diagram analysis, jitter/noise analysis, and S-parameter correlation.
  • Apply and document impedance control, transmission line, and PCB manufacturing best practices in practical design guidelines.
  • Prepare thorough technical documentation of simulation methods, results, and recommendations to support hardware development processes.
  • Demonstrate familiarity with Ethernet high-speed interface standards (25G/100G/400G/800G) in simulation and analysis workflows.
  • Collaborate with PCB layout engineers to review and optimize board designs for signal and power integrity in server, data center, and network infrastructure hardware.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in signal integrity simulation for high-speed digital systems.
  • Proficiency with simulation tools such as Ansys HFSS, Cadence Sigrity, PowerSI, Ansys SIwave, and Keysight ADS.
  • Direct experience with high-speed interface technologies, specifically with PAM4 (56Gbps, 112Gbps) and minimum 25Gbps NRZ links.
  • Extensive knowledge of signal and power integrity concepts, PCB stack-up optimization, impedance control, and fabrication constraints.
  • Strong organizational skills and exceptional technical documentation abilities.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Physics, Mathematics, or a related discipline, or equivalent industrial experience.
  • 8+ years of experience in comprehensive signal and power integrity evaluation for high-performance electronic systems.
  • Advanced expertise in the development of design guidelines for ultra-high-speed interconnects.
  • Experience collaborating with PCB fabrication vendors to implement and verify complex impedance-controlled layouts.

Benefits

Delart provides competitive benefits and compensation across all regions where we operate. In the United States, our benefits package includes premium PPO and HMO medical insurance, dental and vision coverage, flexible spending accounts (FSA), life insurance, short- and long-term disability insurance, a company-matched 401(k) plan, and a generous paid time off policy.

Join us in shaping the future of technology. Apply today!

Delart is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are dedicated to fostering an inclusive workplace for all employees. We strictly prohibit discrimination or harassment of any kind based on race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability, genetics, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other characteristic protected by law.

description:
Connect, Chat, and Create Joy in Someone’s Day!

A warm-hearted female volunteer is needed in the Green Valley area!

A lovely lady, aged and full of stories, would love a friendly visitor to spend an hour with her once a week. She enjoys chatting, sharing experiences, and simply having some company during the day.

If you have a little time to connect and brighten someone’s week, this is a wonderful way to make a meaningful difference in your community.



Your impact

Volunteering as a social visitor can be a rewarding experience, both for the person you visit as well as yourself. Regular visits from volunteers can help to improve quality of life and help people feel less isolated.




HammondCare

HammondCare is an independent Christian charity and we're passionate about improving the quality of life for people in need. We have a wonderful group of volunteers that partner with us to enhance the lives of elderly people.

HammondCare is a provider of The Aged Care Volunteer Visitors Scheme funded by the Australian Government and is established to promote links between elderly people and volunteers in their local community.


Further information

Thank you for expressing an interest in volunteering with HammondCare.


We truly love connecting with people who want to volunteer with us. Our team will reach out with a phone call or text as soon as we can, and if we’re unable to get through, we’ll follow up with an email. Please take a moment to check your spam or junk folder as well, as some email providers don’t always recognise our messages right away.


More information on volunteering with HammondCare can be found at




If you have any questions, you can call Dani, our friendly Volunteer Recruitment Coordinator on 1800 79 33 99.



Requirements

18 years or older • National Volunteer Police Check arranged and paid for by HammondCare •

1 hour Weekly visits, we will work out a time to suit your availability between 9am and 5pm Monday to Sunday.

title: Packaging Technician I
description:
Individuals will perform packaging activities efficiently and safely, incorporating quality in every bottle, can, and case, within company specifications and schedules. This includes bottling, canning and warehousing. Must be able to work any shift in a 24-hour period.


Essential Duties and Responsibilities include the following. Other duties may be assigned.

  • Maintain packaging lines, including starting and stopping of equipment.
  • Ability to work in all assigned areas of the packaging line; perform relief duties when required.
  • Follow directions and perform tasks as needed to ensure continuous work throughout shift.
  • Must be able to lift 50 lbs. as needed
  • Must be able to climb up/down ladders throughout the shift
  • Must be able to manually stack pallets of finished goods according to specifications.
  • Must be able to manually produce finished goods including taping/gluing of boxes/trays, packing of boxes/trays, and feeding product on and off of the production line.
  • Perform basic troubleshooting on equipment as needed.
  • Must adhere to escalation protocol and ensure proper channels of escalation are being followed.
  • Load corrugate, glue pellets, ink, stretch wrap, etc. into appropriate machines.
  • Watch flow of packaging materials into appropriate machine. Clear jams if necessary.
  • Ensure that all equipment is on and functioning properly prior to starting a run.
  • Must do visual inspection of boxes to ensure proper box/tray is used and the graphics on the box/tray are acceptable. Must ensure proper coding is on the bottle, cans, and boxes/trays
  • Monitor machines while running. Check to see that all bottles/cans are packed into boxes and on pallets correctly.
  • Understand and follow safety rules including safe lifting practices and safe machine operation. Personal Protective Equipment is to be used where required.
  • Operate forklift in safe and efficient manner. Stage/move/load/unload materials.
  • Handle chemicals according to proper safe handling procedures
  • Other duties, responsibilities and activities may change or be assigned at any time with or without notice.



Food Safety Responsibilities

  • Complete food safety training and implement when needed.
  • "Report any food safety problems to the SQF Practitioner or Department Manager in a timely manner so that corrective actions may be performed."
  • Maintain quality requirements in accordance with company standards. Address and report any major defects or quality issues to the shift lead or supervisor.
  • Housekeeping: maintain general housekeeping in all areas of production, including the break rooms and rest rooms. Remove plastic, cardboard and contaminated bottles/cans when needed; dispose of materials when needed. Keep work area clean at all times.
  • Ensure that all packaging equipment and the packaging area are completely 100% clean and sanitary, ready for the following days or shifts production.
  • Other duties, responsibilities and activities may change or be assigned at any time with or without notice.
