title: Staff Product Development Engineer
description:
ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD.

At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world’s most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future.

Whether you’re designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward. Join us and, together, we’ll advance your career.




THE ROLE:

AMD is seeking a highly motivated Member of Technical Staff (MTS), Post-Silicon Electrical Validation Engineer to join the Server Compute and Enterprise AI Validation team. In this role, you will be responsible for validating and characterizing high-speed I/O interfaces on AMD Datacenter Server and AI platforms, ensuring robust performance, interoperability, and product quality from silicon bring-up through production release.

You will work closely with architecture, silicon design, signal integrity, package, board, firmware, BIOS, software, and platform teams to develop validation plans, execute test strategies, perform electrical characterization, and debug complex system-level issues. The role offers opportunities to contribute to industry-leading technologies including PCIe, Ethernet, Memory Subsystems, and next-generation AI and server platforms.

THE PERSON:

The ideal candidate is passionate about complex technical challenges, enjoys hands-on lab debugging, and has strong fundamentals in high-speed electrical interfaces and system validation. You thrive in a fast-paced environment, can independently drive technical investigations, and possess the ability to translate ambiguous failures into structured debug plans and actionable solutions.

You are a collaborative engineer who combines technical depth, disciplined execution, and continuous learning while contributing to the success of global engineering teams.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Validation Strategy & Execution
    • Develop and execute post-silicon validation plans for high-speed I/O interfaces including PCIe, xGMI, UALink, IFoE, UCIe, and memory-related technologies.
    • Define validation requirements, test coverage, and success criteria to ensure platform-level functionality, performance, and reliability.
    • Design and execute electrical characterization, compliance, interoperability, and stress test scenarios across various operating conditions.
    • Validate advanced interface features including link training, equalization, power management, bandwidth scaling, and platform enablement.

  • Electrical Characterization & Debug
    • Perform hands-on measurements and analysis using oscilloscopes, TDRs, VNAs, protocol analyzers, BERTs, and other advanced lab equipment.
    • Conduct margining experiments, PHY analysis, and electrical characterization to assess interface robustness and optimize system performance.
    • Investigate and debug complex silicon, platform, firmware, BIOS, software, and hardware interactions.
    • Drive root-cause analysis and collaborate with cross-functional teams to implement corrective actions and long-term solutions.

  • Automation & Methodology Development
    • Develop and maintain automation frameworks, test scripts, and regression environments to improve validation efficiency and scalability.
    • Enhance validation methodologies, coverage, and workflows through continuous process improvements.
    • Support data collection, correlation, analysis, and reporting to enable data-driven engineering decisions.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration
    • Work closely with silicon design, architecture, signal integrity, platform engineering, BIOS, firmware, software, and quality teams to drive product readiness.
    • Collaborate with globally distributed engineering teams to align validation objectives, debug activities, and milestone execution.
    • Communicate technical findings, risks, and recommendations to engineering leadership and key stakeholders.

  • Technical Leadership & Knowledge Sharing
    • Provide technical guidance to junior engineers and team members during validation and debug activities.
    • Contribute to best practices, validation methodologies, and technical documentation across the organization.
    • Share lessons learned and help drive technical excellence within the validation team.

PREFERRED EXPERIENCE:

  • Experience in post-silicon validation, electrical characterization, hardware development, or system-level debug.
  • Knowledge of high-speed interfaces and protocols such as PCIe, Ethernet, DDR, LPDDR, or related technologies.
  • Experience using high-speed measurement and debug equipment including oscilloscopes, TDRs, VNAs, protocol analyzers, or equivalent tools.
  • Familiarity with scripting or programming languages such as Python, C/C++, Perl, or similar.
  • Strong analytical, debugging, and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills in a global engineering environment.
  • Experience with server, datacenter, or AI product validation.
  • Knowledge of JEDEC memory standards, PCIe compliance testing, signal integrity, and PHY characterization.
  • Experience with Linux and Windows Server environments.
    Familiarity with validation automation frameworks and large-scale regression systems.
  • Experience working with Jira, Confluence, SharePoint, or similar engineering collaboration tools.

ACADEMIC CREDENTIALS:

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related technical discipline.

Penang, Malaysia

title: Business Analyst
description:
Job Purpose

The Business Analyst, Corporate Development is a skills-based analytical role suited to someone who can combine financial acumen, business curiosity, strong data skills, and clear communication to support corporate development priorities. Reporting to the Senior Manager, Corporate Development, this role helps turn business questions into structured analysis, meaningful insights, and practical recommendations that support growth, operational improvement, and strategic decision-making.

The successful candidate will bring strong numerical reasoning, critical thinking, attention to detail, cross-functional collaboration, problem-solving, and presentation skills. They will be comfortable working with incomplete information, asking thoughtful questions, validating assumptions, and translating analysis into clear conclusions for leaders and cross-functional partners.

This role requires someone who is highly proficient with Excel, financial modelling, Power BI, and PowerPoint; confident working with operational, supply, logistics, inventory, pricing, customer, and financial data; and able to create dashboards, summaries, trackers, business cases, and executive-ready materials that make complex information easy to understand.

Duties and Responsibilities

Core Analytical Skills:

  • Apply strong analytical thinking to interpret financial, operational, market, and performance data and identify trends, risks, gaps, and opportunities.
  • Use advanced Excel and financial modelling skills to build, maintain, and improve analysis tools, business case models, trackers, scorecards, variance summaries, scenario models, sensitivity models, and decision-support templates.
  • Develop Power BI dashboards and reporting views that connect data to business priorities, including supply performance, demand trends, margin visibility, project tracking, and leadership decision support.
  • Structure ambiguous business problems by clarifying objectives, assumptions, data requirements, constraints, options, and success measures.
  • Apply critical thinking and sound judgment to test assumptions, validate information, and connect analysis to practical business outcomes.

Financial & Business Acumen:

  • Demonstrate understanding of key business drivers, including revenue, margin, cost, capital investment, productivity, utilization, customer trends, supply reliability, inventory management, logistics efficiency, and operational performance.
  • Support business case development by organizing inputs, quantifying benefits, identifying risks, assessing trade-offs, and summarizing financial and operational implications.
  • Conduct ROI, cost-benefit, scenario, sensitivity, and variance analysis to support investment, optimization, and strategic planning decisions.
  • Analyze supply-related factors for an emulsion and bitumen supplier, including product availability, demand patterns, supply chain constraints, transportation impacts, terminal/site performance, inventory levels, and customer service implications.
  • Interpret data in context and explain what the information means for business performance, supply reliability, decision-making, and value creation.
  • Assist in the identification, financial evaluation, and execution of potential M&A and strategic investment opportunities including financial modeling and preliminary valuation work

Research, Due Diligence & Market Intelligence:

  • Gather, organize, and assess internal and external information to support market reviews, product supply analysis, opportunity assessments, business optimization initiatives, and due diligence activities related to emulsion, bitumen, and adjacent supply markets.
  • Maintain organized documentation, research files, information request lists, issue logs, action trackers, and decision records.
  • Use strong attention to detail to validate source information, reconcile inconsistencies, and flag incomplete, inaccurate, or high-risk inputs.
  • Convert large volumes of information into concise summaries, key findings, options, and recommended next steps.

Communication, Presentation & Storytelling:

  • Create clear, concise, and visually organized presentations, dashboards, briefing notes, and executive summaries using PowerPoint, Excel, and other reporting tools.
  • Translate technical, financial, and operational analysis into plain-language messages that explain the business issue, key facts, implications, options, and recommended action.
  • Use strong written and verbal communication skills to support leadership discussions, project updates, investment reviews, and cross-functional working sessions.
  • Present insights in a way that is practical, accurate, outcome-focused, and easy for financial and non-financial audiences to act on.

Collaboration, Initiative & Follow-Through:

  • Work effectively with Finance, Operations, Legal, HR, Procurement, Engineering and other stakeholders to collect inputs, validate assumptions, and reflect operational realities in analysis.
  • Ask thoughtful questions, challenge assumptions appropriately, and build credibility through accuracy, responsiveness, and preparation.
  • Manage multiple priorities, timelines, action items, and follow-ups while maintaining quality and attention to detail.
  • Take initiative to improve reporting tools, simplify processes, identify better ways of working, and support disciplined execution of corporate development priorities.

Qualifications

Required skills and experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Business, Economics, Accounting, Data Analytics, Engineering, or a related field. Progressing towards and or completion of of CPA, CFA, CBV preferred
  • 3–5 years of experience in business analysis, financial analysis, corporate development, strategy, operations analysis, consulting, project analysis, or a similar role requiring strong analytical and communication skills.
  • Advanced Excel and modelling skills, including data organization, formulas, lookups, pivot tables, driver-based modelling, scenario analysis, sensitivity analysis, business case modelling, and clear presentation of results.
  • Strong PowerPoint skills with the ability to create polished, concise, executive-ready presentations and briefing materials.
  • Strong numerical reasoning, data interpretation, business writing, problem-solving, and critical thinking skills.
  • Ability to work with ambiguity, organize complex information, ask good questions, validate assumptions, and identify practical options.
  • Experience preparing dashboards, KPI reports, business cases, financial or operational analysis, supply analysis, project trackers, or management reporting packages.
  • Strong Power BI skills are preferred, including experience building dashboards, data models, report views, and visual summaries; experience with ERP systems, JD Edwards, market research, due diligence, supply chain analysis, or continuous improvement initiatives is considered an asset.
  • Professional maturity, discretion with confidential information, strong stakeholder service orientation, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Ability to work under pressure and meet tight deadlines.

Why Join Us?

At McAsphalt, you will be part of a Canadian industry leader with a strong national footprint, a long-standing commitment to operational excellence, and a culture that values safety, quality, teamwork, practical innovation, and customer service. This role offers the opportunity to lead a meaningful regional operations portfolio, influence business performance, develop operational leaders, and help ensure our facilities continue to deliver reliable products, responsive service, and continuous improvement across the region.

Our purpose is to welcome the world to better places. We’re people first and entrepreneurial, with a strong service ethos.

Why join us? We’ve made it our business to understand how people want to live and work today, tomorrow and beyond and as you’d expect, we practise what we preach in our own workplace as well. We’re known for our supportive, inclusive, and flexible work culture. With recognition from the Workplace Gender Equality Agency, the Australian Workplace Equality Index, and multiple awards for workplace flexibility, our people and the way we work together are our difference.

We’re looking for a motivated and experienced Workplace Technology & Service Delivery Lead to join our Technology & Transformation team. This is a hands-on role where you’ll own the technology our people use every day and the quality of service they receive when they need support. You'll play a key role in keeping Investa's workplace technology at a high standard, driving the reliability, performance and security of the devices and spaces our people use every day, and continually improving how we deliver that service.

Your key responsibilities:

  • Own Investa’s workplace technology experience end-to-end, including devices, meeting rooms, audio-visual technology, telephony and Microsoft 365 productivity platforms.

  • Lead the service desk and service management practice, driving a shift from reactive ticket handling to a proactive, managed service with clear service levels, processes and reporting.

  • Drive continuous improvement, automation and problem management across the service desk and end-user technology environment, using data to measure and demonstrate improvements.

  • 7+ years’ experience across end-user/workplace technology and IT service delivery, including at least 3 years with accountability for a service desk or workplace technology function.

  • Lifestyle: We offer generous parental leave, return to work program, and summer hours

  • Inclusive Culture: A safe, welcoming environment for all, including individuals from Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander communities, the LGBTQ+ community, and those who are neurodivergent

  • Flexibility: We do our best to support you to be able to do the things that are important to you. We offer over 21 formal flexible work options, plus a truly supportive approach to balancing work with life’s priorities

  • Health and Wellness: Discounted health insurance, free health and wellbeing services, discounted fitness classes, reproductive health benefits

title: Test Data Engineer – Automation & Synthetic Data
description:
Salary: $85 – $100 per hour

Test Data Engineer – Automation & Synthetic Data

Brisbane CBD | Hybrid – 2–3 days onsite
9-month contract | Full-time

We’re looking for an experienced Test Data Engineer to join a significant technology program and take ownership of building a reliable, automated test data capability across complex legacy environments.

This is a hands-on role focused on synthetic test data, data masking and automated environment reset. You’ll be working with a long-standing, heavily interconnected PostgreSQL database and helping establish a sustainable approach that removes the reliance on production data within non-production environments.

A key focus in the first month will be proving that realistic synthetic data can be generated and environments can be reset reliably before the solution is scaled.

What you’ll be doing

  • Design and build a synthetic test data capability for automated testing and training environments.

  • Work with internal SMEs to understand a complex, highly interconnected PostgreSQL schema.

  • Build the capability to generate and reset test and training data on demand.

  • Develop appropriate data masking and de-identification approaches to remove production data from lower environments.

  • Automate database and environment refresh/reset processes, reducing manual intervention.

  • Work closely with security, legal and technical stakeholders to ensure the solution meets privacy and data integrity requirements.

  • Collaborate with the managed service provider responsible for the environments.

  • Document the solution and provide a clear handover to the internal team.

What we’re looking for

You’ll ideally have demonstrated experience:

  • Building test data capabilities for systems with complex relational databases.

  • Working extensively with PostgreSQL in a production or enterprise environment.

  • Implementing data masking, de-identification or privacy controls where regulatory or security requirements matter.

  • Automating database/environment refresh and reset processes.

  • Working independently to assess a problem, prove an approach and then build it into a repeatable capability.

  • Communicating effectively across engineering, infrastructure, security and business stakeholders.

Experience with AWS/RDS, synthetic data generation tooling, outsourced infrastructure providers, or highly regulated/data-sensitive environments such as government, banking, insurance or health would be highly regarded.

This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys solving complex data problems and wants to build a capability from the ground up rather than simply maintain an existing process.

Interested? Apply now or reach out directly for a confidential discussion.

title: Python & AI Developers
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Python & AI Developer based in India.

We are seeking a versatile Python and AI developer to build reliable, scalable software that powers modern AI applications and backend services. You will work across backend engineering, AI model integration, data processing, and cloud deployment. The role involves turning experimental models and complex algorithms into robust, production-ready systems capable of operating reliably at scale. You will collaborate closely with data scientists and machine learning engineers to bring AI capabilities into real-world applications. You will have the opportunity to work with modern Python frameworks, automated testing, containerization, and cloud technologies. This is a hands-on engineering role suited to developers who enjoy combining strong software fundamentals with practical AI development.

Accountabilities:

  • Design, develop, and maintain robust backend services, APIs, microservices, and asynchronous task workers using Python and frameworks such as FastAPI, Django, or Flask.
  • Build scalable RESTful services and backend components capable of supporting high-volume AI applications and workloads.
  • Develop optimized model-serving layers for machine learning models and Large Language Models, with a focus on inference performance, reliability, and low latency.
  • Integrate third-party AI services, machine learning models, and intelligent application components into production software systems.
  • Design and maintain reliable ETL and data-processing pipelines for structured and unstructured data used by AI and machine learning applications.
  • Use libraries such as Pandas and NumPy to support data transformation, processing, and preparation workflows.
  • Write comprehensive automated tests using tools such as pytest and maintain strong standards for code quality, documentation, maintainability, and reliability.
  • Participate in code reviews and contribute to engineering standards, reusable components, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Containerize applications using Docker and support deployments across cloud environments through CI/CD pipelines.
  • Monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize applications to improve scalability, stability, performance, and operational efficiency.
  • Collaborate with data scientists, machine learning engineers, and other software developers to translate AI concepts and prototypes into production-ready solutions.

    • Requirements:

    • 3–6 years of professional software development experience, with advanced proficiency in Python and strong knowledge of software engineering principles.
    • Hands-on experience building backend applications, RESTful APIs, microservices, or asynchronous services using Python.
    • Practical experience with modern Python frameworks such as FastAPI, Django, or Flask.
    • Strong understanding of JSON, API design, relational databases, and/or NoSQL databases.
    • Experience integrating machine learning models, LLMs, third-party AI APIs, or other AI-enabled technologies into software applications.
    • Familiarity with data-processing and scientific Python libraries, particularly Pandas and NumPy.
    • Experience developing automated tests using pytest or comparable testing frameworks.
    • Working knowledge of Docker, Git, Linux environments, and fundamental cloud infrastructure concepts.
    • Understanding of CI/CD principles and experience supporting automated build, testing, and deployment workflows.
    • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with an ability to debug complex software and AI-related issues.
    • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively alongside data scientists, ML engineers, and software engineering teams.
    • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, Artificial Intelligence, or a related technical field.

      • Benefits:

      • Annual compensation of approximately INR 2,000,000–3,200,000 CTC, depending on experience and skills.
      • Full-time, mid-to-senior-level employment opportunity.
      • Remote-friendly working model with flexibility across India.
      • Location options including Bangalore, Pune, hybrid, or remote across India.
      • Opportunity to work at the intersection of software engineering and artificial intelligence.
      • Hands-on exposure to Python, modern backend frameworks, AI/ML model serving, data pipelines, Docker, CI/CD, and cloud technologies.
      • Opportunity to collaborate with experienced data scientists, machine learning engineers, and software developers.
      • Exposure to production-scale AI applications and technically challenging engineering projects.
      • Environment focused on clean code, engineering quality, automation, scalability, and continuous technical improvement.

title: HR Assistant
description:

Apply today!

  • Employee programs and events.

Job Summary


The Human Resources Generalist will run the daily administrative functions of the Human Resources (HR) department including maintenance of the HRIS, benefits administration, staff onboarding and projects as assigned.


Essential Functions

  • Assists employees with benefits enrollment, plan changes, and qualifying life event documentation; escalates complex questions to the HR Business Partner or benefits broker as needed.

  • Prepares and distributes benefits communications, open enrollment materials, and new hire benefits guides; supports COBRA notifications and tracks required timelines in coordination with the third-party administrator.
  • Assists with annual open enrollment logistics, including scheduling benefits meetings, preparing enrollment packets, and tracking employee completion.
  • Maintains benefits files and documentation in compliance with ERISA, HIPAA, and applicable record-retention requirements.
  • Maintains and audits I-9 documentation for all new hires using E-Verify, ensuring completion within required timeframes.
  • Supports HR compliance reporting requirements, including EEO-1, OSHA logs, and Joint Commission (TJC) documentation requests, as assigned.

  • Maintains confidentiality of employee records in accordance with HIPAA and applicable state and federal recordkeeping regulations.
  • Assists with unemployment claims and verification requests, routing to the appropriate HR staff or third-party administrator as needed.
  • Supports internal and external HR audits by pulling, organizing, and submitting requested documentation.
  • Uploads, scans, and files new hire paperwork, badges, personnel change forms, and other supporting documents into employee records within Paylocity, ensuring accuracy and completeness.

  • Runs standard reports from Paylocity (e.g., headcount, terminations) for HR staff and department directors as requested.
  • Coordinates new hire onboarding logistics, including scheduling, tracking outstanding pre-employment items, and preparing orientation materials.
  • Assists with facilitation of New Hire Orientation, trainings and completes required onboarding documentation.
  • Completes employment and income verification requests for current and former employees.
  • Provides front-line customer service to visitors and employees in the Human Resources office; answers and directs calls on the main HR line.
  • Assists with employee badge requests and issues.
  • Prepares ad hoc reports and correspondence for HR staff and department leadership as requested; maintains office supplies, department calendars, and general office organization.
  • Other duties as assigned.


Behavioral Standard

Treats everyone as their customer; utilizes scripting and other tools to ensure consistency in customer service; Expresses recognition and shows appreciation to others; fully utilizes AIDET principles; responds quickly to handle requests, complaints and questions; displays a positive attitude.

Communication/Knowledge

  • Wears nametag properly; follows dress code policy; answers phone correctly and promptly; is prepared for meetings; meets deadlines; does not participate in gossip; acts ethically and treats others with respect; respects customer’s and co-worker’s time; establishes and maintains effective relationships with customers and co-workers.

Collaboration/Teamwork

title: Site Activation Partner I - FSP
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Site Activation Partner I - FSP based in Brazil.

This role offers an opportunity to support clinical research studies from site start-up through study close-out, ensuring activities are completed accurately, efficiently, and in compliance with applicable requirements. You’ll work closely with investigator sites, study teams, regulatory stakeholders, and other partners to facilitate successful site activation and ongoing study operations. A key focus will be managing essential documentation, regulatory submissions, ethics processes, and site readiness activities within required timelines. You’ll also help maintain high-quality trial records and support sites throughout the study lifecycle. The position combines independent ownership with close collaboration across international clinical research teams. It is particularly suited to professionals with strong site activation experience and knowledge of US/Canada clinical trial requirements.

Accountabilities:

  • Lead or support clinical trial site activation activities, coordinating essential documents and start-up requirements to compile high-quality Investigator Initiation Packages and achieve site initiation readiness within established timelines.
  • Work directly with investigator sites to confirm readiness, reviewing site profiles and critical information related to essential documents, contracts, clinical supplies, payments, ethics submissions, and other activation requirements.
  • Prepare, validate, submit, and track regulatory and ethics documentation, including Investigator Initiation Packages, IRB materials, FDA 1572/Attestation Forms, amendments, and other country-specific submissions and approvals.
  • Coordinate with investigator sites, study teams, ethics committees, regulatory stakeholders, and supporting functions to resolve issues, manage escalations, and keep activation activities progressing according to plan.
  • Support Central and Local Ethics Committee workflows, including preparation, submission, approval tracking, communication, and dissemination of relevant approvals to study teams and investigator sites.
  • Maintain accurate and inspection-ready information across clinical trial systems and platforms, including site registries, CTMS, eTMF, eISF, shared investigator platforms, document exchange portals, and applicable ethics or regulatory systems.
  • Support study conduct after site activation by coordinating documentation updates, protocol amendments, annual ethics approvals, regulatory revisions, and other activities required throughout the study lifecycle.
  • Ensure timely filing and quality of clinical trial documentation, assist with periodic file reviews, and support investigator sites and study teams in preparing for audits and inspections.
  • Maintain proactive communication with study teams and investigator sites, providing updates on site status, approvals, delays, issues, and required actions.
  • Identify and resolve site-level issues within required timelines, collaborating with study teams and country colleagues on corrective and preventive actions where appropriate.
  • Support site personnel through awareness sessions and guidance on study documentation, applicable regulations, Good Clinical Practice, and operational requirements.
  • Contribute to process improvements and broader initiatives, with opportunities to serve as a study point of contact, subject matter expert, mentor, or representative on global projects.

    • Requirements:

    • At least 3 years of relevant experience in clinical site management, with hands-on experience supporting clinical trials involving the US/Canada.
    • Previous experience in the pharmaceutical industry or a CRO, particularly in clinical trial site activation or study start-up, is preferred.
    • Strong knowledge of clinical trial methodologies, ICH/GCP principles, FDA requirements, and applicable global and local country regulations.
    • Diploma or equivalent combination of education, training, and experience required; a Bachelor’s degree in Life Sciences or a related discipline is preferred.
    • Strong understanding of clinical research and development processes and the key operational elements of clinical trials.
    • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with investigator sites, study teams, colleagues, and external stakeholders.
    • Strong technical skills and the ability to learn and independently use multiple clinical research systems and platforms, including CTMS, eTMF, eISF, document portals, and investigator platforms.
    • High attention to detail and a disciplined, quality-focused approach, with a strong commitment to compliance and right-first-time execution.
    • Ability to work independently while also contributing effectively within international, cross-functional teams.
    • Strong organizational and prioritization skills, with the ability to manage multiple activities, deadlines, sites, and competing priorities.
    • Working knowledge of basic medical terminology, GCP requirements, and standard computer applications, including Microsoft Office.
    • Fluency in English and the local language is required; additional language capabilities are an advantage.
    • Willingness and ability to learn site activation requirements and processes across multiple countries or regions as business needs evolve.

      • Benefits:

      • 7-month temporary assignment with potential transition to a full-time role.
      • Remote work opportunity based in Brazil.
      • Opportunity to contribute to clinical research programs that support the development of new therapies and healthcare solutions.
      • Exposure to international clinical trials and collaboration with investigator sites, study teams, regulatory stakeholders, and cross-functional partners.
      • Opportunity to develop expertise across site activation, clinical trial operations, regulatory documentation, ethics processes, and clinical research systems.
      • Potential opportunities to contribute as a subject matter expert, study point of contact, mentor, or participant in global initiatives.
      • Work within a structured clinical research environment emphasizing quality, compliance, collaboration, and continuous learning.

About the Role

Osmo's QC function is being built from the ground up, and this seat is where day-to-day quality judgment lives. You'll run testing and sampling on raw materials coming in and finished fragrance going out, using real fragrance-industry judgment that automated testing alone can't provide. You'll have the standing to make real-time accept/reject calls independently, and the experience to step in and cover QC decisions when the QC Manager is out.

What You'll Do:

  • Judge incoming raw material results from automated testing, deciding when an out-of-spec reading is a real defect versus normal variation in a natural material

  • Apply trained olfactive judgment to evaluate raw materials and finished goods using sensory skill the equipment can't replicate

  • Run triangulation testing on outgoing product to confirm it matches prior batches before it reaches a customer

  • Make accept/reject calls in real time, multiple times a day, escalating only genuinely ambiguous cases to the QC Manager

  • Step in and cover QC sign-off when the QC Manager is unavailable, keeping finished-goods flow moving rather than stalling

  • Maintain and run lab instrumentation (GC/MS, photosampler, flash point testing, colorimeters), including calibration checks and upkeep

  • Maintain audit-ready lab records: test logs, certificates of analysis, and equipment records

  • Mentor QC Tech staff on fragrance-specific testing and olfactive judgment

  • Partner across the floor with Purchasing, Warehouse, Shipping/Receiving, and Fragrance Development on sample flow and testing turnaround

Who You Are:

  • Fragrance industry experience or exposure required — adjacent industries (coffee, beer, wine, alcohol roasting, flavor, cosmetics, specialty chemicals) don't clear the bar

  • Comfortable making high-frequency accept/reject calls independently, without over-escalating routine judgment

  • Trained nose — sensory and olfactive evaluation skill specific to fragrance raw materials and finished goods

  • Strong hands-on experience with lab instrumentation; GC/GCMS familiarity is a plus, not a requirement

  • Strong documentation habits

  • Comfortable stepping into a QC decision-making role in the Manager's absence

  • Technical degree preferred (Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, or related); equivalent hands-on fragrance-industry lab experience accepted in place of a degree

  • On-site in Elizabeth, NJ, 5 days a week

What We Offer:

  • Real Growth Path — A senior technician track with real, independent QC decision-making authority, inside a quality function being built from the ground up

  • Catered Lunch — Mon/Wed/Fri; Newark, NJ and Brooklyn shuttles

  • 401(k) savings plan and employer match

  • Competitive salary and meaningful equity in a high-growth company

  • Flexible PTO and paid family leave

description:

We're looking for a Product Manager to own Data Provisioning Standards (DPS) — the rules, schemas, contracts, and governance processes that determine how data enters, moves through, and gets consumed across our platform. This is a foundational, cross-cutting role: you won't own a single user-facing feature, you'll own the standards that every data producer and consumer downstream depends on to trust the data they're working with.

[What you will be working on]

This role sits at the intersection of product, data engineering, and governance. You see policy as a product — DPS is a government mandate, but mandates don't implement themselves.

You'll work closely with Policy stakeholders to shape & operationalise standards, Data Providing Agencies (DPAs) to implement DPS, GovTech's engineering team to build toolings & systems, and Data Consuming Agencies (DCAs) to ensure the data reaching them is consistent, well-documented, and trustworthy for their operations and service delivery.


If you've worked on data contracts, schema governance, API standards, data quality/observability tooling, or consent-and-compliance-driven data exchange, this role will feel familiar.


What You'll Do

  • Define and own what good data provisioning looks like across WOG — spanning Data Quality, Data Delivery Performance and Data Interfacing Standards — and iterate those standards in close collaboration with policy stakeholders, ensuring they remain grounded in what agencies can realistically implement as the ecosystem matures.

  • Design and own the agency support packages for DPS implementation — matching the right level of guidance, tooling, and support to each agency's technical maturity so that compliance is achievable for every agency regardless of where they start.

  • Work with data engineering team to translate standards into tooling that data providers can actually use — spanning data quality validation, metrics computation, pipeline integration, and centralised monitoring.

  • Own the roadmap for data quality and provisioning tooling, prioritizing against data provider pain points through requirements-gathering sessions, downstream consumer needs, and adoption risk (e.g., silent schema drift, incomplete metadata, inconsistent semantics across providers).

  • Define and track success metrics for provisioning health: onboarding time, data quality incident rate, schema compliance rate, time-to-detect for drift/anomalies.

  • Write and maintain clear, versioned documentation of every standard — the standard itself, the rationale, migration guidance for changes, and worked examples.

  • Where standards intersect with regulatory or consent requirements, work with legal/compliance to ensure provisioning rules satisfy consent, data minimization, and audit requirements.

  • Represent the provisioning standards function in cross-team and (where relevant) external/industry forums.

[What we are looking for]

  • 4+ years of product management experience, with meaningful time spent on a data platform, data infrastructure, API platform, or developer-facing product

  • Demonstrated experience defining standards, contracts, or schemas that other teams had to adopt — and successfully driving that adoption across teams you didn't manage.

  • Strong technical fluency with data concepts: schemas, APIs, data contracts, ETL/ELT pipelines, data quality dimensions (completeness, timeliness, accuracy). You don't need to write production code, but you need to be credible in a room with data engineers.

  • A track record of balancing governance rigor against provider/developer experience — you know that a standard nobody can practically comply with is worse than no standard at all. So you'll be as invested in the tooling, templates, and any support that make compliance achievable by data providing agencies.

  • Excellent written communication — this role lives and dies by documentation quality. Comfortable writing specs, migration guides, and decision records that other teams will follow without you in the room.

  • Strong stakeholder management skills: you'll be negotiating with data provider teams who don't report to you and don't always want to change how they work.

  • Comfortable operating with ambiguity in a space that's still maturing — you'll be building some of these standards from scratch, not just maintaining existing ones.

Nice to have:

  • Experience with data quality/observability tooling (e.g., Monte Carlo, Validio, Great Expectations, or an in-house equivalent).

  • Background in a regulated or consent-driven data-sharing environment (open banking, health data exchange, gov data platforms, or similar).

  • Experience with data contracts, schema governance frameworks (ODCS, OpenAPI, JSON Schema, Avro/Protobuf), and contract testing tools like Pact.

  • Prior experience in an environment where data provenance and auditability are first-class concerns.

What we offer you:

GovTech is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive workplace that values diverse voices and perspectives, as we believe that diversity is the foundation to innovation.

Our employee benefits are based on a total rewards approach, offering a holistic and market-competitive suite of perks. These include leave benefits to meet your work-life needs and employee wellness programs.

We champion flexible work arrangements (subject to your job role) and trust that you will manage your own time to deliver your best, wherever you are, and whatever works best for you.

Partnering with the Cloud Architect, you'll oversee the security and performance of cloud, network and server environments while providing expert Level 3 support and driving continuous improvement across our technology landscape.

What you'll do

  • Support the design, implementation, and ongoing maintenance of secure infrastructure across on premises and cloud environments.
  • Manage and enhance cyber security controls, ensuring the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of organisational systems and data.
  • Monitor, investigate, and respond to security incidents, vulnerabilities, and infrastructure issues, providing timely resolution and remediation.
  • Act as a Level 3 escalation point for complex infrastructure and cyber security issues, supporting our Service Desk and wider IT team.
  • Design, deploy, and maintain network, server, cloud, telephony and voice solutions to support business operations.
  • Contribute to disaster recovery, business continuity, and infrastructure resilience initiatives to minimise service disruption.
  • Develop and maintain technical documentation, operational procedures, infrastructure diagrams and security related processes.
  • Partner with vendors, stakeholders and internal teams to deliver technology improvements and projects that align with business objectives.

What you'll bring

  • 5+ years' experience in infrastructure, systems administration or advanced technical support roles.
  • Strong knowledge of cyber security principles, technologies and best practices.
  • Experience managing enterprise infrastructure, including networks, servers, cloud services and security platforms.
  • Hands on experience with Microsoft Azure, Microsoft 365, Windows Server and Linux environments.
  • Strong troubleshooting, problem solving, and incident management capabilities.
  • Experience with technologies such as VMware, Fortinet, Cisco, Ubiquiti, Veeam and VoIP solutions.

title: L3 IT Support Engineer (MSP)
location: Davao City, Davao del Sur, Philippines
description:
About Sharesource:

We are a BCorp company whose purpose is to democratise opportunities for individuals from developing countries. With our brand and culture empowering our partners to attract and keep the most qualified members, we share the knowledge to unleash potential and grow scaling teams for Australian and Canadian businesses.

What are we looking for?

We are seeking a Level 2 Technical Support Engineer to join the Modern Workplace team. This role combines escalated technical support, customer environment ownership, and practical Microsoft 365 service improvement across endpoint, identity, security, collaboration, and cloud services.

You will act as a trusted technical owner for assigned customer environments, keeping tickets moving, providing clear customer updates, identifying recurring issues, supporting small changes and project tasks, and knowing when to escalate with the right diagnostics and context.

While Level 3 engineers and technical leads provide architecture and complex escalation support, this role is expected to take day-to-day ownership, work with minimal supervision on standard troubleshooting, and help turn customer needs into practical service improvements.

Here, flexibility isn't just a perk—its how we help you perform at your best, without sacrificing life outside of work.

title: Analista de Riscos Financeiros Pleno (Mercado e Liquidez)
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Analista de Riscos Financeiros Pleno (Mercado e Liquidez) based in Brazil.

This role offers the opportunity to work at the intersection of financial risk management, data analysis, and regulatory requirements. You will monitor and analyze market and liquidity risk indicators, contributing directly to the robustness of risk management practices. The position combines technical analysis with the development and continuous improvement of methodologies, controls, processes, and automation. You will work with metrics such as VaR, IRRBB, DV01, liquidity gaps, and stress scenarios. The role also involves preparing management and regulatory reports and materials for senior leadership and regulatory authorities. It is an environment that values collaboration, continuous learning, innovation, data quality, and sound decision-making.

Accountabilities:

  • Monitor and analyze regulatory and management indicators related to liquidity risk and market risk, identifying relevant movements, trends, and potential impacts.
  • Structure, validate, and continuously improve processes for calculating regulatory liquidity and market risk indicators.
  • Develop, review, and enhance risk methodologies, assumptions, metrics, controls, and processes.
  • Analyze liquidity and market risk results, identifying the main drivers of significant variations and assessing their potential impacts.
  • Monitor market risk metrics, including interest-rate exposure, maturity mismatches, sensitivity measures, IRRBB, VaR, and stress scenarios.
  • Ensure the quality, consistency, robustness, and integrity of data used in liquidity and market risk processes and methodologies.
  • Prepare management and regulatory reports, as well as materials for committees, senior leadership, and the Central Bank of Brazil (BACEN).
  • Support the development and review of risk policies, standards, manuals, procedures, and internal controls.
  • Identify and implement opportunities to improve methodologies, controls, processes, and automation of recurring activities.
  • Support the execution and analysis of liquidity and market risk stress tests.

    • Requirements

    • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related field.
    • Professional experience in liquidity risk and/or market risk analysis.
    • Practical knowledge of programming or data-analysis tools such as Python, VBA, or SQL.
    • Knowledge of liquidity risk metrics and concepts, including cash flow, run-off, minimum cash requirements, funding stability, and liquidity gaps.
    • Knowledge of market risk metrics and methodologies, including VaR, IRRBB, DV01, and maturity mismatches.
    • Knowledge of Brazilian regulations and regulatory requirements applicable to liquidity and market risk management.
    • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret risk indicators, investigate variations, and translate analysis into actionable insights.
    • Attention to detail and a strong commitment to data quality, methodological consistency, and process integrity.
    • Ability to communicate technical information clearly and prepare materials for management, committees, and regulatory stakeholders.

NaphCare is hiring a Mental Health Clerk, to join our team of medical professionals in the Bullock Correctional Facility in Union Springs, AL.

title: Software Engineer
description:
Kia mahi ngātahi mō Pōneke mō tōna āpōpō | Working together for Wellington’s future

Wellington City Council is here to create a city where people want to live, work and play. Our Customer and Community Group brings together the services that help make Wellington a well-connected, engaged and thriving city.

Our Digital and Technology team helps bring this to life through smart technology, digital innovation and connected information systems. From the platforms our people rely on every day to the digital services our communities use, our technology supports the delivery of essential services across Wellington.

We’re looking for a Software Engineer to join our Enterprise Applications team and help develop, enhance and maintain the applications and digital services that support our people, our organisation and our city.

This is a hands-on software development role where you’ll work across the development lifecycle, from understanding requirements and designing solutions through to testing, deployment and ongoing improvement. You’ll work closely with other engineers, technical leads, testers, business analysts, project teams and business owners to build practical, reliable and well-tested solutions.

You’ll also have the opportunity to contribute to how we develop software, including the use of AI-assisted development practices, modern tooling and continuous improvement across our development workflows.

Ko wai tātou | The role

  • Design, develop, test and maintain applications and digital services used by Council staff and the public.
  • Take ownership of components of solutions and ensure they are reliable, maintainable and fit for purpose.
  • Work with technical and business stakeholders to understand requirements and turn them into practical software solutions.
  • Contribute across the software development lifecycle, including planning, estimation, coding, testing, code reviews and release.
  • Help improve development practices, tools and ways of working across Digital and Technology.
  • Use AI-assisted development practices and modern tooling to improve code quality, testing and delivery.
  • Troubleshoot, debug and optimise existing applications and contribute to their continuous improvement.
  • Work with APIs, databases, integrations and cloud services to deliver connected solutions.
  • Communicate progress, risks, dependencies and technical considerations clearly with project teams and business owners.
  • Provide guidance and support to Junior Software Engineers through coaching, peer learning and mentoring.
  • Make pragmatic technical decisions, balancing user needs, quality and delivery without unnecessarily over-complicating solutions.

Ko wai koe | About you

You’ll bring strong professional software development experience and a practical approach to building and improving technology that people rely on.

You’ll have:

  • A degree in Computer Science or a related discipline, or equivalent education and practical experience.
  • At least 7 years’ professional experience as a software developer.
  • Strong experience web technologies such as TypeScript, JavaScript, React, Node.js. Also experience in .NET is preferred.
  • Strong knowledge of modern software development practices, including CI/CD, GitHub and developer tooling.
  • Experience using AI within the software development lifecycle, including AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot.
  • Strong understanding of databases (SQL and NO SQL), APIs and system integration.
  • Experience taking technical work from initial requirements through to software being delivered to users.
  • Experience working within an Agile software development environment.
  • A strong focus on clean, maintainable, efficient and well-tested code.
  • Experience troubleshooting and improving existing systems and applications.
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms and services, with exposure to infrastructure-as-code tools such as Pulumi, or Terraform, being useful.
  • The ability to explain technical concepts clearly to people with different levels of technical understanding.
  • A collaborative approach and the ability to build effective relationships with developers, technical leads, testers, business analysts and business stakeholders.
  • A commitment to continuous learning and keeping your technical skills current.

Nōu te rourou | What's in it for you

Working for the Council offers you a range of benefits including 5 weeks annual leave, flexible working options, health and wellbeing support, Council staff discounts and a range of learning and development programmes and opportunities.

View our Employee Value Proposition Video to see what our employees say about working at WCC.

Applications close Sunday 4 October 2026. All applications must be submitted online. Due to a number of organisational structural changes, our commitment to impacted Kaimahi is that they will be considered first for this advertised position. If no impacted Kaimahi apply other applications will be considered.

All applicants must have the right to work in New Zealand and be prepared to undergo a Ministry of Justice pre-employment check.

Diversity: We want your application to enable you to portray the real you. Skills are gained across many areas of our life, not just formal employment. title: Senior QC Technician, Fragrance Manufacturing
description:
Who we are at Osmo:

Osmo is a digital olfaction company, on a mission to give computers a sense of smell to improve the health and wellbeing of human life. Why? Our sense of smell both enriches and saves lives, and has a deep and direct connection to our emotions and memory.

Olfactory Intelligence has applications across industries including fragrance, manufacturing, security, medicine, and more. We believe in the power of automation and thoughtfully applied AI/ML to solve problems beyond the reach of human intuition alone.

We're headquartered in Elizabeth, NJ, with an additional office in Somerville, MA. We provide complimentary shuttle service from Brooklyn and Newark, NJ.

About the Role

Osmo's QC function is being built from the ground up, and this seat is where day-to-day quality judgment lives. You'll run testing and sampling on raw materials coming in and finished fragrance going out, using real fragrance-industry judgment that automated testing alone can't provide. You'll have the standing to make real-time accept/reject calls independently, and the experience to step in and cover QC decisions when the QC Manager is out.

What You'll Do:

  • Judge incoming raw material results from automated testing, deciding when an out-of-spec reading is a real defect versus normal variation in a natural material

  • Apply trained olfactive judgment to evaluate raw materials and finished goods using sensory skill the equipment can't replicate

  • Run triangulation testing on outgoing product to confirm it matches prior batches before it reaches a customer

  • Make accept/reject calls in real time, multiple times a day, escalating only genuinely ambiguous cases to the QC Manager

  • Step in and cover QC sign-off when the QC Manager is unavailable, keeping finished-goods flow moving rather than stalling

  • Maintain and run lab instrumentation (GC/MS, photosampler, flash point testing, colorimeters), including calibration checks and upkeep

  • Maintain audit-ready lab records: test logs, certificates of analysis, and equipment records

  • Mentor QC Tech staff on fragrance-specific testing and olfactive judgment

  • Partner across the floor with Purchasing, Warehouse, Shipping/Receiving, and Fragrance Development on sample flow and testing turnaround

Who You Are:

  • Fragrance industry experience or exposure required — adjacent industries (coffee, beer, wine, alcohol roasting, flavor, cosmetics, specialty chemicals) don't clear the bar

  • Comfortable making high-frequency accept/reject calls independently, without over-escalating routine judgment

  • Trained nose — sensory and olfactive evaluation skill specific to fragrance raw materials and finished goods

  • Strong hands-on experience with lab instrumentation; GC/GCMS familiarity is a plus, not a requirement

  • Strong documentation habits

  • Comfortable stepping into a QC decision-making role in the Manager's absence

  • Technical degree preferred (Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, or related); equivalent hands-on fragrance-industry lab experience accepted in place of a degree

  • On-site in Elizabeth, NJ, 5 days a week

What We Offer:

  • Real Growth Path — A senior technician track with real, independent QC decision-making authority, inside a quality function being built from the ground up

  • Catered Lunch — Mon/Wed/Fri; Newark, NJ and Brooklyn shuttles

  • 401(k) savings plan and employer match

  • Competitive salary and meaningful equity in a high-growth company

  • Flexible PTO and paid family leave

  • Commuter benefits (pre-tax transit and parking)

If this role inspires you we’d encourage you to apply. We are committed to recruiting, developing, and retaining an incredible team optimized for a diversity of thought, background, and approaches.

For all Full-Time Employees, compensation is just one component of Osmo’s total rewards approach, which is designed to support the well-being, growth, and long-term success of our team members. Depending on the role, this may include base salary or contract-based pay, along with access to health, dental, and vision coverage; a 401(k) retirement savings plan with company match; flexible paid time off and company holidays; and equity or incentive compensation for eligible roles. Actual compensation will vary based on factors such as experience, skills, location, internal equity, and other relevant business considerations. Osmo regularly reviews pay ranges and compensation structures to ensure they remain competitive, equitable, and aligned with current market data.

All employment decisions and responsibilities are determined based on current ability and your ability to grow, without regard to race, color, gender identity, sex, sexual orientation, religion, age, marital status, physical, mental, or sensory disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

title: Senior AWS DevOps Engineer
description:

Salary - £65,000-£85,000


Description


Senior AWS DevOps Engineer


We help organisations design, build and operate secure, resilient cloud environments, with a strong focus on public sector and other complex, regulated environments.


We’re looking for an experienced Senior AWS DevOps Engineer to take a leading role in the design, build and delivery of cloud infrastructure and automation for our clients.

This is a hands-on senior engineering role, combining deep AWS and DevOps expertise with technical ownership, client engagement and the ability to guide other engineers and influence engineering practices.


The Role

As a Senior AWS DevOps Engineer, you’ll take technical ownership of cloud infrastructure, CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code and deployment automation across client engagements.

You’ll work closely with architects, engineers, security specialists and client teams to design and implement solutions that are secure, resilient, scalable and repeatable.

Alongside hands-on engineering, you’ll provide technical leadership, help establish engineering standards and practices, support less experienced engineers and contribute to key technical decisions throughout delivery.



What You’ll Do

• Lead the design, build and evolution of secure AWS cloud infrastructure and DevOps capabilities

• Design and maintain scalable, secure and automated CI/CD pipelines using GitLab or GitHub

• Own infrastructure-as-code approaches using Terraform, ensuring environments are repeatable, maintainable and compliant

• Define and promote engineering standards, patterns and best practices across delivery teams

• Embed automation across build, test, deployment and operational workflows

• Apply DevSecOps and security-by-design principles throughout the delivery lifecycle

• Design, deploy and operate containerised workloads using Kubernetes and AWS services such as ECS and EKS

• Work with architects and security specialists on cloud architecture, networking, identity, security and integration requirements

• Implement effective monitoring, observability, logging and alerting to support resilient services

• Provide technical leadership during complex troubleshooting and resolution of infrastructure and deployment issues

• Engage with clients and technical stakeholders to understand requirements, explain technical decisions and provide recommendations

• Mentor and support engineers, encouraging knowledge sharing and continuous improvement

• Identify opportunities to improve engineering practices, automation, reliability and delivery efficiency

What We’re Looking For

• Current SC clearance is highly desirable due to the nature and timescales of our client engagements. Candidates must be eligible to obtain and maintain SC clearance

• Significant hands-on experience designing, building and operating solutions within Amazon Web Services (AWS)

• Strong knowledge of AWS compute, networking, identity, security and container services

• Strong experience designing and managing CI/CD pipelines using GitLab or GitHub

• Demonstrable expertise with Terraform and infrastructure-as-code at scale

• Strong understanding of Kubernetes architecture and operating containerised workloads in cloud environments

• Good understanding of DevSecOps, OWASP principles and security-by-design

• Experience designing and implementing monitoring, logging and observability solutions

• Strong scripting skills using Python, Bash, PowerShell or similar

• Experience making technical design decisions and providing engineering leadership within multidisciplinary teams

• Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills across complex cloud environments

• Confidence working directly with clients and communicating technical concepts, decisions and recommendations

• Experience working within Agile delivery environments

• Experience supporting and mentoring other engineers

Desirable

• AWS Professional-level certification, such as AWS Certified DevOps Engineer – Professional or Solutions Architect – Professional

• Strong experience delivering solutions for public sector, defence or other regulated clients

• Experience working within secure environments and understanding the associated security and assurance requirements

• Experience contributing to technical designs, architecture decisions and engineering standards

title: Marketing Project Manager
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Marketing Project Manager based in Brazil.

You will coordinate specialists across content, creative, paid media, SEO, CRM, automation, website management, sales, and operations.
The role combines project management, production coordination, publishing, quality assurance, and reporting preparation.

  • Check links, forms, phone numbers, tracking parameters, formatting, mobile presentation, audiences, and calls to action.

    • Requirements

    • Demonstrated experience independently managing marketing campaigns or projects from planning through publication or completion.
    • Strong project-management and operational follow-through, with the ability to manage multiple workstreams, fixed deadlines, dependencies, and contributors simultaneously.
    • Hands-on experience with email, social media, websites, CMS platforms, CRM systems, or similar marketing publishing environments.
    • Practical understanding of campaign quality assurance, tracking requirements, approvals, and publication readiness.
    • Strong written communication and professional, assertive follow-up skills.
    • Ability to coordinate multiple contributors, deadlines, dependencies, and external partners without losing visibility of critical details.
    • Comfort working with spreadsheets and consolidating performance information from multiple sources.
    • Ability to identify incomplete, inconsistent, unsupported, or conflicting reporting information.
    • Sound judgment when determining which issues to resolve independently and which require escalation.
    • Strong attention to detail while maintaining awareness of deadlines, priorities, and business outcomes.
    • Ability to work effectively in a remote, fast-moving environment.
    • Experience with service businesses, multi-location organizations, or lead-generation marketing is preferred.
    • Familiarity with platforms such as GoHighLevel, WordPress, Shopify, Google Analytics, Google Ads, Meta, Microsoft Teams, SharePoint, or comparable tools is a plus.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Data Acquisition Engineer


EQL Global · Stockholm (Remote-friendly) · Full-time · Engineering

About EQL Global

EQL Global is a compliance-first equity data and AI workflow platform serving institutional buy-side and sell-side clients across the Nordics, the UK, and Europe. Our coverage spans 33,000+ listed companies across 89 countries, and our data infrastructure powers analyst workflows at firms that demand accuracy, freshness, and full auditability.

We are building the regulated data layer for institutional capital markets — and the foundation of that layer is the ability to acquire, parse, and structure vast volumes of public corporate disclosure at speed and at scale.


The Role

We're looking for a Data Acquisition Engineer to design and operate the systems that ingest public financial disclosures — regulatory filings, annual reports, prospectuses, exchange notices, and structured datasets — from thousands of sources worldwide.

This is a high-throughput, distributed-systems challenge. On any given run, our pipelines need to retrieve and process tens of thousands of documents in parallel without dropping data, tripping rate limits, or compromising integrity. If you've built resilient, large-scale data collection systems and you care about doing it cleanly and compliantly, we want to talk to you.


What You'll Do
  • Architect and maintain distributed data acquisition pipelines capable of retrieving and processing 10,000+ filings concurrently from public regulatory and exchange sources.
  • Build fault-tolerant extraction systems with robust retry logic, rate-limit handling, request orchestration, and proxy/session management.
  • Develop parsers that turn unstructured and semi-structured documents (HTML, PDF, XBRL, XML) into clean, validated, structured data.
  • Engineer monitoring, alerting, and data-quality checks so we catch gaps, schema drift, and source changes before our clients do.
  • Optimize throughput and cost across cloud infrastructure while keeping collection respectful of source-side constraints.
  • Work closely with our data and product teams to expand coverage across new markets and document types.


What We're Looking For
  • Strong Python engineering, with hands-on experience in frameworks such as Scrapy, Playwright, Selenium, requests/httpx, or equivalent.
  • Proven experience building large-scale, parallelized data collection systems — async programming (asyncio/aiohttp), concurrency, and queue-based architectures (Celery, Kafka, RabbitMQ, or similar).
  • Practical mastery of structured extraction: XPath, CSS selectors, regex, and parsing of PDF/HTML/XBRL/XML at scale.
  • Experience with rate-limit handling, proxy rotation, session management, and building resilient pipelines against unreliable or changing sources.
  • Comfort with cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP/Azure), containerization, and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes, Airflow, or similar).
  • A disciplined, compliance-aware approach to data collection — respecting source terms, public-data boundaries, and data-governance standards (GDPR, etc.).


Nice to Have
  • Familiarity with financial disclosure formats (XBRL/iXBRL, SEC EDGAR, ESEF, exchange filing systems).
  • Experience with data validation and observability tooling.
  • Background in fintech, financial data vendors, or capital markets.
  • Working knowledge of Swedish and/or other European languages.


Why EQL
  • Work on a genuinely hard, large-scale engineering problem at the core of the product.
  • Join an early-stage team where your architecture decisions have real, lasting impact.
  • Build infrastructure that institutional clients depend on every day.
  • Remote-friendly culture with a Stockholm base.

Morgan Consulting are partnering with a highly respected, data driven organisation regarded as an employer of choice in Melbourne. Due to significant investment in AI, Machine Learning and Advanced Analytics capabilities, they are seeking an experienced Staff AI Engineer to join their team in a newly created leadership position.

  • Design scalable AI powered applications and services leveraging modern cloud-native architectures.
  • Evaluate and implement technologies supporting Machine Learning operations, LLM orchestration and AI application development.
  • Ensure AI solutions align with enterprise architecture principles and long term platform strategy.
Machine Learning & Generative AI
  • Lead the design and implementation of enterprise scale AI and Machine Learning solutions.
  • Drive best practices for model development, deployment, monitoring and lifecycle management.
  • Oversee evaluation frameworks, observability strategies and performance optimisation for AI systems.
  • Guide teams building advanced AI applications including RAG based solutions and large language model integrations.

Quality & Engineering Excellence
  • Conduct architecture reviews, design assessments and code reviews to ensure technical excellence.

  • Ensure all solutions meet agreed performance, scalability and reliability standards.

Coaching & Mentoring

  • Support engineers in adopting modern AI development tools, frameworks and methodologies.
  • Contribute to the broader AI and Machine Learning engineering leadership community.
What You Will Bring
  • Extensive experience leading software engineering, AI engineering or machine learning teams within a large-scale environment.

  • Proven experience designing and delivering production grade AI and Machine Learning solutions.
  • Deep understanding of the ML development lifecycle including feature engineering, deployment and monitoring.

  • Experience designing and delivering complex Generative AI and Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions.

Highly Regarded

  • Experience implementing AI observability, monitoring and evaluation frameworks.
  • Exposure to modern engineering tools leveraging AI assisted development.

Why Join?

description:
Job Description Summary

The Probe Product Engineer in STPG Product Engineering owns probe strategy and silicon learning at wafer test, spanning pre‑silicon design‑to‑probe staging, first‑silicon bring‑up, qualification, and high‑volume manufacturing (HVM).

This role is accountable for defining probe coverage intent, establishing limits and guard‑bands grounded in silicon behavior, and driving yield, quality, and test‑cost outcomes. The focus is on interpreting design intent, device operation, and process interactions, and translating product risk into robust, manufacturable probe strategies aligned with downstream test and customer requirements.

The engineer works closely with Design, DFT, Design Validation (DV), Process Integration, Backend Test, and Reliability teams to ensure probe solutions are technically sound, scalable, and product‑centric across the lifecycle.

Key Responsibilities

Probe Coverage Strategy & Ownership

  • Define and own probe coverage intent by mapping design features, device behavior, and process risks into probe observability, screening mechanisms, trims, and guard‑bands.

  • Define, release, and sustain probe test flows from first silicon through qualification and HVM, ensuring coverage objectives are met without unnecessary test overhead.

  • Establish probe limits and guard‑bands based on silicon characterization, design intent, and customer specifications, with clear alignment to downstream test.

  • Lead probe enablement for new product introductions (NPI) and technology ramps, identifying coverage and manufacturability risks early and driving mitigation plans.

Pre‑Silicon Design‑to‑Probe Staging & DFT Readiness

  • Partner with Design, DFT, and DV teams during pre‑silicon phases to drive effective design‑to‑probe staging.

  • Review and influence DFT architecture, test hooks, observability, redundancy, and trim structures to enable efficient and manufacturable probe coverage.

  • Participate in pre‑silicon verification and simulation reviews to reduce first‑silicon debug risk.

  • Define probe coverage intent early and ensure continuity from design features through probe and downstream test (shift‑left learning).

First Silicon Bring‑Up & Device Characterization

  • Support first‑silicon bring‑up using engineering probe platforms and lab‑based characterization setups.

  • Perform silicon and device‑level characterization (parametric behavior, margins, trims, stress response) to inform probe limits and screening strategy.

  • Correlate early silicon behavior with probe results to validate coverage intent, identify gaps, and eliminate redundant content.

description:
Job Description Summary

The Probe Product Engineer in STPG Product Engineering owns probe strategy and silicon learning at wafer test, spanning pre‑silicon design‑to‑probe staging, first‑silicon bring‑up, qualification, and high‑volume manufacturing (HVM).

This role is accountable for defining probe coverage intent, establishing limits and guard‑bands grounded in silicon behavior, and driving yield, quality, and test‑cost outcomes. The focus is on interpreting design intent, device operation, and process interactions, and translating product risk into robust, manufacturable probe strategies aligned with downstream test and customer requirements.

The engineer works closely with Design, DFT, Design Validation (DV), Process Integration, Backend Test, and Reliability teams to ensure probe solutions are technically sound, scalable, and product‑centric across the lifecycle.

Career Growth & Impact

  • Direct ownership of probe strategy and quality outcomes across the product lifecycle.

  • Exposure to advanced technology nodes, customer‑driven requirements, and large‑scale manufacturing systems.

  • Clear growth paths across senior technical contributor, product leadership, or people management tracks within STPG Product Engineering.

Key Responsibilities

Probe Coverage Strategy & Ownership

  • Define and own probe coverage intent by mapping design features, device behavior, and process risks into probe observability, screening mechanisms, trims, and guard‑bands.

  • Define, release, and sustain probe test flows from first silicon through qualification and HVM, ensuring coverage objectives are met without unnecessary test overhead.

  • Establish probe limits and guard‑bands based on silicon characterization, design intent, and customer specifications, with clear alignment to downstream test.

  • Lead probe enablement for new product introductions (NPI) and technology ramps, identifying coverage and manufacturability risks early and driving mitigation plans.

Pre‑Silicon Design‑to‑Probe Staging & DFT Readiness

  • Review and influence DFT architecture, test hooks, observability, redundancy, and trim structures to enable efficient and manufacturable probe coverage.

  • Participate in pre‑silicon verification and simulation reviews to reduce first‑silicon debug risk.

  • Define probe coverage intent early and ensure continuity from design features through probe and downstream test (shift‑left learning).

First Silicon Bring‑Up & Device Characterization

  • Support first‑silicon bring‑up using engineering probe platforms and lab‑based characterization setups.

  • Perform silicon and device‑level characterization (parametric behavior, margins, trims, stress response) to inform probe limits and screening strategy.

  • Correlate early silicon behavior with probe results to validate coverage intent, identify gaps, and eliminate redundant content.

  • Provide early silicon learning to accelerate probe flow stabilization and yield ramp.

Yield, Quality & Reliability Enablement

  • Enable intrinsic and extrinsic screening strategies in collaboration with Reliability teams.

  • Provide structured, data‑backed feedback to Fab, Process Integration, Design, and DV teams to close learning loops efficiently.

Test Efficiency & Cost Optimization

  • Support wafer‑level speed (WLS) activities as part of broader probe optimization efforts.

  • Balance coverage, yield, quality, and cost trade‑offs using silicon data and product risk understanding.

Data, Analytics & AI Enablement

  • Apply data‑driven insights to continuously improve probe effectiveness and efficiency.

Artificial Intelligence

  • Strong analytical skills and ability to drive structured root‑cause analysis.

  • Effective communication skills and ability to work across global, cross‑functional teams.
