title: Solution Architect – D365 F&O | Contract | Outside IR35
description:
Senior Solution Architect – D365 F&O / Enterprise Finance Transformation | Contract | Outside IR35

We are looking for a highly experienced Solution Architect to support a major enterprise transformation within a complex UK utilities environment.

This is not a traditional D365-only architecture role. The programme is moving a significant home installations finance operation onto Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations, with Salesforce as the customer-facing platform, AWS supporting integration, SAP S/4HANA remaining part of the finance landscape, and multiple payment and consumer-finance providers involved.

A significant proportion of the target architecture is still to be defined, so we need an architect comfortable operating in discovery, challenging existing designs and owning architecture across multiple enterprise platforms.

The Role

You will own the end-to-end solution architecture across the finance and billing landscape, working closely with Finance, Dynamics, Salesforce, AWS/integration and wider architecture teams.

Key responsibilities will include:
  • Define the end-to-end architecture across Salesforce, AWS, Dynamics 365 F&O and SAP S/4HANA.
  • Own integration patterns for billing, amended sales processes, payments, settlements and financial reporting.
  • Define how existing D365 Order-to-Bill and Subscription Billing frameworks can be reused and where new patterns are required.
  • Architect payment flows incorporating card payments, pre-authorisation/tokenisation, multiple merchant accounts and settlement reconciliation.
  • Define integration patterns with multiple consumer-finance/lending providers, including funding requests, remittance ingestion and high-volume settlement matching.
  • Ensure new D365 processes integrate safely into the existing SAP S/4HANA finance landscape.
  • Establish robust approaches to error handling, reconciliation, exception management, auditability and operational visibility.
  • Lead architectural decisions around where functionality should sit across D365, Salesforce, AWS and surrounding platforms.
  • Work with functional and technical specialists to turn high-level business epics into a coherent target architecture.
Key Experience

We are particularly interested in architects with:
  • Strong architecture experience around Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations / Dynamics 365 Finance.
  • Proven experience designing solutions across multiple enterprise platforms rather than operating purely within D365.
  • Strong understanding of finance, billing, Accounts Receivable and Order-to-Cash processes.
  • Experience integrating D365 with Salesforce and/or AWS-based integration landscapes.
  • Experience with complex payments, payment gateways, merchant services or card processing.
  • Exposure to consumer-finance/lender integrations, remittance processing or high-volume settlement would be highly valuable.
  • Understanding of SAP S/4HANA / SAP FI and coexistence or integration between SAP and Dynamics would be advantageous.
  • Ability to lead discovery where the existing processes and target-state design are not yet fully documented.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills and the credibility to work directly with senior Finance and enterprise architecture stakeholders.
This role will suit a genuinely cross-platform Solution Architect who understands D365 Finance but is equally comfortable owning the architecture around the boundaries of the platform.

Experience within utilities, energy, financial services, subscription businesses or other complex high-volume billing environments would be particularly relevant.

title: Service Designer- Data Programme
description:
GovTech is the lead agency driving Singapore’s Smart Nation initiatives and public sector digital transformation. As the Centre of Excellence for Infocomm Technology and Smart Systems (ICT & SS), GovTech develops the Singapore Government’s capabilities in Data Science & Artificial Intelligence, Application Development, Smart City Technology, Digital Infrastructure, and Cybersecurity.

At GovTech, we offer you a purposeful career to make lives better where we empower our people to master their craft through robust learning and development opportunities all year round.

Play a part in Singapore’s vision to build a Smart Nation and embark on your meaningful journey to build tech for public good. Join us to advance our mission and shape your future with us today!

Learn more about GovTech at tech.gov.sg.

[What you will be working on]

The mission of GovTech's Data Programme is to deliver fit-for-purpose data assets and services for policy making, service delivery and operations across Whole of Government. Our programme creates value through enablement - reducing friction for agencies so they can move faster and make better decisions in their work with existing government datasets.

You will contribute to the design and development of one or more of our four strategic initiatives:

1. Standardised Data Platform
2. Unified Frontend / DataHive
3. Unified Serving Backbone
4. Observability & Governance Infrastructure

About the Role
We are looking for a Service Designer to look across all touchpoints within the department and map out how they interlink with one another. A key part of this role is piecing together fragmented, disconnected journeys and helping them dovetail into one coherent system or programme — so that agencies experience our data services as a single, joined-up whole rather than a set of disparate tools and processes.

Responsibilities

  • See the Whole System: Map the full landscape of touchpoints across the four strategic initiatives — surfacing how services, teams, and tools interconnect (or fail to) from the user's point of view.

  • Diagnose Fragmentation: Identify gaps, overlaps, redundancies, and hand-off points between initiatives where journeys break down or feel disjointed to agencies and end-users.

  • Design the Connective Tissue: Define how fragmented journeys can dovetail into one coherent, unified programme experience — establishing the service architecture and shared patterns that hold the four initiatives together as a single system.

  • Produce Systems-Level Artefacts: Create service blueprints, ecosystem maps, journey maps, and touchpoint inventories that give the programme a shared, visual understanding of how the whole service functions end-to-end.

  • Translate Complexity into Clarity: Distil complex, technical, and cross-team workflows into artefacts.

  • Collaborate & Influence: Partner closely with product designers, researchers, product managers, and engineers across all four pillars to socialise the systems view, resolve conflicting journey designs, and align teams around a single coherent programme narrative.

What it is like working here
We build products that serve a variety of agency users, who use them to solve highly meaningful problems pertinent to our society, from transportation, to education, to healthcare. The public sector is full of opportunities where even the simplest software can have a big impact on people’s lives. We are here to improve how we live as a society through what we can offer as a government.

  • Rapid Prototyping - Instead of spending too much time debating ideas we prefer testing them. This identifies potential problems quickly, and more importantly, conveys what is possible to others easily.

  • Reliable Productisation - To scale an idea, a prototype or a Minimum Viable Product to a software product, we scrutinize and commit to its usability, reliability, scalability and maintainability.

  • Ownership - In addition to design responsibilities, this means having ideas on how things should be done and taking responsibility for seeing them through. Building something that you believe in is the best way to build something good.

  • Continuous Learning - Working on new ideas often means not fully understanding what you are working on. Taking time to learn new frameworks, technologies, and even different ways of working is not just encouraged but essential.

What we are looking for

  • 5+ years of professional experience in Service Design.

  • A strong portfolio demonstrating that shows work at the programme or ecosystem level — not just individual product or feature design.

  • Demonstrated experience mapping complex, multi-stakeholder systems — service blueprints, ecosystem maps, journey maps that span multiple teams, products, or organisations — and using them to drive alignment.

  • Comfort operating at a level above individual product delivery — able to set direction and shared patterns for other designers to execute against, rather than owning end-to-end delivery personally.

  • Experience working with technical, data-heavy, or infrastructure-oriented products is a strong plus.

  • Take the initiative to make things happen

  • Desire to learn, adapt and grow in the UX design field

What We Offer:

  • Collaborative and creative work environment
  • Competitive salary and benefits package, including opportunities for professional growth and development
  • Work environment that is fully supportive of self-improvement and personal/professional development

GovTech is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive workplace that values diverse voices and perspectives, as we believe it is key to innovation.

Our employee benefits are based on a total rewards approach, offering a holistic and market-competitive suite of perks.

We champion flexible work arrangements (subject to your job role) and trust you to manage your time to deliver your best.

Learn more about life inside GovTech at go.gov.sg/GovTechCareers.
Stay connected with us on social media at go.gov.sg/ConnectWithGovTech

POSITION OVERVIEW:

The Project Manager is responsible for leading and coordinating cross-functional pharmaceutical R&D programs across the drug development lifecycle, from preclinical research through clinical development. This role serves as a central point of coordination among scientific, clinical, regulatory, quality, and operational stakeholders to ensure projects are executed on time, within scope, and within budget. The Project Manager drives project planning, risk management, resource alignment, and operational execution while supporting critical development milestones and regulatory objectives.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

This list is not exhaustive and may be supplemented and changed as necessary.

  • Develop, maintain, and manage detailed project plans, timelines, and operational roadmaps utilizing tools such as Microsoft Project, Smartsheet, or similar project management platforms.

  • Develop and implement risk mitigation strategies, contingency plans, and escalation processes to minimize delays and maintain project momentum.
  • Monitor project budgets, forecast resource requirements, and support financial planning activities throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Evaluate and manage project scope changes while assessing impacts to timelines, budgets, resources, and program objectives.
  • Support preparation and coordination of regulatory submissions, including INDs, CTAs, and other development-related documentation.

  • Other duties as assigned. These job requirements are not intended to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills required of personnel.

QUALIFICATIONS AND REQUIREMENTS

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the education, experience, skills, knowledge, and abilities required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential duties.

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Chemistry, Pharmacy, Engineering, or a related scientific discipline required.
  • Advanced degree (MS, PhD, MBA, or equivalent) strongly preferred.

Experience

  • Minimum of 5 years of experience within pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or life sciences organizations.
  • At least 3 to 5 years of direct project or program management experience supporting research, development, clinical, or operational initiatives.
  • Experience managing cross-functional teams and projects in a regulated environment.
  • Experience supporting regulatory submissions and development programs is preferred.
  • Demonstrated understanding of pharmaceutical product development, including preclinical, clinical, regulatory, and commercialization activities.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Strong understanding of the drug development lifecycle from preclinical research through clinical development.
  • Proven project planning, scheduling, budgeting, resource management, and execution capabilities.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to anticipate challenges and implement practical solutions.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to influence and drive alignment across cross-functional teams without direct authority.
  • Experience utilizing project management tools such as Microsoft Project, Smartsheet, Planisware, or similar systems.
  • Strong organizational skills with a high attention to detail and ability to maintain comprehensive project documentation.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to use a computer keyboard and mouse; reach with hands and arms; talk and listen. The employee is frequently required to walk and sit, as well as to lift and carry objects such as books and files weighing up to 25 pounds. The employee is occasionally required to stand, stoop, or kneel. Specific vision abilities required by this position include close vision and the ability to adjust focus.

Work Environment:

title: Systems Engineering Lead
description:
Systems Engineering Lead is responsible for providing technical direction, systems engineering governance, and multidisciplinary integration across light rail transit (LRT) infrastructure programs in Toronto, Ontario, Canada.

The role oversees the development, integration, verification, and validation of complex transit systems including rolling stock, signalling and train control, traction power infrastructure, fare collection systems, and operations and maintenance facilities. Working across design, procurement, integration, testing, and commissioning phases, the position ensures that technical solutions satisfy project requirements, operational objectives, safety expectations, and stakeholder needs throughout the system lifecycle.

The ideal candidate brings 12+ years of systems engineering experience within rail or transit environments, including leadership responsibility on multidisciplinary transportation infrastructure projects. Experience in requirements management, systems integration, technical assurance, and verification activities is essential, together with the ability to guide technical teams and support project delivery in regulated transit environments

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide systems engineering leadership and technical governance across rolling stock, signalling, power infrastructure, fare systems, and OMSF disciplines.
  • Develop and maintain the Systems Engineering Management Plan, including requirements management, verification, and validation processes.
  • Lead requirements definition, analysis, allocation, and traceability activities from system-level requirements through subsystem specifications.
  • Conduct technical design reviews and ensure engineering solutions satisfy functional, operational, and performance requirements.
  • Coordinate systems engineering activities with interface management, systems integration, and discipline engineering teams.
  • Establish and maintain system architecture to support integrated technical design across project systems.
  • Lead trade studies and technical assessments to support engineering decision-making and system performance optimization.
  • Manage requirements traceability and oversee verification and validation activities to demonstrate compliance.
  • Perform technical risk management activities and develop mitigation strategies for system-level risks.
  • Support procurement processes through technical specification reviews and contractor proposal evaluations.
  • Provide technical guidance related to operating concepts, degraded-mode operations, and emergency response procedures.
  • Ensure engineering solutions support 1,435 mm gauge track, low-floor LRV operations, and transit signal priority functionality.
  • Mentor engineering personnel and support the development of systems engineering capability across the project team.

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in Systems Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.
  • Professional Engineer (P.Eng.) designation.
  • Minimum 12 years of progressive systems engineering experience within rail, transit, or transportation infrastructure projects.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in technical leadership, systems management, or multidisciplinary engineering leadership roles.
  • Expert knowledge of systems engineering principles, methodologies, requirements management, and lifecycle processes.
  • Comprehensive understanding of light rail transit systems, including rolling stock, signalling systems, traction power systems, control systems, and operational infrastructure.
  • Demonstrated experience leading multidisciplinary engineering teams on complex infrastructure programs.
  • Strong requirements management experience using IBM DOORS or equivalent requirements management platforms.
  • Experience performing verification, validation, integration, and compliance management activities.
  • Strong analytical, technical problem-solving, and stakeholder coordination skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to present complex technical information to diverse audiences.

Preferred

  • Master's degree in Engineering or a related technical discipline.
  • INCOSE ASEP or CSEP certification.
  • Experience applying Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) methodologies.
  • Experience with MBSE tools and digital systems engineering environments.
  • Experience supporting large-scale transit expansion or light rail delivery programs.
  • Experience leading technical assurance, testing, and commissioning activities.
  • Knowledge of transit operations planning, service reliability, and system performance monitoring.

title: Product Owner
description:
About ChargeNet
ChargeNet is on a mission to accelerate the transition to sustainable transportation by building a comprehensive network of electric vehicle (EV) charging stations across New Zealand and by supplying and building market leading products and service offerings that make charging accessible to EV owners.
We built the first nationwide network, we developed the software to run it and ensure everyone who is ready to drive an EV can do it, where they want and when they want. It’s time to eliminate range anxiety and make electric vehicle adoption convenient and accessible for all New Zealanders.

About the Role
You'll independently lead product ownership across two development squads and interact with B2C and B2B customers, industry partners and internal users and stakeholders. You'll take the product propositions the business sets and turn them into delivered outcomes: owning the backlog, writing detailed user stories and acceptance criteria, running agile ceremonies and working shoulder-to-shoulder with engineering daily whilst always being on top of the user experience and their needs.
As a tech savvy product owner, you fully understand all the moving parts of the ecosystem. From the at-site charging experience, to the charging process and it’s challenges, through to taking a payment from the customer and business reporting.

Skills & Experience
  • 2–5 years as a Product Owner in a software environment
  • Ownership of the end user experience including user flows, wireframing and creation of basic designs, briefing external UX designers and validating solutions, with the final call on whether what ships genuinely works for the people using it
  • Assessing business impact and prioritisation
  • Strong technical literacy - comfortable discussing APIs, system architecture, integrations and data flows, and confident asking the hard questions of an engineering team
  • Curiosity to understand how things work under the hood, and the ability to connect the dots between a technical decision and its impact on a user
  • Track record delivering B2B and/or B2C software and app products end to end, from discovery through release
  • Skilled at running story mapping sessions and writing detailed user stories, acceptance criteria and developer-ready documentation once a solution approach has been confirmed with the team
  • Solid grasp of agile delivery, prioritisation techniques and data-driven decision making; familiar with Jira, Confluence and Miro
  • Bonus: OCPP, OCPI or other EV/energy protocols, fleet management or energy optimisation exposure, basic SQL

Why Work at ChargeNet?
  • Hybrid working - Monday to Wednesday in the office and as required, work from home Thursday and Friday
  • Modern Takapuna office a short walk from the beach
  • Genuine end-to-end exposure - in a business this size you'll understand the whole ecosystem, not just your slice of it
  • Learn well beyond product: EV infrastructure, grid capacity and energy systems
  • Work directly with an experienced product leader invested in your development
  • AI use is encouraged for appropriate tasks and part of how the team works
  • Directly shape the infrastructure New Zealand's transport future depends on

Ready to apply?
If you're a product person who likes getting into the technical detail and wants to see the impact of what you ship, we'd love to hear from you. Apply now, or email dan@talent.army for a confidential conversation.

title: SAP Integration Architect (VCP)
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a SAP Integration Architect (VCP) based in India.

We are looking for a senior SAP integration professional to lead architecture, delivery governance, and execution across complex SAP and non-SAP landscapes.
You will own integration strategy and help design scalable, secure, and clean-core compliant solutions using SAP BTP Integration Suite.
The role combines deep technical expertise with delivery leadership, stakeholder management, and hands-on solution ownership.
You will work across platforms including S/4HANA, ECC, SAP IBP, Ariba, SuccessFactors, and non-SAP applications.
The position involves shaping integration standards across APIs, events, messaging, security, monitoring, and error handling.
You will collaborate with business teams, SAP functional teams, infrastructure, security, BASIS teams, vendors, and system integrators.
This is a full-time hybrid opportunity based in Bengaluru for an experienced professional comfortable managing multiple workstreams in a fast-changing environment.

Accountabilities:

  • Define enterprise-wide integration architecture using SAP BTP Integration Suite, including Cloud Integration/CPI, API Management, and Event Mesh.
  • Design scalable integration patterns across S/4HANA On-Premise and Cloud, ECC, SAP IBP, Ariba, SuccessFactors, and non-SAP applications.
  • Establish standards for synchronous and asynchronous integrations, APIs, events, message orchestration, and integration patterns.
  • Drive clean-core compliant integration architectures while minimizing custom modifications to the SAP core.
  • Lead end-to-end integration delivery across multiple programs, workstreams, vendors, and system integrators.
  • Own the integration roadmap, milestones, RAID management, dependencies, and delivery governance.
  • Review and approve Functional Specifications, Technical Specifications, Integration Design Documents, and related technical deliverables.
  • Ensure integration solutions meet agreed SLAs, performance benchmarks, security requirements, and architectural standards.
  • Lead integration readiness across SIT, UAT, cutover, and go-live activities.
  • Provide hands-on technical leadership across SAP Cloud Integration, including iFlows, adapters, mappings, and orchestration.
  • Lead API Management activities covering REST/OData APIs, policies, throttling, and API-led integration approaches.
  • Design and guide event-driven integrations using Event Mesh.
  • Manage secure connectivity using SAP Cloud Connector and advise teams on secure integration architectures.
  • Guide implementation of OAuth2, certificates, JWT, PGP, encryption, and key-management mechanisms.
  • Act as the integration SPOC for business stakeholders, SAP functional teams, BASIS, security, infrastructure, vendors, and system integrators.
  • Define monitoring, alerting, logging, and error-handling strategies for critical integrations.
  • Lead hypercare and L3 support for high-priority integration solutions.
  • Drive performance tuning, resiliency, scalability, and continuous improvement across the integration landscape.

    • Requirements:

    • Strong professional experience in SAP integration architecture, solution design, and delivery leadership.
    • Deep hands-on expertise with SAP BTP Integration Suite, including Cloud Integration/CPI, API Management, and Event Mesh.
    • Strong experience with SAP S/4HANA, both On-Premise and Cloud, as well as SAP ECC.
    • Experience integrating SAP platforms such as SAP IBP, Ariba, SuccessFactors, and non-SAP enterprise applications.
    • Strong knowledge of integration technologies and protocols including REST, OData, SOAP, IDoc, RFC, and EDI.
    • Proficiency with JSON, XML, XSLT, and Groovy scripting.
    • Strong understanding of integration patterns including Point-to-Point, Hub-and-Spoke, and event-driven architectures.
    • Experience designing and implementing API-led architectures.
    • Strong knowledge of integration security technologies and practices, including OAuth2, SAML, SSL, certificates, encryption, JWT, and PGP.
    • Strong understanding of SAP Clean Core principles, extensibility, and SAP-recommended integration practices.
    • Experience defining integration standards, governance frameworks, monitoring strategies, and operational processes.
    • Experience leading complex integration programs involving multiple workstreams, vendors, and technical teams.
    • Strong planning and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and dependencies simultaneously.
    • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present and explain complex technical topics clearly to diverse stakeholders.
    • Strong influencing and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to build effective relationships across multidisciplinary teams.
    • Ability to work independently on complex processes, solutions, and modules supporting multiple programs or systems.
    • Strong decision-making and problem-solving abilities, including the judgment to identify risks and escalate issues appropriately.
    • Self-motivated, collaborative, and comfortable taking initiative in a complex and rapidly changing environment.
    • Ability to remain composed and effective when priorities, requirements, or timelines change.
    • SAP BTP or integration-related certifications are an advantage.

      • Benefits:

      • Full-time employment opportunity.
      • Hybrid working model based in Bengaluru, Karnataka.
      • Opportunity to lead enterprise-scale SAP integration architecture and delivery initiatives.
      • Exposure to SAP BTP Integration Suite, S/4HANA, API-led architecture, event-driven integration, and Clean Core practices.
      • Opportunity to work across diverse SAP and non-SAP platforms and complex integration landscapes.
      • Collaboration with multidisciplinary business, technology, security, infrastructure, and functional teams.
      • Opportunity to contribute to strategic integration standards, governance, scalability, and continuous improvement.
      • Professional environment focused on technology delivery, problem-solving, and execution.

title: Opleidingsplaats Verzorgende IG
description:
Droom je van een carrièreswitch naar de zorg? Careyn is een erkend leerbedrijf waar je werken en leren combineert en meteen praktijkervaring opdoet. Als grootste ouderenzorgorganisatie van Nederland bieden we zij-instromers volop kansen om zich professioneel en persoonlijk te ontwikkelen. Je brengt je kennis meteen in de praktijk en groeit stap voor stap naar een betekenisvolle rol in de zorg.

Dit ga je doen als Leerling Verzorgende IG

In het zij-instroom traject als Verzorgende IG volg je één dag per week theorie en werk je de overige dagen in een van onze teams in Utrecht. De opleiding duurt gemiddeld 2,5 jaar. Je ondersteunt ouderen bij hun dagelijkse zorg, van wondverzorging tot het toedienen van medicatie. Je leert omgaan met situaties rondom dementie en de laatste levensfase. Daarbij help je bewoners zoveel mogelijk zelfstandig te blijven. Zo draag je bij aan hun comfort en kwaliteit van leven.

Wat werken in dit team aantrekkelijk maakt

Je krijgt de kans om ervaring op te doen op een van onze locaties én binnen de wijkteams, waardoor je het vak in de volle breedte leert kennen. In een warm en betrokken team is er veel ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen en verantwoordelijkheid te nemen. De combinatie van zorg verlenen, persoonlijke aandacht geven en meedenken in passende oplossingen maakt het werk afwisselend en betekenisvol. Iedere dag brengt nieuwe, waardevolle zorgsituaties met zich mee. Zo draag je bij aan het leven van ouderen in een omgeving waar zij zich vertrouwd en gezien voelen.

Wat je van ons mag verwachten

  • Salaris volgens cao VVT, FWG 35: vanaf € 2.663 (o.b.v. 36 uur).

  • Een leerarbeidsovereenkomst voor 24 tot 32 uur per week, met uitzicht op een vaste aanstelling na het afronden van je opleiding.

  • Reiskostenvergoeding, 8% vakantietoeslag en 8,33% eindejaarsuitkering.

  • Mogelijkheid om gebruik te maken van het meerkeuzesysteem, zoals extra verlof of een fietsregeling.

  • Toegang tot o.a. HeyCoach, budgetcoach en DigiCoach voor jouw ontwikkeling.

  • Bij Careyn krijg je meer dan de arbeidsvoorwaarden uit de cao VVT. Meer weten? Bekijk onze arbeidsvoorwaarden.

Om de veiligheid van onze cliënten en medewerkers te waarborgen, is voor alle medewerkers die bij Careyn in dienst komen een Verklaring Omtrent Gedrag (VOG) vereist. Bij gelijke geschiktheid krijgen interne sollicitanten voorrang ten opzichte van externe kandidaten.

title: IT Support and Governance Specialist Consultant
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a IT Support and Governance Specialist Consultant based in Brazil.

As an IT Support and Governance Specialist Consultant, you will help organizations design and implement effective models for application and IT service support.
The role combines technical expertise, service management, governance, and process improvement to strengthen operational continuity and service quality.
You will assess existing support models, identify risks and bottlenecks, and translate findings into practical improvements.
The position involves establishing ITIL and COBIT-based processes, service structures, SLAs, responsibilities, controls, and operational indicators.
You will also evaluate applications, integrations, monitoring capabilities, documentation, and operational readiness during transitions into support.
The role offers an opportunity to work closely with technical teams, business stakeholders, and suppliers in complex technology environments.
This is a fully remote consulting opportunity suited to a senior professional who combines hands-on technical knowledge with strong governance and communication skills.

Accountabilities:

  • Diagnose existing application and IT service support models, identifying risks, bottlenecks, operational gaps, and opportunities for improvement across processes, applications, integrations, and suppliers.
  • Design and implement processes for incident, problem, request, change, and knowledge management based on ITIL and COBIT practices.
  • Structure service catalogs, service levels, responsibility matrices, SLAs, escalation mechanisms, and other elements required for effective IT service management.
  • Assess applications and integrations for documentation quality, monitoring capabilities, failure management, supportability, and operational readiness.
  • Define operational readiness, acceptance, knowledge-transfer, and stabilization criteria for transitioning projects and solutions into ongoing support.
  • Establish operational indicators, controls, governance routines, and monitoring mechanisms for internal teams and technology suppliers.
  • Validate support models through pilots and assisted implementations, supporting teams during adoption and stabilization.
  • Deliver practical processes, procedures, controls, and performance indicators that can be incorporated into day-to-day operations.
  • Establish clear boundaries between support, corrective activities, enhancements, and projects, ensuring effective coordination between support, development, infrastructure, and suppliers.
  • Ensure traceability of operational activities and decisions in alignment with governance, security, compliance, and audit requirements.
  • Structure knowledge-management and continuity mechanisms to reduce dependency on individual employees and improve organizational resilience.
  • Formalize the transition of support models to internal teams, including documentation, outstanding items, responsibilities, and continuous-improvement plans.
  • Facilitate workshops, knowledge-transfer sessions, and team training to support successful implementation and adoption.

    • Requirements

    • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
    • Senior-level experience in application support and in implementing or improving IT service management processes.
    • Applied knowledge of ITIL and COBIT, including experience defining responsibilities, SLAs, controls, processes, and operational indicators.
    • Strong technical understanding of enterprise applications, APIs, integrations, and databases.
    • Ability to analyze application logs, perform SQL queries, and contribute to technical troubleshooting and root-cause analysis.
    • Experience with incident and problem management, root-cause analysis, production changes, and transitions from project delivery into ongoing support.
    • Experience working with ITSM tools and collaborating with technical teams, business stakeholders, and external suppliers.
    • Ability to facilitate workshops, document processes clearly, and take a hands-on approach to implementation and team enablement.
    • Strong communication, organization, analytical thinking, and problem-solving skills.
    • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with multidisciplinary teams and stakeholders.
    • Experience in critical or regulated environments is a plus.
    • Knowledge of observability, SRE, DevOps, and operational automation is desirable.
    • Experience with ServiceNow, Jira Service Management, BusinessMap, or equivalent ITSM/process-management platforms is an advantage.
    • ITIL, COBIT, or related service-management and IT governance certifications are a plus.

Interview Plan

Floor Leader

As a Floor Leader, you'll play a vital role in supporting the Store Management Team across all areas of the business. This includes everything from driving sales and opening/closing the store to analyzing sales results and leading training sessions. Together with your fellow leaders, you'll work to ensure that every aspect of the store is firing on all cylinders, creating an exceptional customer experience, a happy and motivated staff, and operational excellence that would make even the most detail-oriented among us proud.

Your day-to-day will be spent on the shop floor, where you'll lead and inspire a team of sales associates to achieve and surpass their goals. By fostering a culture of passion and positivity, you'll help create a work environment that's both productive and fun, resulting in happy customers and happy employees. The Floor Leader role is all about making the world a better place one soap at a time!

Sales & Customer Experience:

  • Driving Sales: Utilize the StoreForce dashboard results to provide effective coaching and feedback to the sales team, and make necessary adjustments to the shop floor structure to meet and exceed sales goals.   • Customer Experience: Lead by example in delivering a world-class customer experience on the shop floor, including product demonstrations. Observe and listen to consultations, collaborate with your team, and strive to exceed daily sales goals. By fostering a culture of excellence in customer service, you'll drive sales, create a loyal customer base, and build a positive reputation for your store.
  • Building the Brand: Educate customers on Lush brand values, and articulate our position on Fighting Animal Testing, Freshest Cosmetics, Ethical Buying, 100% Vegetarian, Handmade, and Naked Packaging in the shop and through community engagement, hosting store parties, and other traffic-driving initiatives.

Lead by example, take ownership of your development, assess your performance, and actively seek feedback, resources, and opportunities to improve and elevate your skills, knowledge and abilities.

Foster a sense of belonging by promoting teamwork, encouraging collaboration, and recognizing and valuing each employee's unique contributions.

    • a fast-paced team environment

title: Senior Software Engineer - SAP HANA, BODS
description:
Salary: $140 – $150 per hour

Senior Software Engineer - SAP BusinessObject Data Services (BODS)

To apply for this role, the candidate must be an Australian Citizens and have a minimum of Baseline Security Clearance.

Job details

  1. Software Engineers have experience overseeing software development projects, writing optimised code, and provide technical leadership to a team of software engineers. They are responsible for the quality and functionality of the software produced by their team.

  2. EL1 Software Engineers, often referred to as Development Experts, have experience overseeing software development projects, writing optimised code, and provide technical leadership to a team of software engineers.

  3. They are responsible for the quality and functionality of the software produced – in this case utilising SAP BODS which is an ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) platform that integrates, cleanses, and loads data from multiple sources into target systems like SAP HANA, SAP BW, or non-SAP data warehouses. It combines data integration, data quality, data profiling, and data processing in a single solution.

  4. An EL1 SAP BODS Software Engineer engages in the design and development of high-quality solutions in support of business and technical requirements. They lead software development projects and provide technical leadership to their teams - managing the planning, development and construction activities. EL1 SAP BODS Software Engineers evaluate and resolve complex issues within Agile development and production environments.

Key duties and responsibilities

May include some or all the following:

  1. lead and create software and technical designs for the realisation of highly complex development solutions

  2. develop strategy to ensure high quality code and long-term maintenance of a product's code base

  3. provide specialist technical advice on software development and maintenance

  4. lead the release and ensure go-live production support and maintenance for the team’s developments

  5. lead analysis, design, software development, prototyping, unit testing and maintenance activities

  6. review and undertake high-level analysis of technical requirements to support project evaluation with proposed solutions

  7. investigate and resolve highly complex ICT issues

Technical skills

A. Experience using SAP Business Objects Data Services (BODS) to implement Batch data ingestion pipelines
B. Experience using the following in SAP BODS:
- Script transforms, Query transforms, Validation transforms, Database extraction functions, Database load
functions, Address transforms, Name transforms, and Real time services
C. Highly desirable - experience in using any of the following databases:
- SAP HANA
- PostgreSQL
- IBM DB2
- Teradata

Requirements

Criteria

Candidate must provide a one-page pitch to address all criteria specified. This is equal to 5000 characters including spaces.

Essential criteria

  • 1. Emerging technology monitoring: Level 5 (SFIA)

    Monitors the external environment to gather intelligence on emerging technologies. Assesses and documents the impacts, threats and opportunities to the organisation. Creates reports and technology roadmaps and shares knowledge and insights with others.

  • 2. Methods and tools: Level 5 (SFIA)

    Provides advice, guidance and expertise to promote adoption of methods and tools and adherence to policies and standards. Evaluates and selects appropriate methods and tools in line with agreed policies and standards. Contributes to organisational policies, standards, and guidelines for methods and tools. Implements methods and tools at programme, project and team levels including selection and tailoring in line with agreed standards. Manages reviews of the benefits and value of methods and tools. Identifies and recommends improvements.

  • 3. Programming/software development: Level 5 (SFIA)

    Takes technical responsibility across all stages and iterations of software development. Plans and drives software construction activities. Adopts and adapts appropriate software development methods, tools and techniques. Measures and monitors applications of project/team standards for software construction, including software security. Contributes to the development of organisational policies, standards, and guidelines for software development.

  • 4. Release and deployment: Level 5 (SFIA)

    Leads the assessment, analysis, planning and design of release packages, including assessment of risk. Liaises with business and technology teams on release scheduling and communication of progress. Conducts post-release reviews. Ensures that release processes and procedures are applied and that releases can be rolled back as needed. Identifies, evaluates and manages the adoption of appropriate release and deployment techniques, processes and automation tools.

  • 5. Software configuration: Level 5 (SFIA)

    Takes technical responsibility across all stages and iterations of configuration development and deployment. Plans and drives software configuration activities. Adopts and adapts appropriate software configuration methods, tools and techniques. Measures and monitors the application of standards for configuration design and deployment including software security. Contributes to the development of organisational policies, standards, and guidelines for software configuration design and deployment.

  • 6. Software design: Level 4 (SFIA)

    Designs complex software applications, components and modules. Uses appropriate modelling techniques following agreed software design standards, guidelines, patterns and methodology. Creates and communicates multiple design views to balance stakeholders' concerns and to satisfy functional and non-functional requirements. Identifies, evaluates and recommends alternative design options and trade-offs. Models, simulates or prototypes the behaviour of proposed software to enable approval by stakeholders, and effective construction of the software. Verifies software design by constructing and applying appropriate methods. Reviews, verifies and improves own designs against specifications. Leads reviews of others designs.

  • 7. Specialist advice: Level 4 (SFIA)

    Provides detailed and specific advice regarding the application of their specialism to the organisation's planning and operations. Actively maintains knowledge in one or more identifiable specialisms. Recognises and identifies the boundaries of their own specialist knowledge. Where appropriate, collaborates with other specialists to ensure advice given is appropriate to the organisation's needs.

  • 8. Systems design: Level 5 (SFIA)

    Designs large or complex systems and undertakes impact analysis on major design options and trade-offs. Ensures that the system design balances functional and non-functional requirements. Reviews systems designs and ensures that appropriate methods, tools and techniques are applied effectively. Makes recommendations and assesses and manages associated risks. Adopts and adapts system design methods, tools and techniques. Contributes to development of system design policies, standards and selection of architecture components.

  • 9. Systems integration and build: Level 5 (SFIA)

    Plans and drives activities to develop organisational systems integration and build capabilities including automation and continuous integration. Identifies, evaluates and manages the adoption of tools, techniques and processes to create a robust integration framework. Provides authoritative advice and guidance on any aspect of systems integration. Leads integration work in line with the agreed system and service design. Assesses risks and takes preventative action. Measures and monitors applications of standards. Contributes to the development of organisational policies, standards, and guidelines for systems integration.

  • 10. Testing: Level 4 (SFIA)

    Selects appropriate testing approach, including manual and automated testing. Develops and executes test plans and test cases. Implements scalable and reliable automated tests and frameworks. Collaborates across parties involved in product, systems or service design and development to enable comprehensive test coverage. Identifies improvements in requirements, design or specification processes to increase the effectiveness and efficiency of testing. Analyses and reports on test activities, results, issues and risks, including the work of others.

Desirable criteria

  • 1. Configuration management: Level 2 (SFIA)

    Applies tools, techniques and processes to administer, track, log, report on and correct configuration items, components and changes. Assists with audits to check the accuracy of the information and undertakes any necessary corrective action under direction.

title: Punch Machine Helper

description:
Share a cuppa, a chat, and a few domino wins!


We’re looking for a friendly volunteer to brighten the day of an older gentleman in Wallsend. He’d love some regular company — whether that’s sharing a cuppa and a chat, going for a drive, or enjoying a few games of dominoes together. If you enjoy good conversation and simple pleasures, this could be a wonderful way to make a real difference in someone’s week.

Location: Wallsend

Time commitment: 1 hour per week (flexible)

Impact: Deep, personal, and lasting

One hour a week can make a real difference.

If this sounds like you – or someone you know – we’d love to hear from you!


Your impact

Volunteering as a social visitor can be a rewarding experience, both for the person you visit as well as yourself. Regular visits from volunteers can help to improve quality of life and help people feel less isolated.




HammondCare

HammondCare is an independent Christian charity and we're passionate about improving the quality of life for people in need. We have a wonderful group of volunteers that partner with us to enhance the lives of people cared for by HammondCare.

HammondCare is a provider of The Aged Care Volunteer Visitors Scheme funded by the Australian Government and is established to promote links between elderly people and volunteers in their local community.


Further information

​

Thank you for expressing an interest in volunteering with HammondCare.

18 years or older • National Volunteer Police Check arranged and paid for by HammondCare

POSITION OVERVIEW:

We are seeking a CQV Engineer with 7–11 years of experience supporting commissioning, qualification, and validation activities for GMP-regulated facilities, utilities, equipment, automation systems, and manufacturing processes. This role is responsible for the execution of commissioning and qualification activities, including system walkdowns, protocol execution, documentation review, discrepancy management, and system turnover support. The CQV Engineer will work cross-functionally with Engineering, Construction, Automation, Operations, Quality, and project teams to ensure systems are installed, tested, documented, and released in accordance with approved requirements, project timelines, and regulatory expectations.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

(This list is not exhaustive and may be supplemented or adjusted as needed.)

  • Review approved design, vendor, turnover, and qualification documentation in preparation for commissioning and qualification execution activities.
  • Support system walkdowns, field verification activities, construction completion reviews, and readiness assessments.
  • Execute commissioning and qualification protocols, including IQ, OQ, PQ, functional testing, and other approved test documentation as applicable.
  • Verify installation of equipment, utilities, instrumentation, controls, and automation systems against approved drawings, specifications, vendor documentation, and design requirements.
  • Verify system functionality, alarms, interlocks, controls, instrumentation, and operational requirements during execution activities.
  • Coordinate testing activities with Engineering, Construction, Automation, Operations, Quality Assurance, and equipment vendors to support execution schedules.
  • Perform and document field testing activities and collect objective evidence required to support protocol execution and qualification deliverables.
  • Identify, document, and track discrepancies, punch-list items, protocol exceptions, and deviations encountered during execution activities.
  • Support investigations, issue resolution, corrective actions, retesting, and closure of execution-related deviations and discrepancies.
  • Perform protocol data review and ensure documentation is complete, accurate, attributable, and compliant with GMP documentation requirements.
  • Review turnover packages and verify supporting documentation required for system acceptance and qualification.
  • Develop and complete qualification summary reports, turnover documentation, and system closeout packages.
  • Support system release and handover activities to Operations and Quality upon successful completion of required CQV deliverables.
  • Maintain execution status and communicate progress, constraints, project risks, and dependencies to CQV and project leadership teams.
  • Participate in project meetings and collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to ensure alignment with project schedules and milestones.
  • Support regulatory inspections, audits, and quality initiatives as they relate to commissioning, qualification, and validation activities.

QUALIFICATIONS AND REQUIREMENTS

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Life Sciences, or a related technical discipline.

Technical Experience

  • 7–11 years of commissioning, qualification, validation, engineering, or related experience within the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical device, or other regulated life sciences industries.
  • Strong understanding of FDA cGMP requirements, GDP documentation practices, and risk-based commissioning and qualification methodologies.
  • Experience supporting commissioning and qualification activities for process equipment, clean utilities, facilities, automation systems, and manufacturing systems.
  • Demonstrated experience executing and/or supporting IQ, OQ, PQ, commissioning, startup, and functional testing protocols.
  • Experience reviewing engineering documentation, including P&IDs, specifications, equipment drawings, turnover packages, and vendor documentation.
  • Familiarity with deviation management, discrepancy resolution, change control processes, and quality systems.
  • Experience supporting startup, construction completion, system turnover, and operational readiness activities is preferred.
  • Experience working in large capital project environments and collaborating with multidisciplinary project teams is preferred.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Strong knowledge of commissioning, qualification, and validation principles within GMP-regulated environments.
  • Ability to execute protocols in the field and effectively document testing results and objective evidence.
  • Strong organizational skills with attention to detail and documentation accuracy.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to interact with stakeholders across multiple functional groups.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively in a fast-paced project environment.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to support investigations, issue resolution, and risk mitigation activities.
  • Ability to work independently while contributing effectively as part of a cross-functional project team.
  • Proficient with Microsoft Office applications and electronic quality/documentation systems.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

Physical Demands:

The physical demands described here are representative of the requirements that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to use a computer keyboard and mouse; reach with hands and arms; talk and listen. The employee is frequently required to walk and sit, as well as navigate production, utility, construction, and manufacturing areas. The employee may occasionally be required to stand for extended periods, climb stairs, stoop, kneel, or lift and carry objects weighing up to 25 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this position include close vision and the ability to adjust focus.

Work Environment:

The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Duties will be performed in a combination of office, laboratory, manufacturing, utility, and construction environments. The employee may be exposed to varying noise levels and active project areas while supporting field execution, system walkdowns, and qualification activities. Appropriate personal protective equipment (PPE) may be required when working in designated operational or construction environments.

TOTAL REWARDS PROGRAM:

We define total rewards as compensation, benefits, remote work/flexibility, development, recognition, and our culture with programs that support each of our reward pillars. This includes a market competitive base salary and annual incentive plan, robust benefit offerings, and ongoing recognition and career development opportunities. Employees also enjoy our generous flexible paid time off program, company-paid holidays, flexible working hours, and fully remote work options for most positions and the ability to work “almost anywhere.” However, if a physical work location is more for you, we have office locations in Greater Boston, San Diego, CA, Boulder, CO, and India.

COMPENSATION:

The expected salary range for this position is $120,000 to $140,000 yearly. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by law.

Currently, Syner-G is unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa at this time.

title: L3 IT Support Engineer (MSP)
description:
About Sharesource:

We are a BCorp company whose purpose is to democratise opportunities for individuals from developing countries. With our brand and culture empowering our partners to attract and keep the most qualified members, we share the knowledge to unleash potential and grow scaling teams for Australian and Canadian businesses.

What are we looking for?

We are seeking a Level 2 Technical Support Engineer to join the Modern Workplace team. This role combines escalated technical support, customer environment ownership, and practical Microsoft 365 service improvement across endpoint, identity, security, collaboration, and cloud services.

You will act as a trusted technical owner for assigned customer environments, keeping tickets moving, providing clear customer updates, identifying recurring issues, supporting small changes and project tasks, and knowing when to escalate with the right diagnostics and context.

While Level 3 engineers and technical leads provide architecture and complex escalation support, this role is expected to take day-to-day ownership, work with minimal supervision on standard troubleshooting, and help turn customer needs into practical service improvements.


What are you expected to do?

  • Customer Environment Ownership
    • Maintain technical visibility across assigned customer environments, including Microsoft 365, endpoint, identity, security, collaboration, risks, support history, and improvement opportunities.
    • Act as a trusted technical contact for assigned customers, providing clear updates, structured service discussions, and practical next steps.
    • Coordinate with Level 3 engineers, project resources, service management, and vendors to progress complex issues, small changes, and planned initiatives.
    • Identify recurring issues and improvement opportunities, then help turn them into practical remediation, better configuration, automation, governance, and adoption activities.
  • Technical Support & Escalation Management
    • Act as the escalation point from Level 1 for more complex support issues, taking ownership from triage through to resolution or appropriate escalation.
    • Plan and prioritise workload to minimise backlog, maintain ticket hygiene, complete accurate time entries and notes, and keep clients informed.
    • Escalate difficult or high-impact issues with clear diagnostics, business impact, attempted actions, and recommended next steps.

    • Use support activity, customer feedback, and ticket trends to improve service quality and reduce repeat issues.

  • Systems, Microsoft 365 & Cloud Operations

    • Provide desktop, device, software, connectivity, onboarding, and offboarding support across Windows, macOS, and Microsoft 365 environments.

    • Troubleshoot user, device, access, licensing, mailbox, Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive, and collaboration issues across assigned tenants.

    • Support endpoint management, device compliance, application deployment, and configuration tasks using Intune and related tools .

    • Assist with basic network triage including connectivity, DNS, DHCP, and LAN/WAN issues where required .

  • Microsoft 365 & Cloud Support

    • Administer and maintain assigned Microsoft 365 tenants under agreed standards, including user access, licensing, Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive, Intune, Entra ID, and security settings

    • Support identity and access tasks including MFA, group membership, mailbox permissions, Conditional Access triage, guest access, and basic security investigation and escalation

    • Contribute to Microsoft-focused improvement and project work, including tenant clean-up, endpoint management, collaboration, security, identity, and modern workplace configuration

  • Documentation & Continuous Improvement

    • Log incidents, service requests, time entries, customer updates, and escalation notes accurately in ConnectWise

    • Create and maintain customer environment notes, runbooks, known issue records, onboarding/offboarding steps, and handover documentation

    • Contribute to the team knowledge base and continually improve documentation so support knowledge is retained and shared across the team


You'll be a great fit if:

  • You have a minimum of 4 years of experience in a service desk, helpdesk, MSP, or technical support role.

  • You have strong working knowledge of Microsoft 365, including Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive, Intune, Entra ID, endpoint management, and core identity/security concepts.
  • You have experience supporting Windows and macOS users, devices, access, collaboration tools, and cloud services across multiple customer environments.
  • You have clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to provide confident customer updates and translate technical activity into clear actions.
  • You have the ability to triage, prioritise, and manage multiple tickets, customers, and competing priorities with good judgement and follow-through.
  • You have a strong ownership mindset, including accurate documentation, proactive communication, and the ability to work through standard troubleshooting without constant supervision.
  • You are comfortable working in a multi-tenant MSP environment with high context switching and varied customer maturity levels.
  • You have familiarity with ConnectWise or similar ITSM/PSA platforms, including ticket notes, time entries, statuses, and escalation records.
  • You have experience supporting customer environments, service improvement actions, small changes, or technical coordination activities, which is highly regarded.


﻿Required Certifications:

  • Microsoft AZ-900, Azure Fundamentals

  • Microsoft MS-900, Microsoft 365 Fundamentals

  • Microsoft SC-900, Security Fundamentals


What you gain beyond the role:

  • Remote + Hybrid Flexibility: Enjoy the best of both worlds—collaborative office days when it counts, balanced with the freedom to work from home.
  • Achieve Work-Life Balance and Flexibility: Work in an environment where you're trusted and empowered to work independently, while still having the support you need to deliver your best. Here, flexibility isn't just a perk—its how we help you perform at your best, without sacrificing life outside of work.
  • Open Culture: Your voice matters, we encourage proactive communication and fresh ideas.
  • Supportive Team: From your very first day to every career milestone, we've got your back—with long-term growth and projects you can truly thrive in.
  • Learn and Grow: Training, coaching, and international opportunities to level up your skills and career
  • Be part of a B-Corp company that puts people and planet first while creating meaningful impact.

Please note: This role is remote; however, we require candidates to be based locally in the Philippines. This is to support occasional onsite activities such as team events, client meetings, or equipment handover. Additionally, local residency is necessary for compliance with Philippines labor laws and employment regulations.

___________________
Why work for Sharesource?

Our clients come from all walks of life and so do we. We hire hundreds of skillful individuals from a wide variety of backgrounds, genders, and personalities to live out our diverse culture and make a positive impact on the world!

Our 5 Values:

  • Make a social impact: We balance our work for client teams and for society by constantly making a positive impact.
  • Be proactive: We encourage brave thinking and continuous improvement, and drive change through action.
  • Create value: We create measurable values for our stakeholders: our teams, partners, suppliers, investors, and communities.
  • Be fair, open and honest: We foster equality and inclusivity in a supportive environment that embraces diversity and celebrates achievements.

  • Add fun, passion and love: We priorities fun and passion, fostering higher engagement and a positive can-do attitude.

___________________
What to Expect in the Process

  • You'll go through 2-3 interviews plus a possible assessment with our client partner. This includes an initial chat, a culture-fit interview, and 1–2 conversations with our awesome client. The whole process usually takes 2-3 weeks, but we'll let you know if things need to move quicker.
  • Our best advice? Be yourself and enjoy the conversations. Well keep you updated every step of the way, and you're always welcome to reach out for updates anytime.
  • If all goes well, well complete reference checks and requirements quickly—so we can get that job offer to you without delay.

We would be grateful if you have these already:

  1. Fit to Work/Health Card (Basic 5 employment medical tests)

  2. NBI Clearance

  3. Social IDs - PHIC, SSS, HDMF, TIN

  4. Character references with contact info

At Sharesource, we believe in the value of diversity and inclusion. We are committed to creating a diverse, respectful, and inclusive workplace, and we do not discriminate based on factors such as race, gender, religion, sexual orientation, or disability.

title: Senior/ Lead Product Manager - Government on Commercial Cloud (GCC)
description:
The Government Technology Agency (GovTech) is the lead agency driving Singapore’s Smart Nation initiatives and public sector digital transformation. As the Centre of Excellence for Infocomm Technology and Smart Systems (ICT & SS), GovTech develops the Singapore Government’s capabilities in Data Science & Artificial Intelligence, Application Development, Smart City Technology, Digital Infrastructure, and Cybersecurity.

At GovTech, we offer you a purposeful career to make lives better. We empower our people to master their craft through continuous and robust learning and development opportunities all year round. Our GovTechies embody our Agile, Bold and Collaborative values to deliver impactful solutions.

GovTech aims to transform the delivery of Government digital services by taking an "outside-in" view, putting citizens and businesses at the heart of everything we do.

Play a part in Singapore’s vision to build a Smart Nation and embark on your meaningful journey to build tech for public good. Join us to advance our mission and shape your future with us today!

Learn more about GovTech at tech.gov.sg.

Government on Commercial Cloud (GCC) is a "wrapper" platform facilitating government agencies in swiftly and securely adopting commercial cloud solutions from Amazon Web Services (AWS), Microsoft Azure and Google Cloud Platform (GCP) at a lower cost. GCC allows Singapore government agencies to tap on commercial cloud software and cloud native services – provided by multinational conglomerates – to incorporate advanced functionalities into their applications, leading to faster delivery of secure and seamless digital government services for Citizens and Businesses. GCC comprises a suite of products such as GCC 2.0, GCC+, GCC Lite, BaaS+, GCC Pulse and Cloud Management Portal (CMP).

[What you will be working on]

What you will own:

You will own the management of a GCC product through its entire Product Life Cycle.


What you are expected to do:

As a GCC Senior/ Lead Product Manager, you are expected to fulfil these three key areas of responsibility:


Drive Product Strategy and Continuous Feature Development.
Set the product vision and proactively lead the development of product roadmaps that anticipate user needs and align with Programme strategy.

Drive User Adoption.
Own, develop and implement the go-to-market (GTM) strategy of your assigned GCC Product.

Ensure Long-Term Business Viability and Sustainability of your product by maintaining strong oversight on its fiscal health and progress towards delivering its specific strategic goals and desired outcomes.


You will do this by:

Product Strategy and Continuous Feature Development

  • Set the product vision and develop long-term roadmaps, including coordinating across teams to deliver.

  • Conduct regular focus group discussions to understand user requirements and gather user pain points to iteratively improve GCC product features.

  • Maintain technology watch of the latest cloud infrastructure innovation and build strong collaborative relationships with strategic industry partners to leverage their forefront cloud native services and products to enhance GCC’s cloud infrastructure capability.

  • Work with GCC Core Engineering Team to prioritise engineering resources in the implementation of product feature enhancements, recognising tradeoffs between speed and long-term technical debt.

Drive User Adoption

  • Conduct regular webinars and change management sessions for agency users to drive better understanding and correct use of GCC products and their features to aid in their development of secure and seamless digital government services.

  • Work with the central Document Enablement Team in the development of product documentation to reduce user friction during their adoption journey.

  • Work with GCC Solution Engineering Team to address user queries on GCC Products and engage agency users.


Ensure Long-Term Business Viability and Sustainability

  • Be responsible for the budget and finance planning to ensure a healthy P&L for the GCC Product.

  • Conduct regular product pricing reviews based on adoption rate and operating cost to ensure it is fairly priced and yet generates sufficient revenue to cover the operating cost as a central platform product.

  • Provide GovTech Management with timely updates on the performance of the product through monthly OKR reporting and product scorecard.


[What we are looking for]

We are looking for a strategic product leader who thrives in a fast-paced and high-pressure environment and is versatile, able to operate across individual contribution, team leadership and cross-functional collaboration. In particular, a candidate with the following skillsets and attributes:

  • 6 to 8 years’ experience in managing cloud infrastructure and/or tech stack products, with at least 2 years in a product leadership role. Years of experience are a rough guideline. We are also open to exceptional candidates who demonstrate strong strategic thinking, product leadership, and a track record of delivering impact at scale.

  • Deep expertise in commercial cloud, cloud GenAI Platforms, and Day-2 operations of cloud-hosted systems.

  • Proven ability to set product vision, develop long-term roadmaps, and translate programme strategy into actionable product plans

  • Strong stakeholder management and communications skills with the ability to navigate complex matrix relationships and resolve competing priorities. You must be comfortable making presentations to senior management on a regular basis.

  • Strong command of Agile development methodology and OKR framework.

  • Sharp business development acumen with experience in P&L ownership and product pricing strategy.

What we offer you:

GovTech is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive workplace that values diverse voices and perspectives, as we believe that diversity is the foundation to innovation.

Our employee benefits are based on a total rewards approach, offering a holistic and market-competitive suite of perks. These include leave benefits to meet your work-life needs and employee wellness programs.

We champion flexible work arrangements (subject to your job role) and trust that you will manage your own time to deliver your best, wherever you are, and whatever works best for you.
