title: Head of Platform Engineering
description:
About Reducto

Reducto is the agentic document platform for leading AI teams who demand enterprise performance at scale. We provide a comprehensive toolkit for working with documents the way a human would, combining custom in-house and leading frontier models to power efficient and accurate document workflows.

We’ve grown rapidly, increasing revenue 8x year over year and partnering with hundreds of companies, from leading AI teams like Harvey, Vanta, and Scale, to enterprise customers across FAANG and top trading firms.

Reducto has raised over $100M from world-class investors including a16z, Benchmark, and First Round Capital.

The Role

Reducto's platform is what turns a customer's document into a result. Underneath it is advanced job orchestration, document pre and post processing, reliable and fast model inference, along with the deployment platforms that let a bank or an insurer run all of it inside their own environment. We process a billion pages a month, and the customers driving that volume run us in production on workflows where a failure is their incident as much as ours. We're hiring a Head of Platform Engineering that will own the reliability of the platform, shape the future direction, and build the team that executes it.

This is a hands-on role. You'll be in design reviews, on incidents, and in the code when it unblocks the team, and you'll spend your first few months shipping as an engineer alongside the team before you fully take on leading it. As AI makes it easier to write code, the expectation that you can solve the hard problems yourself becomes more of the norm.

You'll report to our VP of Engineering and work directly with our founders.

We would love to meet you if you:

  • Operating record: You have at least 3 years of experience owning reliability, latency, and efficiency for a platform of significant scale, and you can talk about the numbers you moved and how.

  • Hands-on: You've been in hands-on roles recently, and you're comfortable writing design docs, writing code, and reviewing your team's code with a critical eye.

  • Hiring: You have a track record of attracting, hiring, and retaining top tier talent, and you can point to people you brought in who are still doing their best work.

  • Ambiguity: You can find your bearings in environments that move extremely fast and where not everything is spelled out yet. Generally this looks like having done 0 to 1 as a founder, a founding engineer, or the person who started a greenfield project and carried it through.

  • Ownership: You expect to own the roadmap and the technical decision making for your team, and you'd rather bring both to planning than be handed them.

  • Stack: You're familiar with infrastructure-as-code and containerized deployments, and you've operated them in production.

  • Bar: You have a high bar for how things are done technically, you hold your team to it, and you apply it to your own work first.

  • Curiosity: You're deeply curious and eager to learn new technology, stacks, and products, including the ones we haven't picked yet.

The Core Work Will Include:

  • Owning Reducto's serving platform end to end, from job orchestration and document pre/post processing through model inference, autoscaling, and throttling, including finishing an in-flight migration of the serving stack

  • Building out how we deploy and serve Reducto to customer clouds and on-premise environments

  • Building the observability that tells us and our customers what the platform is doing, and using it to drive alerting, incident response, and the reliability, latency, and cost-per-document numbers the team is measured on

  • Owning the platform roadmap and the technical decisions behind it, and sourcing and recruiting the platform engineers who will execute it

  • Working with our Product engineering team to build and scale our agent runtimes and environments

  • Building our internal data platform that serves internal users and customers

  • Working closely with our ML and Product engineering teams to roll out new models and deployment capabilities

Bonus points if you

  • Have served ML models, particularly vision-language models, at scale

  • Have built data platforms for internal users and ML teams

  • Have built, shipped, and managed on-premise deployments

  • Have experience with agent sandboxes, harnesses, and evaluations

This is an in person role at our office in SF. We're an early stage company which means that the role requires working hard and moving quickly. Please only apply if that excites you.

About Reducto

Nearly 80% of enterprise data is in unstructured formats like PDFs

PDFs are the status quo for enterprise knowledge in nearly every industry. Insurance claims, financial statements, invoices, and health records are all stored in a structure that’s simply impractical for use in digital workflows. This isn’t an inconvenience—it’s a critical bottleneck that leads to dozens of wasted hours every week.

Traditional approaches fail at reliably extracting information in complex PDFs

OCR and even more sophisticated ML approaches work for simple text documents but are unreliable for anything more complex. Text from different columns are jumbled together, figures are ignored, and tables are a nightmare to get right. Overcoming this usually requires a large engineering effort dedicated to building specialized pipelines for every document type you work with.

Reducto breaks document layouts into subsections and then contextually parses each depending on the type of content. This is made possible by a combination of vision models, LLMs, and a suite of heuristics we built over time. Put simply, we can help you:

  • Accurately extract text and tables even with nonstandard layouts

  • Automatically convert graphs to tabular data and summarize images in documents

  • Extract important fields from complex forms with simple, natural language instructions

  • Build powerful retrieval pipelines using Reducto’s document metadata

  • Intelligently chunk information using the document’s layout data

Benefits at Reducto

At Reducto, we’re invested in the well-being and growth of our team. Here’s what we currently offer:

  • Unlimited PTO: We believe great work requires recharging.

  • Lunch: Receive a free lunch to eat with your teammates daily at the office

  • Reimbursed Transportation: Provide us with your receipts and we’ll take care of the costs

  • Insurance: Generous health insurance covering medical, dental, and vision.

  • Health and Wellness Budget: We provide up to $150/mo reimbursement for health and wellness spending, such as gym memberships, fitness classes, or similar.

  • Parental Leave: Work with us to build a leave schedule that works for you and your family

Reducto is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, race, color, age, national origin, religion, physical and mental disability, genetic information, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity/assignment, citizenship, pregnancy or maternity, protected veteran status, or any other status prohibited by applicable national, federal, state or local law.

title: Software Engineer
description:
About us

Core Flow AI Pty Ltd is an Australian technology company operating in the artificial intelligence sector. The business develops AI-powered technology solutions, including software, automation and intelligent systems to support business operations and product development. Core Flow AI Pty Ltd is one of the fastest-growing startups globally, serving 20 million users in our first year. We are an in-person company based in Sydney, Australia.

Role Overview

The position involves designing and developing scalable backend services, APIs and data pipelines, implementing new product features, integrating AI models and third-party technologies, and contributing to system architecture, performance, security and reliability. The role is focused on delivering personalised, interactive AI experiences to the company's 20 million users, supported by broader full-stack product development.

Key responsibilities

1. AI/ML Integration & AI Product Engineering

• Integrate advanced AI/ML models (chat, image, and video generation) into consumer-facing products.

• Collaborate with product and AI teams to deliver personalised, interactive AI experiences.

• Design and build the backend services, APIs, and data pipelines that serve AI/ML models in production.

• Experiment with and evaluate new AI technologies (e.g., generative AI models, AI/ML tooling, cloud AI services) to drive product innovation.

2. Product Development & Feature Implementation

• Design, build, and maintain scalable software solutions to support the startup’s core product and user needs.

• Collaborate with product managers and designers to translate requirements into functional, efficient code.

• Rapidly prototype and iterate on features based on user feedback and business priorities.

• Develop and maintain high-quality, scalable software and services using TypeScript.

• Contribute to the full product lifecycle: from discovery and UX research to development, API integration, and release.

3. System Architecture & Scalability

• Develop and optimize backend services, APIs, and databases to ensure performance and reliability.

• Design and implement secure, scalable backend services and APIs.

• Implement best practices for code maintainability, testing, and deployment (CI/CD).

• Troubleshoot and resolve bottlenecks in infrastructure as the company scales.

• Ensure code quality, application security, and performance across core systems.

4. Cross-Functional Collaboration & Support

• Work closely with frontend engineers to integrate UI components with backend logic.

• Assist in debugging and resolving production issues across the stack.

• Research and integrate third-party tools, libraries, or frameworks to accelerate development.

• Prepare technical documentation and support knowledge handover across the engineering team.


Qualification requirements

• A bachelor’s degree or higher qualification.

OR

• At least five years of relevant experience and/or relevant vendor certification may substitute for the formal qualification.

Experience & Other Requirements

• At least 1 year of relevant experience in a similar field.

• Database management & query optimization.

• Cross-functional leadership.

• Engineering mentorship: secure coding, API integration, performance best practices.

Salary and location

The duties will be performed at the company’s Sydney office at Level 6, 77 Pacific Highway, North Sydney NSW 2060. The attractive salary is offered per annum, exclusive of superannuation, with compulsory superannuation contributions paid in addition.

Only eligible and short-listed applicants will be considered.

title: Account Director - Korea (Beauty)
description:
About WPP Production

We are WPP Production - the unified global production company that brings together all of WPP's content producers, studios and craft experts into one connected organisation. We combine world-class human craft with next generation technology to originate, design, and deliver multi-channel content systems at scale. Built for borderless collaboration and powered by deep craft expertise, we are the production engine designed for today's always on, AI driven marketing world.

About WPP

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com.

The Role: This is a double-hatted role: you lead a brand category across the region, and you are the local market lead where you're based. As Category Lead, you drive priorities and delivery standards for your category everywhere it operates, working with your counterparts in the other markets to keep quality and approach consistent. As Local Market Lead, you own the day-to-day client relationship in your market. You're the person the client calls, the one accountable for what gets delivered, and the person expected to know that market's language, platforms, and regulatory landscape well enough to catch problems before the client has to. PMs report directly to you.

What You'll Own

Category expertise

  • Drive priorities and delivery standards for your category across every market it touches, not just your own
  • Build category-specific knowledge that outlasts any single campaign
  • Mirror the category-cluster model our media partner already runs, so category strategy and media planning move together, not separately

Quality and brand integrity

  • Review global and regional toolkits and judge, realistically, what can be adapted and how given local platform and regulatory requirements
  • Hold the line on brand compliance and quality even under deadline pressure

Local market ownership

  • Serve as the single point of contact for adaptation and delivery in your market, brief through delivery
  • Own the local partnership and act as gatekeeper for commercial terms specific to your market
  • Ensure governance cadence is followed, e.g. weekly delivery syncs, monthly reviews, escalating on schedule rather than only when something breaks
  • Identify and resolve local delivery challenges before they become client-facing issues

Alignment with Media

  • Make sure adaptation work is aligned to Media's confirmed plan, not created independently and forced into it afterward
  • Embed local platform and cultural knowledge into what gets adapted and how
  • Flag early where a market's platform requirements or regulatory constraints affect what's realistically deliverable

Team leadership

  • Lead your PMs directly and manage workload, quality, and growth
  • Set a standard the team wants to meet, not just comply with
  • Flex team capacity as volume and campaign complexity shift versus running a fixed structure regardless of demand

Commercial and operational rigor

  • Own volume and budget scoping for your market — translating expected campaign volume into resourcing needs, and contributing meaningfully to forecasting and budgeting conversations
  • Track performance against agreed KPIs, adjusting resourcing or approach as real demand data comes in
  • Apply financial compliance procedures correctly as a matter of course

Escalation and judgement

  • Act as the escalation point for your market — resolving what can be resolved locally, and knowing precisely what needs to go to the Regional Lead instead of guessing
  • Bring recommended solutions to escalations, not just the problem

What You'll Need

  • 6+ years in account or category leadership within content production or adaptation, ideally agency-side
  • Genuine fluency in your local market: language, culture, and regulatory nuance
  • Beauty or prestige category experience
  • Experience managing AMs/PMs or junior team members directly, not just contributing individually
  • Experience partnering closely with a media agency to deliver genuinely integrated outcomes
  • Strong commercial acumen, i.e. comfortable with cost estimates, budgets, and contractual terms
  • Sound negotiation and problem-solving skills, exercised under real time pressure

#LI-SY1

Why work here:
At WPP Production, you’ll help shape the future of content production at a truly global scale. We bring together world-class talent, cutting-edge studios, and advanced technology to solve some of the most complex creative and production challenges in the industry. You’ll work in a collaborative, borderless environment where craft excellence is valued, innovation is encouraged, and AI and next-generation tools are used to amplify not replace human creativity. With access to diverse projects, global career opportunities, and the backing of WPP’s unmatched network, this is a place where you can grow your skills, make real impact, and create work that performs for every audience, across every channel, at every moment.

  • Werken in de praktijk bij Careyn, op een intramurale locatie of binnen een wijkteam.

  • Opdoen van gevorderde en gespecialiseerde verpleegkundige kennis en deze toepassen in de praktijk.

  • Verlenen van zorg aan ouderen in (hoog)complexe zorgsituaties en uitvoeren van zorgleefplannen.

  • Samenwerken met cliënten, mantelzorgers en (para)medici aan behoud van regie en gezondheid.

Wat werken in dit team aantrekkelijk maakt

Je gaat aan de slag binnen Utrecht Stad, waar Careyn een breed aanbod van intramurale locaties en wijkteams heeft. De doelgroep is divers: van zelfstandig wonende ouderen tot bewoners met complexe zorgvragen. Je werkt samen met betrokken collega’s in een professionele en warme omgeving, waarbij je de kans krijgt om te leren van ervaren zorgprofessionals en je te ontwikkelen tot hbo Verpleegkundige.

Wat je van ons mag verwachten

  • Salaris volgens cao VVT, FWG 50: € 3.324 - € 3.502 (o.b.v. 36 uur).

  • Een leerarbeidsovereenkomst voor 24 tot 32 uur per week, met uitzicht op een vaste aanstelling na het afronden van je opleiding.

  • Reiskostenvergoeding, 8% vakantietoeslag en 8,33% eindejaarsuitkering.

  • Mogelijkheid om gebruik te maken van het meerkeuzesysteem, zoals extra verlof of een fietsregeling.

  • Toegang tot o.a. HeyCoach, budgetcoach en DigiCoach voor jouw ontwikkeling.

  • Bij Careyn krijg je meer dan de arbeidsvoorwaarden uit de cao VVT. Meer weten? Bekijk onze arbeidsvoorwaarden.

Bij Careyn begint goede zorg met goed werkgeverschap, daarom zetten we jou op 1. Jij krijgt vertrouwen, ruimte om zelfstandig te werken en mee te denken. We zorgen voor een goede werk-privébalans, zodat jij je werk met plezier kunt doen.

Om de veiligheid van onze cliënten en medewerkers te waarborgen, is voor alle medewerkers die bij Careyn in dienst komen een Verklaring Omtrent Gedrag (VOG) vereist. Bij gelijke geschiktheid krijgen interne sollicitanten voorrang ten opzichte van externe kandidaten.

title: Domain Architect - Telco, Network & Infrastructure

An experienced Domain Architect with broad technical exposure across telecommunications, networking and infrastructure environments. You will have a track record of developing architecture strategies and roadmaps within complex, highly available or critical environments.

title: Compliance Specialist
description:
itsme® has fundamentally changed how people lead their digital lives in Belgium, but we are not stopping there! Do you want to be a driving force to help expand on this success story as part of a talented team that is making a positive impact on society? Then keep on reading, you’ll probably like what you’ll see.

We are itsme®, one of Europe’s fastest-growing scale-ups, with 150 team members and growing. Our mission: to provide a state-of-the-art digital identity solution for all people, enabling them to interact securely in the digital space. Now, only nine years after being founded, close to 8 million citizens use the itsme® app to identify themselves and sign documents online. Starting in Belgium, we successfully launched the itsme app in 32 European countries, with the ambition of becoming an internationally leading player.

We are looking for a Compliance Specialist whose mission will be to validate itsme® compliance to the different frameworks that we have to abide to, such as eIDAS – the regulation on Electronic Identity and Signatures – but also GDPR, NIS2, CRA, AI and the frameworks our customers are looking at such as PSD3, PSR and DORA.

The primary objective of the role is to provide assurance that itsme's products, services and operations remain demonstrably compliant with applicable regulatory and contractual requirements. You help the organisation translate requirements into controls, validate their effectiveness and ensure that compliance can be evidenced towards regulators, auditors, customers and partners.

What your job looks like

· Take a pivotal role in the Compliance, Risk and Audit department, working alongside experts in the field of Information Security, Privacy and Compliance;

· Analyse the impact of new legislation and standards on products, processes and operational controls;

· Ensure traceability between (new) requirements, controls and supporting evidence;

· Assist product and operational teams with implementations of new features to bring them in line with the applicable Belgian and European frameworks;

· Produce assurance reports for management and governance bodies;

· Prepare, lead and assist in regular audits, both internal and external, to provide transparency about our continued compliance, and produce the evidences that underpin our commitments to the market;

Background and experience

· A bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience

· Proven work experience of 5 years or more in on e or more of the following domains: Electronic Identity, Electronic Signatures, Fintech or RegTech organisations, Personal Data Processing, Compliance Assessments, Policy and Process implementations, or similar areas of expertise.

· Experience in environments where compliance, resilience, personal data protection, information security are of utmost importance.

· Experience with GRC, compliance automation and/or evidence management platforms

· Holder of an auditor certification in eIDAS, ISO27701, 27001 or other equivalent frameworks will be a plus.

· Prior experience in the application of ETSI ESI Standards in the field of Identity Proofing and/or Electronic Signatures are a plus

· A strong and convincing communicator, you know how to deal with a multitude of stakeholders on different hierarchical levels both in- and outside itsme®.

· Writing skills include the development of clear, concise and pragmatic guidelines in policies, procedures and instructions for colleagues & suppliers

Competences

· You are comfortable challenging business and technology stakeholders in a constructive manner and can defend compliance positions using risk-based reasoning

· You take ownership of your projects and reach out to your colleagues

· You have an open and flexible mindset and can act as a go-to-person

· You are able to think strategically and maintain a helicopter view

· You are a team player who shares knowledge and enjoys celebrating joint achievements

· Languages: You are fluent in English. Dutch and/or French are a plus.

What we offer

  • Being welcomed by an informal, enthusiastic, and ambitious team that is revolutionising how we safely manage our digital identity, in Belgium & beyond.

  • Offices within walking distance from Brussels Central Station, with the possibility to work remotely 3 days a week.

  • A contract of indefinite duration, with an attractive compensation package.

  • An environment where we care a lot about our core values:

    • Impact: Lead by example and create positive influence.

    • Resourcefulness: Connect, mobilise, and collaborate across ecosystems.

    • Curiosity: Explore, learn, and challenge the status quo.

    • Scale: Build strong foundations for sustainable growth.

    • Humble: Respect, listen, and embrace feedback for growth.

Purpose: The Integration Center serves as a critical component of the development lifecycle and ensuring seamless operations before product deployments or release to customers.

Scope: The Integration Center is a specialized environment where various components, systems, technologies are integrated, tested, and validated. The Integration Center is responsible for meeting quality standards, performance expectations and customer requirements before deployment.


Our Integration Center is made up of the following roles: Chief Operating Officer, Integration Center Manager, Technical Processing Engineer, Technical Lead, Technical Lead Coordinator, Maintenance Coordinator, Integration Technicians I-III


Responsibilities:

Integration Testing: Integrates different hardware and software components, subsystems, or modules to verify interoperability and functionality.


System Validation: Tests and validates integrated systems or solutions to ensure they meet performance, reliability, and compatibility requirements.


Prototyping and Development: Supports the development and prototyping of new products or solutions by providing a controlled environment for testing and refinement.


Test Lanes: Configures physical and virtual test environments with equipment, tools, and simulation software necessary for integration and testing.


Infrastructure: Provides network connectivity and infrastructure to simulate real-world deployment scenarios and connectivity requirements.


Functional Testing: Conducts functional testing to verify that integrated systems or components perform according to specifications and requirements.


Performance Testing: Measures and evaluates the performance metrics of integrated systems under various conditions (e.g., load testing, stress testing).


Compatibility Testing: Ensures compatibility with existing systems, platforms, or third-party components that the integrated solution may interact with.


Security Testing: Assesses the security posture of integrated systems to identify vulnerabilities and ensure compliance with security standards.


Project Management: Manages integration projects, schedules, and resources to ensure timely completion of testing and validation activities.


Documentation: Maintains comprehensive documentation of integration processes, test results, configurations, and any issues encountered during testing.


Quality Control: Implements quality control measures to maintain high standards of product or solution integrity and reliability.

title: Staff Autonomy Software Engineer, Localization
description:
Kodiak Robotics, Inc. was founded in 2018 and has become a leader in autonomous ground transportation committed to a safer and more efficient future for all. The company has developed an artificial intelligence (AI) powered technology stack purpose-built for commercial trucking and the public sector. The company delivers freight daily for its customers across the southern United States using its autonomous technology. In 2024, Kodiak became the first known company to publicly announce delivering a driverless semi-truck to a customer. Kodiak is also leveraging its commercial self-driving software to develop, test and deploy autonomous capabilities for the U.S. Department of Defense.

We are looking for a Staff Engineer on our Calibration, Localization and Mapping (CLAM) team — a technical leader with deep expertise in state estimation, inertial navigation, and sensed odometry who can set technical direction across the team and organization.

In this role, you will:

  • Set the technical strategy and architecture for our onboard navigation and pose estimation systems.
  • Lead the design and development of advanced sensor fusion and pose estimation approaches across IMU, camera, and lidar sensors, anticipating failure modes before they arise in the field.
  • Drive the direction of visual and lidar odometry algorithms, including evaluating build-vs-adopt tradeoffs for new techniques.
  • Define and evangelize navigation metrics and evaluation methodology used across the org to assess algorithm and system performance.
  • Serve as a technical escalation point for complex, ambiguous, or cross-cutting localization problems.
  • Evaluate sensor performance and optimize sensor selection.
  • Verify correct sensor calibrations, settings, and uncertainty characterizations.

What you’ll bring:

  • Strong technical background. BS, MS or PhD with academic or industry experience in building navigation, localization, and odometry systems.
  • Expert in C++ and strong problem-solving skills.
  • Strong software engineering skills and experience building high-reliability deployed applications . You write well-designed, highly maintainable code. Code is your craft.
  • Deep experience transforming raw sensor data from GNSS, IMU, wheel speed, etc. into 6-DOF pose using Kalman Filtering, factor graphs, or comparable state estimation techniques — and judgment on when each approach is appropriate.
  • Experience with computer vision, visual odometry, and/or odometry from point clouds
  • A history of mentoring engineers and elevating the technical practices of a team.
  • A team player. You take ownership and work with the team to deliver exceptional results. You are interested in the performance of the entire system across engineering disciplines.
  • Ability to build and iterate quickly. You enjoy working fast and smart, and you are comfortable in defining and building lasting infrastructure components from scratch.
  • Hands on. Curious. Flexible. Interested in new domains to expand your horizons and provide a complete system wide solution.
  • Great communicator. You have experience writing clear, concise design documentation to gather feedback from across the team to find the best solution.

What we offer:

  • Competitive compensation package including equity and annual bonuses
  • Excellent Medical, Dental, and Vision plans through Kaiser Permanente, Cigna, and MetLife (including a medical plan with infertility benefits)
  • MetLife Legal Services, Identity & Fraud Protection, Hospital Indemnity Insurance, Accident Insurance, & Critical Illness Insurance
  • Flexible PTO, 10 paid holidays, and generous parental leave policies
  • Our office is centrally located in Mountain View, CA
  • Office perks: dog-friendly, free catered lunch, a fully stocked kitchen, and free EV charging
  • Long Term Disability, Short Term Disability, Life Insurance
  • Wellbeing Benefits - Headspace through Cigna, Calm through Kaiser, One Medical, Gympass, Spring Health through Cigna, Rula (mental health navigation)
  • Fidelity 401(k)
  • Commuter, FSA, Dependent Care FSA, HSA
  • Various incentive programs (referral bonuses, patent bonuses, etc.)

The pay range listed below reflects the base salary in our SF/Silicon Valley location, across several internal levels. Actual starting pay will be based on job-related factors including: work location, experience, relevant training, education, skill level and performance during interview. Total compensation at Kodiak includes base pay, equity, bonus and a competitive benefits package

title: Physical Implementation Engineer– Machine Learning
description:
Job Description:

Are you passionate about improving hardware efficiency and helping Arm and its partners to build outstanding products? This role offers a great chance to enter Machine Learning and Artificial Intelligence. These are crucial technologies shaping the future of computing. By working with sophisticated Arm IP, you will help build technology that supports the next wave of mobile apps, portable devices, home automation, smart cities, and autonomous vehicles.

Responsibilities:

Within our growing and versatile team, you’ll contribute to the development and verification of groundbreaking ML and Neural Network hardware. Collaborating with experts across global build centers, you’ll drive impactful projects and help deliver Arm’s next-generation IP using the most sophisticated tools and methodologies. Meeting Area, Frequency, and Power requirements with a reasonable runtime is one of most important activities we encounter.

As a hardware Physical Implementation Engineer, you will contribute significantly by:

  • Identify critical bottlenecks across IP development, performing accurate trade-off between the various PPA metrics of the designs (frequency, power, area).
  • Analyzing and optimizing power for our next generation IP, using innovative technologies, methodologies and tools.
  • Providing high-quality timing, power and area analysis and recommendations to design teams, with opportunities to take increasing ownership of PPA optimization and technical direction depending on experience.
  • Supporting our partners to achieve the best PPA results.
  • Liaise with other implementation groups to improve implementation flow alignment across the company.
  • Working with the latest technology nodes and EDA Tool Suite offerings from Synopsys, Cadence and Mentor.

  • A university degree or equivalent experience in Electrical Engineering or a similar subject.
  • Knowledge of digital hardware and some hardware description language (VHDL, Verilog and SystemVerilog).
  • Knowledge of Physical Implementation flow from RTL through Synthesis, Place & Route, LEC and STA.
  • In depth understanding and hands-on experience in balancing trade-offs for PPA.
  • Ability to plan/make estimates and timeline for physical implementation related activities.
  • A high level of pro-activity, initiative and problem solving skills.

Preferred Skills and Experience:

  • Understanding of low power build features and techniques, including clock and power gating, voltage/frequency scaling, memory/logic retention.
  • Experience in scripting flows using combination of Python, TCL, Bash and MAKE.
  • Experience in RTL simulation and verification.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Knowledge of machine learning / AI fundamentals.
  • Knowledge/Interest in building AI agents for a physical implementation workflow.

At Arm, you will join a world-class team committed to pushing boundaries and reaching ambitious goals.   • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Systems Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

Years of experience: Minimum 10 years of experience in systems engineering, interface management, design coordination, technical project integration, or a related role in a complex multidisciplinary environment.

description:
SYSTRA Canada is part of the SYSTRA group, an international consulting and engineering group, a world leader in the design of transport infrastructures. SYSTRA Canada is an engineering and consulting firm whose primary focus is to offer transportation solutions, whether for passengers or goods: feasibility studies of building a new railway line, increasing the capacity of the existing infrastructure, privatization of a railway.

Context

The Multidisciplinary Technical Coordinator is responsible for coordinating the technical development and interface management of a defined Sector of the Alto project across multiple civil and infrastructure disciplines. This role ensures that the design and technical deliverables for all linear infrastructures disciplines such as alignment, roadworks, railway bridges, bridges, geotechnic, earthworks, utilities, landscape, hydrology and drainage are fully coordinated with the others workstreams’ scope (Rail Systems and Rolling Stock, Environment, Facilities, Stations, …), supporting an integrated and buildable project outcome.

The position acts as a central technical focal point for cross-disciplinary coordination within the section, helping to identify interface risks, resolve design conflicts, and maintain alignment between discipline teams, project requirements, and delivery milestones. A key part of the role is to drive technical collaboration and support proactive coordination with the BIM Coordinator for model integration, clash detection, and resolution of geometric and spatial conflicts.

Missions/Main Duties

The coordinator manages the multidisciplinary technical interfaces within the assigned Alto's sector and ensures consistent communication between the involved design teams. The role supports the technical alignment of alignment, roadworks, railway bridges, bridges, geotechnic, earthworks, utilities, landscape, hydrology and drainage packages with all others workstreams’ requirements, and associated corridor constraints.

The role includes reviewing discipline outputs to confirm that designs are compatible, technically sound, and coordinated at all relevant interfaces.

The coordinator facilitates regular technical coordination meetings with internal teams and relevant stakeholders to track interface issues, review progress, and drive timely resolution of conflicts. The role is expected to maintain visibility over key technical risks and escalate critical issues where necessary.

Close collaboration with the BIM Coordinator is required to support federated model reviews, multidisciplinary coordination workflows, and clash detection processes. The coordinator helps ensure that discipline models are developed in accordance with project standards, submitted in a timely manner for integration, and reviewed to identify and resolve clashes, inconsistencies, and constructability concerns.

Key Technical Focus Areas

The role places particular emphasis on multidisciplinary interface coordination in the high-speed rail environment. Strong attention is required for:

  • Corridor constraints, including alignment, gradient, and clearance for high-speed operations, as well as spatial compatibility with OCS, and dynamic envelope requirements.
  • Utility and infrastructure interactions, such as power supply systems, signaling, drainage, and road/railway geometry interfaces to ensure seamless integration and operational efficiency.

Profile/Skills

Education: Civil Engineering degree.

Years of experience: 10-15 years of relevant experience

Technical competencies:

The role requires relevant experience in multidisciplinary design coordination on major infrastructure or rail/transit projects, preferably within HSR, metro, railway.

Candidates should demonstrate experience working across several infrastructure disciplines and managing technical interfaces in a complex project environment.Familiarity with BIM-based coordination processes and experience collaborating with BIM teams on clash detection and model reviews is highly desirable.

Clear verbal and written communication skills, both in French and in English.*

*Reasons for requiring bilingualism: You will have the opportunity to work with a varied clientele, including both French- and English-speaking companies. Bilingualism is therefore fundamental to building strong relationships with our customers, understanding their specific needs, communicating effectively in their preferred language and facilitating strategic meetings.

Personal and soft skills :

The successful candidate should have strong technical coordination skills and the ability to understand how different infrastructure disciplines interact within a constrained project corridor. Good communication and facilitation skills are essential, as the role requires regular interaction with multiple technical teams and stakeholders.

The role also requires sound problem-solving ability, attention to detail, and the capacity to manage competing technical priorities while maintaining project deadlines. A collaborative mindset is essential, particularly in supporting integrated design reviews and working effectively with the BIM Coordinator and discipline teams.

Power Integrations stands apart in the Philippine talent market through its unique combination of power electronics and power semiconductor technology, enabling engineers to work across the complete innovation cycle, from semiconductor device physics to system-level power conversion solutions. Unlike many companies that focus on only one domain, Power Integrations offers exposure to both advanced semiconductor design and real-world power electronics applications, creating a rare and highly valuable engineering experience.

Power Integrations develops the semiconductor devices and the power conversion technologies that power billions of electronic products worldwide. Engineers gain expertise in both chip-level innovation and system-level design, enabling them to solve complex challenges in energy efficiency, power density, and reliability across consumer, industrial, automotive, and renewable energy applications.

Engineers work with advanced characterization tools and sophisticated power-testing environments, enabling them to develop technical expertise with the same technologies used by leading semiconductor companies worldwide.

title: Fragrance Quality Control Technician
description:
Who we are at Osmo:

Osmo is a digital olfaction company, on a mission to give computers a sense of smell to improve the health and wellbeing of human life. Why? Our sense of smell both enriches and saves lives, and has a deep and direct connection to our emotions and memory.

Olfactory Intelligence has applications across industries including fragrance, manufacturing, security, medicine, and more. We believe in the power of automation and thoughtfully applied AI/ML to solve problems beyond the reach of human intuition alone.

We're headquartered in Elizabeth, NJ, with an additional office in Somerville, MA. We provide complimentary shuttle service from Brooklyn and Newark, NJ.

About the Role

Osmo's QC function is being built from the ground up, and this seat is where day-to-day quality judgment lives. You'll run testing and sampling on raw materials coming in and finished fragrance going out, using real fragrance-industry judgment that automated testing alone can't provide. You'll have the standing to make real-time accept/reject calls independently, and the experience to step in and cover QC decisions when the QC Manager is out.

What You'll Do:

  • Judge incoming raw material results from automated testing, deciding when an out-of-spec reading is a real defect versus normal variation in a natural material

  • Apply trained olfactive judgment to evaluate raw materials and finished goods using sensory skill the equipment can't replicate

  • Run triangulation testing on outgoing product to confirm it matches prior batches before it reaches a customer

  • Make accept/reject calls in real time, multiple times a day, escalating only genuinely ambiguous cases to the QC Manager

  • Step in and cover QC sign-off when the QC Manager is unavailable, keeping finished-goods flow moving rather than stalling

  • Maintain and run lab instrumentation (GC/MS, photosampler, flash point testing, colorimeters), including calibration checks and upkeep

  • Maintain audit-ready lab records: test logs, certificates of analysis, and equipment records

  • Mentor QC Tech staff on fragrance-specific testing and olfactive judgment

  • Partner across the floor with Purchasing, Warehouse, Shipping/Receiving, and Fragrance Development on sample flow and testing turnaround

Who You Are:

  • Fragrance industry experience or exposure required — adjacent industries (coffee, beer, wine, alcohol roasting, flavor, cosmetics, specialty chemicals) don't clear the bar

  • Comfortable making high-frequency accept/reject calls independently, without over-escalating routine judgment

  • Trained nose — sensory and olfactive evaluation skill specific to fragrance raw materials and finished goods

  • Strong hands-on experience with lab instrumentation; GC/GCMS familiarity is a plus, not a requirement

  • Strong documentation habits

  • Comfortable stepping into a QC decision-making role in the Manager's absence

  • Technical degree preferred (Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, or related); equivalent hands-on fragrance-industry lab experience accepted in place of a degree

  • On-site in Elizabeth, NJ, 5 days a week

What We Offer:

  • Real Growth Path — A senior technician track with real, independent QC decision-making authority, inside a quality function being built from the ground up

  • Catered Lunch — Mon/Wed/Fri; Newark, NJ and Brooklyn shuttles

  • 401(k) savings plan and employer match

  • Competitive salary and meaningful equity in a high-growth company

  • Flexible PTO and paid family leave

  • Commuter benefits (pre-tax transit and parking)

If this role inspires you we’d encourage you to apply. We are committed to recruiting, developing, and retaining an incredible team optimized for a diversity of thought, background, and approaches.

For all Full-Time Employees, compensation is just one component of Osmo’s total rewards approach, which is designed to support the well-being, growth, and long-term success of our team members. Depending on the role, this may include base salary or contract-based pay, along with access to health, dental, and vision coverage; a 401(k) retirement savings plan with company match; flexible paid time off and company holidays; and equity or incentive compensation for eligible roles. Actual compensation will vary based on factors such as experience, skills, location, internal equity, and other relevant business considerations. Osmo regularly reviews pay ranges and compensation structures to ensure they remain competitive, equitable, and aligned with current market data.

All employment decisions and responsibilities are determined based on current ability and your ability to grow, without regard to race, color, gender identity, sex, sexual orientation, religion, age, marital status, physical, mental, or sensory disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

title: DevOps / CI/CD Engineer - Platformteam
description:
Wil jij ervoor zorgen dat ontwikkelteams binnen het Openbaar Ministerie hun software veilig en betrouwbaar kunnen ontwikkelen en uitrollen? Binnen programma EMMA vernieuwen we de technische omgeving waarin applicaties van het OM worden gebouwd en beheerd. Als DevOps / CI/CD Engineer bouw je mee aan onze CI/CD-keten en help je ontwikkelteams om steeds zelfstandiger gebruik te maken van het platform. Daarmee werk je aan digitale voorzieningen waarop duizenden collega's binnen het OM dagelijks moeten kunnen vertrouwen.

Wat ga je doen?

Als DevOps / CI/CD Engineer maak je deel uit van het platformteam binnen programma EMMA. Je ontwerpt, bouwt en beheert de CI/CD-keten rondom ons OpenShift-platform. Je zorgt ervoor dat ontwikkelteams hun software op een veilige, gestandaardiseerde en efficiënte manier kunnen bouwen, testen en deployen. Je kijkt daarbij verder dan één pipeline of applicatie.

Je ontwikkelt oplossingen die door meerdere teams gebruikt kunnen worden en helpt ontwikkelteams om daar zelfstandig mee te werken. Zie je dat een proces slimmer kan of dat een standaard ontbreekt? Dan denk je mee over een oplossing en help je deze in de praktijk te brengen.

Je houdt je onder andere bezig met: het ontwerpen, bouwen en beheren van CI/CD-pipelines, templates en technische standaarden; het integreren van de CI/CD-keten met OpenShift en voorzieningen voor artifacts, images, testen en security; het verbeteren van de developer experience met herbruikbare oplossingen en goede ontwikkel- en deploymentprocessen; het optimaliseren van container-images, deployments en geautomatiseerde kwaliteitscontroles; het analyseren en oplossen van complexe technische problemen binnen pipelines, containeromgevingen en platformdiensten; het zorgvuldig vastleggen van technische oplossingen en werkwijzen en het delen van kennis met ontwikkelteams.

Je werkt onder andere met GitLab CI/CD, OpenShift, Nexus en Grafana. Welke technologie we ook inzetten: voor jou staat voorop dat oplossingen betrouwbaar en goed onderhoudbaar zijn en dat ontwikkelteams er zelfstandig mee verder kunnen.

Wie ben jij?

Je bent een ervaren DevOps- of CI/CD-engineer die begrijpt wat er nodig is om software betrouwbaar van ontwikkeling naar productie te brengen. Je kunt technische problemen analyseren en overziet de samenhang tussen CI/CD, containers en platformdiensten. Tegelijkertijd begrijp je dat binnen een organisatie als het OM zorgvuldigheid en continuïteit zwaar wegen.

We vragen van jou: hbo-werk- en -denkniveau op het gebied van IT; minimaal 4 jaar aantoonbare ervaring met het ontwerpen, bouwen en beheren van CI/CD-pipelines binnen een professionele DevOps-omgeving; aantoonbare ervaring met containerisatie en met Kubernetes, OpenShift of een vergelijkbaar containerplatform; ervaring met Linux en scripting, bijvoorbeeld met Bash. Ervaring met onze volledige technische omgeving verwachten we niet. Ervaring met GitLab CI/CD of OpenShift helpt je om sneller je weg te vinden.

Kennis van bijvoorbeeld Nexus, Grafana, ArgoCD, MuleSoft of geautomatiseerde security- en quality tooling is een pré. Ook een certificering zoals Certified Kubernetes Application Developer (CKAD) zien we als een pré. Competenties die essentieel zijn om deze rol goed te kunnen vervullen zijn: Accuraatheid en zorgvuldigheid Je werkt nauwkeurig en controleert wijzigingen in pipelines, configuraties en deployments voordat je deze doorvoert.

Je signaleert fouten en risico's tijdig, werkt volgens afgesproken standaarden en legt technische oplossingen zorgvuldig vast. Daarbij verlies je security, stabiliteit en beschikbaarheid niet uit het oog. Technisch inzicht en leergierigheid Je begrijpt de samenhang tussen development, CI/CD, containers en platformdiensten. Je kunt complexe technische vraagstukken analyseren en vertalen naar praktische oplossingen. Je houdt ontwikkelingen binnen je vakgebied actief bij en past nieuwe technologie op een verantwoorde manier toe.

De kennis die je opdoet deel je met collega's en ontwikkelteams. Communicatieve vaardigheid Je legt technische onderwerpen helder en begrijpelijk uit en stemt je communicatie af op je gesprekspartner. Je luistert naar de vragen en uitdagingen van ontwikkelteams en kunt technische keuzes goed onderbouwen. Ook schrijf je duidelijke documentatie en weet je draagvlak te creëren voor standaarden en nieuwe werkwijzen. Werken bij het Openbaar Ministerie Het Openbaar Ministerie (OM) zorgt voor opsporing en vervolging van strafbare feiten.

Bij het OM werken ruim 7.000 medewerkers met diverse (culturele) achtergronden, opleidingen en kwaliteiten. Het is belangrijk dat alle collega's zich bij het OM thuis voelen en gerespecteerd en gewaardeerd worden. Ook in talent en groei. Lees hier meer. Over de afdeling Je komt te werken bij de Informatievoorziening Openbaar Ministerie. Als OM hebben we behoefte aan een toekomstbestendige en duurzame ICT en Informatievoorziening.

Dit brengt veel uitdagingen met zich mee, daarom is in 2021 het nieuwe OM-onderdeel Informatievoorziening Openbaar Ministerie (IVOM) opgericht. Centraal in de opgave van IVOM staan drie strategische pijlers. We richten ons de komende jaren op het verbeteren van de performance en stabiliteit van de huidige systemen, het professionaliseren van de IV-organisatie en het vernieuwen van de werkprocessen en het ICT-landschap.

Dit doen we met meer dan 200 professionals, die zorgen dat onze ruim 6.300 OM collega's probleemloos kunnen werken, elke dag opnieuw. Binnen IVOM kom je te werken in het platformteam van programma EMMA. Binnen EMMA werken we aan de vernieuwing van het applicatielandschap, de ontwikkelstraat en de platformdiensten van het OM. We bewegen naar een omgeving met meer automatisering en standaardisatie, waarin ontwikkelteams steeds zelfstandiger gebruik kunnen maken van beschikbare platformdiensten.

Het platformteam bouwt de technische voorzieningen die deze ontwikkeling mogelijk maken. Niet alles ligt al vast. Dat betekent dat je niet alleen een bestaande omgeving beheert, maar ook kunt bijdragen aan de verdere ontwikkeling van onze platformdiensten en werkwijzen. Daarbij werk je nauw samen met andere technische specialisten en de ontwikkelteams die gebruikmaken van het platform. Overige arbeidsvoorwaarden Naast het salaris ontvang je een individueel keuzebudget (IKB). Het IKB bestaat uit geld (16,5% van je bruto jaarsalaris) en tijd.

Met het IKB maak jij de keuzes die bij jou passen en kun je een deel van je arbeidsvoorwaarden zelf samenstellen. Je kunt er bijvoorbeeld voor kiezen om een deel van je maandinkomen te laten uitbetalen wanneer jij dat wenst. Ook kun je dit budget omzetten in verlof en andersom of besteden aan fiscaalvriendelijke doelen. De Rijksoverheid hecht sterk aan persoonlijke groei en loopbaanontwikkeling en biedt daarvoor tal van mogelijkheden.

Tot de secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden behoren onder meer verschillende studiefaciliteiten, bedrijfsfitness, volledige vergoeding van je ov-reiskosten woon-werkverkeer en gedeeltelijk betaald ouderschapsverlof.

Bijzonderheden De functie is ingeschaald in schaal 11 van de CAO Rijk (€ 4.132,76 - € 6.275,94); Het betreft een functie voor 36 uur per week; Je ontvangt een arbeidsovereenkomst voor bepaalde tijd met uitzicht op een arbeidsovereenkomst voor onbepaalde tijd; Voor deze functie is een Verklaring Omtrent het Gedrag (VOG) vereist; Geselecteerde kandidaten ontvangen uiterlijk 6 oktober 2026 bericht; De selectiegesprekken vinden plaats op 12 oktober 2026 in Utrecht.

Voldoe je aan de belangrijkste functie-eisen, maar heb je nog niet met iedere genoemde technologie gewerkt? Laat je daardoor niet tegenhouden om te reageren. We zijn vooral benieuwd naar de relevante ervaring die je meebrengt en hoe je jouw vak in de praktijk uitoefent. Meer informatie Wil je meer weten?

Dan kun je contact opnemen met Menno van Bers (Teamleider) via telefoonnummer 06-46838578 of via e-mail m.van.bers@om.nl Sollicitatieprocedure Voor vragen over de sollicitatieprocedure kun je contact opnemen met Tim Spijker (Recruitment Adviseur) via telefoonnummer 06-42400400 of via e-mail t.spijker@om.nl De selectiegesprekken voeren we op een gestructureerde manier. We vragen je daarbij naar concrete situaties uit je eerdere werkervaring.

Zo kunnen we op een zo objectief mogelijke manier beoordelen hoe jouw ervaring en competenties aansluiten bij deze functie. Sollicitatiewijze Je kunt je motivatiebrief en cv uploaden tot en met 27-09-2026 via de sollicitatieknop.

description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Pessoa Desenvolvedora Flutter - Sênior based in Brazil.

This is a senior-level opportunity for a Mobile Developer to build and evolve a Flutter application used daily by thousands of users.
You will contribute directly to mobile architecture, scalability, modularization, performance, and the delivery of impactful product features.
The role combines hands-on Flutter development with API integrations, automated testing, production monitoring, and continuous delivery.
You will work with technologies across the broader ecosystem, including Dart, TypeScript, and Ruby, gaining a comprehensive view of the product.
Quality is considered part of the developer’s ownership, with engineers responsible for building, testing, monitoring, and sustaining what they deliver.
You will collaborate closely with Product and Design teams, connecting technical decisions with user needs and business impact.
The role is fully remote and initially structured as a two-month temporary engagement, with the possibility of continuing the relationship based on project needs and performance.

Accountabilities:

  • Develop and continuously evolve a mobile application using Flutter and Dart, delivering reliable experiences to a large and active user base.
  • Contribute actively to the application architecture, ensuring scalability, modularization, maintainability, and strong performance as the product evolves.
  • Design and implement critical mobile features, including geolocation and maps, user check-in flows, and integrations with payment providers.
  • Integrate the mobile application with REST APIs while developing an understanding of backend flows and the broader system architecture.
  • Take ownership of delivery quality by implementing and executing behavioral and black-box tests, as well as supporting automated testing practices.
  • Participate in code reviews, technical decisions, architectural discussions, and product conversations, contributing ideas and helping establish effective engineering practices.
  • Monitor application health in production, investigating crashes, performance issues, stability concerns, and other indicators that may affect the user experience.
  • Contribute to deployment and application publishing processes for both Android and iOS, including CI/CD workflows and release activities.
  • Collaborate closely with Product and Design teams, ensuring technical decisions are aligned with product objectives, user needs, and measurable business impact.

    • Requirements:

    • Solid professional experience as a Flutter Developer, with strong hands-on experience building and evolving mobile applications in production environments.
    • Advanced knowledge of Dart and strong understanding of mobile development best practices, architecture, maintainability, and performance.
    • Consistent experience with state management solutions such as BLoC or comparable approaches for building scalable and maintainable applications.
    • Strong experience integrating mobile applications with REST APIs and understanding how frontend, backend, and integration layers interact.
    • Experience implementing automated tests in mobile development environments and a strong commitment to software quality.
    • Practical experience with Git and modern code versioning practices.
    • Experience publishing and maintaining applications through both Google Play and the App Store.
    • Experience working in Agile environments, including Scrum or Kanban, with strong collaboration and communication skills.
    • Strong ownership of code, quality, delivery, and production outcomes, combined with a product-engineering mindset rather than a task-execution approach.
    • Curiosity and willingness to understand other technology stacks and the broader system, including technologies such as TypeScript and Ruby.
    • Proactive and analytical approach to identifying problems, proposing solutions, and seeking opportunities to create meaningful product and business impact.
    • Experience with Flutter Channels and native development using Kotlin or Swift is a valuable advantage.
    • Experience with maps and geolocation services, CI/CD pipelines, or working across mobile, backend, and integration layers is considered a plus.
    • Genuine interest in application architecture and the evolution of complex systems is highly valued.

      • Benefits:

      • Fully remote work model.
      • Initial temporary engagement for two months, with the possibility of continuing based on business and project needs.
      • Opportunity to work on a mobile product used daily by thousands of users.
      • Opportunity to contribute to technically challenging areas including mobile architecture, geolocation, payments, API integrations, performance, and production stability.
      • Collaborative environment with close interaction across Engineering, Product, and Design.
      • Exposure to a broader technology ecosystem and opportunities to work across mobile, backend, integrations, and CI/CD.

title: Trim & Upholstery Technician
description:
Interior Technician


Department:
Trim Shop

FLSA Classification:
Non-Exempt

Employment Type:
Full-Time

Work Location:
Cantonment, Florida; Onsite

Travel Required:
None


About Us

Velocity is the nation's leading and largest builder of classic American vehicles, redefining what it means to own a classic. Our vehicles are not simply restored; they are entirely reborn. We blend the timeless character and aesthetics of vintage vehicles with the performance, technology, and reliability of modern automobiles. By moving beyond traditional one-off restorations and their uncertainty, Velocity has established a new standard for meticulously crafted, high-performance classics with enhanced reliability and drivability.


Velocity's Culture and Core Values

Success at Velocity requires a "whatever it takes" mentality. We embody grit, demonstrating perseverance, resilience, and unwavering determination in the face of challenges. We are adaptable, embracing change, adjusting to new circumstances, and continuously seeking ways to improve processes and outcomes because growth does not come from comfort.

We take ownership, assuming full responsibility for tasks, decisions, and outcomes, whether successes or setbacks, without shifting blame. "That is not my job" is not in our vocabulary; when one part of our team falls short, we all do.

Finally, our ambition fuels our drive to excel, improve, and uphold the highest standards for both personal and professional growth. This mindset defines who we are and supports our continued success.


Overview

The Interior Technician fabricates, upholsters, finishes, and installs premium interior components for Velocity's classic vehicles. This role follows build specifications, approved patterns, work instructions, quality standards, and production priorities to deliver accurate work on schedule. The technician protects craftsmanship, material quality, documentation, and downstream vehicle flow while continuously developing upholstery and trim skills.


Job Level

Individual Contributor


Reports To

Trim Shop Manager; receives daily work direction from the Interior Team Lead


Direct Reports

None


Duties and Responsibilities

Interior Fabrication and Upholstery

• Fabricate, upholster, wrap, finish, and install assigned interior components in accordance with build specifications, approved patterns, samples, and quality standards.

• Operate industrial sewing machines and approved hand and power tools safely; perform routine machine and tool care within the technician's training level.

• Work with leather, vinyl, fabric, foam, carpet, composites, acrylic, StarBoard, adhesives, fasteners, and related trim materials as assigned.

• Measure, fit, align, and finish components accurately, including work performed in confined areas of vehicle interiors.

• Adapt upholstery materials and approved techniques to achieve consistent fit, appearance, durability, and function.

Quality and Documentation

• Verify the work order, build sheet, specifications, materials, and assigned priority before beginning work; ask for clarification when information conflicts or is incomplete.

• Inspect incoming materials and completed work for color, grain, fit, finish, function, damage, and conformance to specifications before handoff.

• Identify and report shortages, defects, damage, incorrect materials, or process concerns immediately to prevent delays and avoidable rework.

• Complete required SOS, sign-off, quality, labor, and production records accurately and on time.

• Take clear required photographs of completed work for customer service, quality, and internal records.

Production and Team Standards

• Complete assigned work in the approved priority sequence and communicate any risk to quality, labor hours, or due dates before a commitment is missed.

• Support teammates and cross-train within the Trim Shop to maintain department flow and meet vehicle completion requirements.

• Maintain a clean, safe, and efficiently organized workstation, tools, materials, racks, and work-in-process.

• Follow standard work, safety procedures, dress-code requirements, and required personal protective equipment practices.

• Arrive on time, professionally prepared, and ready to work at the scheduled start of the shift.

• Participate in continuous improvement by identifying repeat quality issues, waste, unclear instructions, and opportunities to improve safety or flow.

Execution Authority

• Confirm part completion and process completion only for work the technician is trained, qualified, and assigned to perform.

• Identify part needs, material needs, process concerns, and improvement opportunities, and communicate them through the established department process.

• Exercise additional authority for material purposing, material billing, sewing, patterning, technician training, project planning, or project completion only when specifically assigned and competency-approved by the Trim Shop Manager.

• Stop and escalate work when specifications conflict, required materials are unavailable, quality is at risk, or the task exceeds the technician's approved authority.


Key Performance Indicators

• Billable labor utilization: Maintain at least 97% billable hours to payroll, excluding approved indirect time.

• On-time completion: Complete at least 95% of assigned work by the committed production date, or escalate a documented blocker before the date is missed.

• Labor-hour performance: Complete assigned work within established vehicle and task-hour goals; performance is reviewed against the current production plan.

• First-pass quality: Complete and self-inspect assigned work before handoff. Work is expected to meet approved specifications and quality standards without avoidable technician-caused rework, correction, or replacement. Recurring quality issues, preventable defects, and failure to report known concerns will be reviewed as part of performance.

• Documentation and sign-off: Complete 100% of required SOS, quality, labor, and photo documentation before handoff.


Required Skills and Abilities

• Strong attention to detail and the manual dexterity required for precise upholstery, sewing, wrapping, fitting, and installation work.

• Ability to read and follow build sheets, work instructions, measurements, patterns, material direction, and quality standards.

• Ability to distinguish colors, shades, grain direction, alignment, surface defects, and finish differences.

• Commitment to producing high-quality work and learning new tools, materials, techniques, and standardized processes.

• Ability to work efficiently in a fast-paced environment, both independently and as part of a team.

• Ability to receive verbal and written direction, adjust priorities, and communicate concerns clearly and promptly.

• Ability to work overtime when required by production needs.

• Valid driver's license and reliable transportation to and from work.

• Ability to meet company pre-employment and employment requirements, including mandatory drug screening.


Education Background and Experience

• No formal degree is required; demonstrated aptitude, craftsmanship, reliability, and ability to learn are essential.

• Experience operating sewing machines or performing upholstery, trim, fabrication, or vehicle-interior work is preferred; role-specific training may be provided.

• Prior automotive, marine, aviation, furniture, or custom upholstery experience is preferred.


Physical Demands (To include but not limited to)

• Frequent standing, walking, bending, kneeling, crouching, twisting, and reaching throughout the shift, including work above the shoulders and below the waist.

• Regular lifting and carrying of tools, parts, seats, panels, and materials up to 50 pounds; team lift or mechanical assistance is required above that weight or when an item cannot be handled safely by one person.

• Frequent and repetitive use of hands, wrists, arms, and fingers for sewing, cutting, stretching, fastening, tool operation, and detailed manual work.

• Ability to safely enter, exit, and work within vehicle interiors and around vehicles, carts, racks, tools, and production equipment.

• Visual acuity sufficient to evaluate measurements, alignment, surface quality, color, shade, and finish.


Work Environment

• Work is performed primarily in an automotive production and trim-shop environment with regular exposure to shop noise, dust, vehicle movement, and temperature variation.

• The role may involve exposure to adhesives, cleaners, solvents, foam dust, leather and fabric fibers, and other materials used in automotive upholstery; required PPE is provided and must be used.

• Work is performed near sewing machines, cutting equipment, hand tools, power tools, racks, carts, and partially completed vehicles.


Benefits Include

Compensation: Pay is based on experience and qualifications.

Health & Wellness: Health/Dental/Vision/Life/Disability/Aflac available after 60 days.

Retirement: 401(k) with company match after 6 months at the next enrollment period.

Paid Time Off: Paid time off and paid holidays.

Additional Perks: Company-sponsored events, tool program, merchandise discounts, and a friendly team environment.

title: Station Design Manager
description:
SYSTRA Canada is part of the SYSTRA group, an international consulting and engineering group, a world leader in the design of transport infrastructures. SYSTRA Canada is an engineering and consulting firm whose primary focus is to offer transportation solutions, whether for passengers or goods: feasibility studies of building a new railway line, increasing the capacity of the existing infrastructure, privatization of a railway.

Context

The Station Design Manager will lead and coordinate the multidisciplinary design of rail stations and associated facilities across all project stages. The Station Design Manager is responsible for ensuring that station designs meet project objectives, operational requirements, passenger experience standards, regulatory frameworks, constructability constraints, and lifecycle performance targets. This role entails technical coordination across architecture, structural, MEP, utilities, fire/life safety, vertical transportation, civil interfaces, and rail systems. The Station Design Manager will act as the design coordination lead for station packages within projects.

Missions/Main Duties

Management and Team Governance

1. Design Leadership and Governance

  • Coordinate the multidisciplinary design development of rail stations and station-related facilities from concept to IFC stage.
  • Ensure alignment of station design Objectives as identified during the design co-development.
  • Maintain the Station Development Plan, including: Design milestones, Deliverable matrices, Interface registers, Risk registers, Design review checkpoints
  • Establish and enforce technical governance processes, including: Design reviews (30/60/90/IFC), Change control procedures, Configuration management, Decision traceability and design maturity gates.
  • Ensure compliance with Project Requirements Specifications (PRS), technical standards, and applicable Canadian codes and regulations.
  • Provide technical expertise and guidance to discipline leads and consultant teams as required.

2. Interface Management

  • Manage interfaces between station design and: Track alignment and rail systems (OCS, signalling, telecoms); Civil works and guideway structures; Utilities relocation and integration; Traction power and substations; Operations and maintenance facilities; Third-party developments and municipal infrastructure.
  • Ensure station design requirements are clearly communicated to rail systems, civil, and infrastructure teams.
  • Coordinate closely with: System Engineering stream, Digital engineering / BIM team, Asset management and digital twin representatives, Future operator and maintainer.
  • Develop and maintain an Interface Management Plan for each station package.

3. Regulatory and Authority Coordination

  • Liaise with federal, provincial, and municipal authorities to support: Building permits; Fire marshal approvals; Environmental approvals; Accessibility compliance; Transport Canada coordination (where applicable); Utility provider coordination as required
  • Ensure alignment with codes and standards.
  • Support environmental assessment processes and community consultations.

4. Passenger Experience and Operations Integration

  • Ensure station layouts support: Efficient passenger circulation; Safe platform operations; Emergency egress compliance; Wayfinding and intuitive navigation; Security screening (if applicable); Retail and commercial integration; Multimodal connectivity (bus, metro, parking, active transport)
  • Coordinate with ridership and operational teams to validate functional, architectural and engineering studies as required.
  • Ensure integration of maintainability, durability, and lifecycle cost considerations in design decisions.

5. Risk, Cost and Schedule Control

  • Identify and manage design and possible construction risks.
  • Support value engineering exercises and cost optimization workshops.
  • Ensure station design deliverables align with overall programme schedule and budget constraints.
  • Monitor consultant performance, deliverable quality, and adherence to scope.

Procurement / Tender Preparation

  • Support procurement strategy for station packages, including Scope boundary definition; Performance-based specifications; Technical evaluation criteria
  • Support preparation and review of station tender documentation.
  • Ensure clarity of interface clauses and technical responsibilities in tender documents.

Profile/Skills

The Station Design Manager shall have the following qualifications and experience:

  • Accredited degree in Architecture, Building Engineering, or related discipline.
  • Professional Engineer or eligibility to obtain; Registered Architect or eligibility to obtain considered an asset.
  • Minimum 15–20 years of experience in major infrastructure or transportation projects, including at least 10 years in multidisciplinary station or complex building design leadership roles.
  • Experience on rail or metro projects, preferably high-speed rail or large transit hubs.
  • Demonstrated experience managing multidisciplinary teams in highly regulated environments.
  • Experience coordinating brownfield integration with existing operational rail networks is an asset.
  • Familiarity with Alliance, Design-Build, or PPP contract models is an asset.
  • Bilingual (English/French) preferred.

This role requires strong cross-disciplinary leadership and executive communication:

  • Strategic systems thinking and ability to translate programme objectives into station design roadmaps.
  • Ability to challenge and synthesize discipline inputs into coherent design solutions.
  • Executive-level communication and presentation skills.
  • Stakeholder engagement and negotiation capabilities.
  • Decisiveness under schedule and budget constraints.
  • Strong facilitation skills for technical workshops and value engineering sessions.
  • Conflict resolution across technical and commercial teams.
  • Ability to represent station design at project boards, with authorities, operators, and public

  • Experience preparing engineering documentation, specifications, reports, and design deliverables.
  • Strong communication, stakeholder coordination, and interdisciplinary collaboration skills.
