title: Program Analyst
description:
Why Renovo?
Renovo Solutions is a nationwide healthcare and life sciences technology management company. We offer a range of opportunities for employees to grow within the company. With a presence in 40+ states and a growing international footprint, we provide comprehensive solutions for managing and maintaining the equipment our clients depend on. We prioritize investing in our employees’ development, offering various phases and advancement paths. Through ongoing training, mentorship programs, and a supportive work environment, we foster professional growth and promote from within. Join our team to make a difference while advancing your career with Renovo.

Summary:
The Program Analyst turns what the Enterprise Laboratory Instrument Services (ELIS) program actually does into evidence the program and the client can act on. This role helps support operational performance analysis, spend and volume trending, and the analysis behind decisions on coverage, capacity and capital replacement.

The role is remote with periodic travel to assigned sites. It reports to the Regional Director of Operations and takes functional direction from the Manager, Master Data and Systems on data and reporting standards.

What you will do:
Contractual performance reporting:

Produce contractual key performance indicators

Maintain the calculation method for each measure in documented form so any figure can be traced and reproduced.

Identify and flag where a contractual measure cannot be produced accurately from available data, and escalate rather than approximate.

Support the quality governance review, which is the only measure in the agreement without an annual cap.

Produce the cost savings evidence, which is the measure the RenovoCare conversion program exists to satisfy.

Prepare performance content for operational reviews, client business reviews and program governance.

Track corrective action triggers and remediation status where a measure breaches its threshold.

Operational analysis:

Analyze scheduled maintenance (SM) and demand maintenance (DM) completion, response and resolution performance by site, platform, vendor and department.

Analyze first-time-fix, repeat-fault and aging work order patterns, and identify what is driving them.

Analyze self-perform versus vendor-performed volume and the cost difference, and support the conversion case.

Analyze capacity and workload distribution across sites and staff, and flag where load is unsustainable before it fails.

Support capital replacement and end-of-life analysis with failure, downtime and spend evidence.

Spend and commercial analysis:

Analyze service spending by site, vendor, platform and category, and explain variance against budget in operational terms.

Analyze the contract and entitlement position, including renewal timing, coverage gaps and coverage paid for and not used.

Support quote benchmarking and vendor performance comparison.

Provide the analysis behind change requests, scope changes and pricing discussions.

Analytical integrity:

Understand how the work is performed well enough to recognize a figure that cannot be true and investigate rather than publish it.

State the limitations of any analysis, including sample size, data gaps and known record defects affecting the result.

Distinguish correlation from cause and say which one an analysis supports.

Refuse to present a threshold rule or heuristic as a statistical conclusion.

Reconcile any figure appearing in more than one report so the program does not publish two different answers to the same question.

Working with the sites and functions:

Act as the named analytical contact for assigned Site Operations Managers.

Travel to assigned sites to understand how the work is actually performed and why the data looks the way it does.

Feed analytical findings back to the sites in a form they can act on, not only upward as reporting.

Work with the Master Data Analyst on record defects that are corrupting analysis, and with Sourcing and Payments on spend and contract data.

Specify and validate reporting and dashboard requirements. This role does not configure or develop the platform.

Quality, compliance and safety:

Meet GxP and client data integrity requirements, including traceability and change control on reported figures.

Support internal and client audits with traceable analysis and source data.

Follow client site safety and access requirements when on site.

Escort and vendor hosting when on site:

Escort is a standing expectation of every role on this program. When present at a client site, escort and host OEM and third-party personnel on request, regardless of whose scope the instrument sits in.

Confirm third-party personnel are inducted, badged, and compliant with client site access and safety requirements before they enter a laboratory.

Confirm the work performed matches what was authorized and the service record is complete before the third-party leaves site.

Escalate immediately where a third party arrives unannounced or attempts work outside the authorized scope.

Qualifications:

3+ years of experience in operational, service, performance or financial analysis.

Demonstrated ability to produce analysis that has been challenged and held up.

Strong spreadsheet capability including pivot, lookup and reconciliation techniques. SQL, Power BI, Tableau or comparable reporting tool experience preferred.

Experience with a computerized maintenance management system (CMMS), enterprise asset management system or service management platform as a data source.

Experience working to contractual or regulated performance measures where the definition matters.

Demonstrated willingness to say that a number is wrong or cannot be produced, rather than publishing it.

Working knowledge of GxP requirements and data integrity expectations.

Experience in a pharmaceutical, biotechnology, healthcare or technical service environment preferred.

Education/Special Training:

Bachelor’s degree is preferred, in a technical, scientific, business, finance or information discipline. Equivalent experience considered.

Training in GxP, data integrity and client site safety provided or required.

CMMS, reporting tool and platform training provided after hire.

Required Competencies:

Analytical Rigor - knows the difference between a pattern and a conclusion, and reports which one it is.

Intellectual Honesty - states the limitations of the analysis and will not publish a figure that cannot be traced.

Operational Understanding - knows how the work is performed well enough to spot a figure that cannot be true.

Curiosity - investigates why the number looks wrong instead of reformatting it.

Communication - explains an analytical finding to operations staff and to client leadership in terms each can act on.

Follow-through - closes out the finding rather than delivering the chart.

Independence - holds an unpopular conclusion when the data supports it.

Integrity - can admit mistakes, is direct and truthful, and acts in the best interest of clients, employees and Renovo.

Success Measures:

Contractual key performance indicator reporting delivered on time, accurate and traceable

Reported figures reconciled across reports, with no conflicting answers published

Data limitations stated on every analysis where they exist

Analytical findings acted on by the sites, not only received

Self-perform conversion and coverage change cases supported with evidence

Spend variance explained in operational terms

Capacity and workload risks flagged before they result in a performance failure

Audit outcomes on reported performance data

Site and client leadership feedback on the usefulness of the analysis

Safety Requirements:

Abide by and follow Renovo safety policies, procedures, and injury and illness prevention expectations.

Maintain a safe working environment for self and others when visiting customer sites, laboratories, offices, or operational environments.

Follow applicable customer site safety requirements, OSHA guidelines, and laboratory or facility-specific procedures as required.

Complete required safety training assignments on time.

Physical Requirements:

Predominantly remote, office-based work.

When on assigned client sites, presence in active laboratory environments including areas with biological, chemical, electrical and cryogenic hazards.

Ability to wear required personal protective equipment when on site.

Travel approximately 10 to 20 percent, covering assigned sites, client reviews and program meetings.

Classification:
FLSA: Exempt

title: Principal Security Specialist
description:
Setting the Scene
Our client is a major Queensland Government organisation responsible for delivering essential digital, technology and customer services across the state. As part of the Security Operations team, this is an opportunity for an experienced Principal Security Specialist to take ownership of a complex Check Point firewall environment and play a key role in its assessment, optimisation and future migration.

The Role
Reporting to the Director of Information Security Services, you’ll join a team responsible for delivering 24x7 security infrastructure services across government clients. You’ll initially undertake a detailed discovery and due diligence exercise across the existing Check Point environment, which is currently supported by another service provider. From there, you’ll help shape the future-state solution, transfer knowledge to the internal team and provide ongoing technical support while supporting the migration to the chosen solution.

Key responsibilities:
  • Conduct detailed discovery and due diligence of the existing Check Point firewall environment
  • Document the current architecture, configuration, connectivity, support model and operational requirements
  • Assess the existing Check Point environment from a security, technical and supportability perspective
  • Identify risks, gaps, dependencies and opportunities for improvement
  • Estimate ongoing service management and support requirements
  • Provide hands-on technical support across the existing Check Point firewall environment
  • Develop options and recommendations for migrating clients to a more cost-effective and manageable security solution
  • Contribute to the design and implementation of the future-state firewall environment
  • Assist with the migration of existing Check Point firewalls to the chosen solution
  • Troubleshoot complex firewall, network security and connectivity issues
  • Work closely with internal technical teams, clients and external service providers
  • Support the delivery of new security initiatives and enhancements to existing security services
  • Contribute to operational documentation, technical procedures and knowledge management
  • Participate in rostered on-call arrangements supporting critical security infrastructure
What you'll bring
  • Extensive hands-on experience managing and implementing Check Point firewalls
  • Strong experience across Check Point firewall architecture, configuration, software, licensing and connectivity
  • Demonstrated experience leading or delivering firewall migrations and transformation projects
  • Strong technical troubleshooting and problem-solving capability across complex security infrastructure
  • Experience conducting technical discovery, environment assessments and due diligence
  • Ability to document complex technical environments clearly and identify opportunities for improvement
  • Experience providing knowledge transfer and mentoring to technical teams
  • Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical audiences
  • Strong analytical and decision-making skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment
  • Experience working within large, complex or highly regulated environments
A Check Point certification such as CCSE, or an equivalent security certification, will be highly regarded. Experience within government, managed services, telecommunications, enterprise technology or other complex environments will also be highly regarded.

MOE's DXD is hiring a Senior/Lead UX Designer to lead design craft and user research across its student-facing digital products (including the Student Learning Space). The role requires 10+ years of UX experience and involves shaping high-quality, evidence-driven experiences while collaborating cross-functionally with product, engineering, and curriculum teams. Beyond execution, the designer will also help grow and mentor the student mission design team.

Overview

At DXD (Digital Excellence & Products Division), Ministry of Education (MOE), we work on the digital experiences that shape how students learn, how teachers support that learning, and how parents stay connected to their child's education.

We are looking for a Senior / Lead UX Designer to drive design craft and user experience across MOE's student missions. The Student Learning Space (SLS) is a key focus, but this role covers the broader student product portfolio and involves working across teacher and parent domains to deliver experiences that feel connected and coherent.

This is a design-first role. In the first 6 to 12 months, you will lead the design of key student-facing experiences, setting a high bar for craft, interaction quality, and visual coherence, while running discovery work to better understand how students and teachers engage with digital learning tools. You will also help build out the design practice for the student mission, putting in place rituals, standards, and ways of working for a growing team. Day to day, you will work closely with product managers, curriculum specialists, and developers to shape and ship solutions grounded in evidence and design excellence.


[What you will be working on]

Design Craft and Execution (Primary)

  • Set and uphold a high standard of design quality across the student product portfolio, covering interaction design, visual design, information architecture, and accessibility
  • Design user flows, wireframes, and high-fidelity prototypes that balance usability, learning outcomes, and technical feasibility
  • Contribute to shared design patterns and components that keep student products consistent and aligned with teacher and parent domains
  • Deliver design specifications that enable smooth implementation, with close attention to how content and UI interact in learning contexts

Discovery and User Research (Primary)

  • Lead user research with students and teachers to understand how digital tools support and get in the way of learning
  • Map end-to-end learning journeys across the student product portfolio, drawing on qualitative research and behavioural data to surface design opportunities
  • Run usability testing and iterate based on evidence, working across mission boundaries (teachers, parents) to make sure the ecosystem holds together

Growing the Student Design Practice (Secondary)

  • Put in place design rituals, critique processes, and quality standards for the student mission design team
  • Mentor and support designers on the team, raising craft quality through hands-on feedback, design reviews, and knowledge sharing
  • Contribute to the DXD-wide design community, shared standards, and cross-mission alignment

Stakeholder Engagement (Secondary)

  • Work closely with product managers, curriculum specialists, and developers to align on user needs, learning outcomes, and delivery timelines
  • Facilitate workshops and co-design sessions with educators and domain experts, and clearly articulate the thinking behind design decisions


What we are looking for

Skills, Behaviours, and Attributes

  • Strong design craft, with a solid track record in interaction design, visual design, and prototyping across complex digital products, including sensitivity to accessibility and content-heavy interfaces
  • Ability to hold both the detail (pixel-level quality) and the bigger picture (cross-product coherence, design patterns, ecosystem thinking)
  • Skilled in user research and usability testing, and comfortable using both qualitative and quantitative evidence to inform design decisions
  • Experience setting up or growing a design practice, including rituals, critique culture, and quality standards
  • Comfortable navigating ambiguity and shaping design direction in environments where processes are still taking shape
  • A clear communicator who can make the case for design quality with product, engineering, and curriculum stakeholders
  • Thoughtful and intentional use of AI tools in the design workflow


Qualifications and Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Design, Human-Computer Interaction, Education Technology, or a related field
  • At least 10 years of experience in UX design, product design, or interaction design roles
  • A strong portfolio that demonstrates craft quality, design thinking, and the ability to ship complex products
  • Experience designing for education, learning platforms, or content-rich multi-user products is highly valued
  • Familiarity with public sector environments or large-scale platform design is a plus


Reporting and Team Structure

  • Reports to: Design Manager
  • Works with: Product managers, curriculum specialists, developers, designers across teacher and parent missions, and the DXD design community

What We Offer:

  • Collaborative and creative work environment
  • Competitive salary and benefits package, including opportunities for professional growth and development
  • Work environment that is fully supportive of self-improvement and personal/professional development

GovTech is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive workplace that values diverse voices and perspectives, as we believe it is key to innovation.

Our employee benefits are based on a total rewards approach, offering a holistic and market-competitive suite of perks.

We champion flexible work arrangements (subject to your job role) and trust you to manage your time to deliver your best.

title: Commercial Administrator
description:
UGL is seeking a highly organised and commercially focused Commercial Administrator to join our project team on a 15\:13 site roster. Reporting to the Project Leadership Team, you will provide critical commercial and contract administration support to ensure the effective management of change notices, variations, contractual correspondence and commercial records.

You will play an integral role in supporting cost recovery, contractual compliance and project commercial performance by maintaining accurate records, coordinating commercial processes and assisting with client and subcontractor commercial submissions.

This is an exciting opportunity for a proactive professional who thrives in a fast-paced project environment and enjoys working collaboratively to deliver successful commercial outcomes on a major project.

Key Responsibilities

  • Partner with the Construction Manager, Project Manager and Site Leadership Team to support project commercial objectives.
  • Prepare, submit and administer client change notices, variations, compensation events and contractual claims in accordance with contract requirements.
  • Maintain variation, change management and commercial correspondence registers, ensuring accurate and timely records.
  • Collect, compile and maintain supporting documentation including site records, progress reports, timesheets, delay records and cost data.
  • Assist in the assessment, quantification and valuation of scope changes, including labour, plant, equipment, materials and subcontractor costs.
  • Monitor project activities to identify commercial risks, contractual entitlement events and scope growth opportunities.
  • Prepare contractual correspondence including notifications, RFIs, notices of delay and other formal communications.
  • Track variations from identification through to approval, recovery and close-out.
  • Support subcontractor variation assessments and commercial evaluations.
  • Assist with monthly cost reporting, forecasting, accruals and earned value activities.
  • Build and maintain effective working relationships with project teams, subcontractors and client representatives.
  • Maintain commercial records and documentation in accordance with project procedures, contractual obligations and audit requirements.
  • Contribute to commercial reports, dashboards and presentations for internal and client meetings.
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives to enhance commercial systems and processes.

About You

You will be a proactive and detail-oriented professional with experience supporting commercial and project delivery teams in construction, engineering, mining, maintenance or infrastructure environments.

To be successful, you will have\:

  • Previous experience in Commercial Administration, Contracts Administration, Project Administration or a similar role.
  • Experience working on major projects within construction, resources, energy, maintenance or infrastructure sectors.
  • Understanding of contract administration, change management and variation processes.
  • Strong analytical, organisational and problem-solving skills.
  • High attention to detail and a commitment to maintaining accurate records.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong stakeholder management and relationship-building abilities.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel.
  • The ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a dynamic site environment.
  • What Makes You Right for UGL
  • Genuine concern for safety.
  • Ability to provide a safe, supportive and positive workplace.
  • Capacity to flourish in a high-performance environment.
  • An innovative mindset and willingness to challenge the norm.
  • A belief that success and value are driven by real teams where everyone has a role to play.

About UGL

UGL is well-known and respected for providing end-to-end engineering, construction and maintenance services across rail and transport, communications and technology systems, oil and gas, power, renewables and resources, water and defence sectors.

We partner with some of the world's largest blue-chip companies, government agencies, private enterprises and public institutions and are proud to be a member of the CIMIC Group of companies.

At UGL, we value diversity in backgrounds, ideas, work styles and perspectives. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and strongly encourage people with disability, Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples, mature-aged workers and people from culturally diverse backgrounds to apply.

As a Lead Software Development Engineer, you will take on a key technical role within our software team, contributing to the development of high-performance applications for real-time embedded control systems. You’ll write clean, efficient code, guide architectural decisions, and work closely with teammates across disciplines to build scalable, reliable solutions. title: Service Practice Specialist
description:
About the team:

Our End User Operations function underpins how people across the cooperative get their work done every day. Our priorities are clear: elevate the end-user experience, modernise devices and collaboration, and strengthen operational performance. We look out for each other, and work together to solve problems, improve services, and keep things moving - especially when things are busy or incidents are urgent.

Join us as we build a more proactive, automated, and resilient environment that connects systems and enables our teams to keep feeding the South.

About the role:

As a Service Practice Specialist, you'll play a key part in the coordination, governance and analysis of our processes and practices across multiple functions, ensuring ITSM practices are applied across the business and actually deliver value to the end user.

You'll work cross-functionally with a range of different stakeholders, coordinating multiple workstreams and ensuring actions actually happen so that ideas come to fruition. You'll identify gaps and improvement opportunities and shape them into outcomes, analyse incidents, changes and trends and turn the findings into insights and recommendations using ITIL guidelines.

  • Work with teams across the business to gather information, identify gaps and risks and turn that data into actionable outcomes to support teams
  • Coordinate end-to-end Change and Release activities, ensuring robust documentation, risk management, and forward planning are consistently applied

  • Improve service stability by analysing incident and problem trends, supporting root cause analysis, and ensuring corrective actions are implemented and closed
  • Deliver accurate, meaningful service level reporting and performance insights to improve transparency and support better decision-making

This role includes an on-call factor for Major Incident Response - working on-call one in every five weeks.

About you:

You might already be a Business Analyst, Project Coordinator, Account Manager or similar - the important thing is that you are someone who enjoys working with people to understand how services operate, why things break, where inefficiencies exist and how to create action plans to improve them.

You like to keep across multiple actions ensuring things don't fall through the cracks and coordinating those activities across a variety of streams. Reviewing and analysing trends and then telling a story based on that information comes naturally to you.

You'll balance strong problem solving and analytical skills with customer support and stakeholder engagement to ensure you can get the information you need but also have the influence to drive governance and ensure ideas become reality. You're able to understand and talk technical and be able to translate that for non-technical audiences.

You're curious, you love asking questions, you're a fast learner who is detail focused, organised and enjoys working with people to achieve great outcomes and help our teams continually improve. Basically, you get satisfaction from making complex things runs smoothly.

If you have any questions about the role, or experience any issues submitting your application, please email careers@foodstuffs-si.co.nz

description:
Tier 2+ Help Desk Technician

**REMOTE WORK IS NOT OFFERRED**MUST BE LOCAL**


Job Title: Tier 2+ Help Desk Technician

Employment Type: Full-time employee

Location: Denver Tech Center (DTC) — Dry Creek Rd & I-25, Centennial/Greenwood Village, CO | On-site

Compensation: $80,000 – $90,000 per year, depending on experience and certifications

Experience: 3+ years in a help desk or technical support role preferred


About Perfect Cloud Solutions

Perfect Cloud Solutions is a Denver-based managed service provider delivering IT support, cloud infrastructure, and cybersecurity services to businesses across Colorado. Our clients count on us to keep their environments fast, stable, and secure — and our technicians are the reason they do. We are a small, collaborative team where your work is visible, your judgment matters, and there is a clear path to deeper technical and security work.

Position Overview

We are seeking a skilled and proactive Tier 2+ Help Desk Technician to join our IT services team. This role is ideal for someone with strong troubleshooting instincts, a solid grasp of networking fundamentals, and hands-on experience managing cybersecurity alerts.

As a Tier 2+ Technician, you are the escalation point for our Tier 1 support staff. You will own the complex tickets — the ones that require real diagnosis rather than a script — and drive them to resolution quickly and cleanly, while helping strengthen the security and stability of our clients’ IT infrastructure. You will also mentor Tier 1 technicians and help build the documentation that makes the whole team faster.

This is a hands-on team, not a tiered silo. While your primary focus is escalated work, you will also pick up Tier 1 tickets from time to time to support the team during high-volume periods, coverage gaps, and busy queues. We are looking for someone who pitches in wherever the work is rather than waiting for it to reach their tier.

Key Responsibilities

Technical Support & Troubleshooting

• Provide advanced support for hardware, software, and network issues escalated from Tier 1.

• Diagnose and resolve issues across Windows, macOS, and mobile platforms.

• Support end-user applications including Microsoft 365, VPNs, remote access tools, and client-specific line-of-business applications.

• Own escalated tickets end to end — communicate status clearly, meet SLA targets, and confirm resolution with the client.

• Document solutions and contribute to the internal knowledge base so recurring issues get resolved faster at Tier 1.

• Serve as a technical mentor and escalation resource for Tier 1 technicians.

Networking Support

• Troubleshoot LAN/WAN connectivity issues across client sites.

• Perform core network configuration tasks including IP addressing, DHCP, DNS, and VLAN assignment.

• Run diagnostics, apply firmware updates, and manage configuration changes on switches, routers, and firewalls.

• Support site-to-site and client VPN connectivity and wireless infrastructure.

Cybersecurity Alert Management

• Monitor, triage, and respond to alerts from security tooling including SIEM, antivirus, and endpoint detection and response (EDR) platforms.

• Investigate potential threats, determine severity, and escalate confirmed incidents according to defined procedures.

• Lead phishing investigations and support end-user security awareness and education efforts.

• Assist with vulnerability remediation and security hardening across client environments.

• Maintain current awareness of evolving threats, attack techniques, and security best practices.

System Administration

• Manage user accounts, groups, and permissions in Active Directory, Entra ID, and Microsoft 365.

• Execute patch management and software deployment across managed endpoints.

• Support backup, restore, and disaster recovery operations, including periodic restore testing.

• Assist with onboarding and offboarding workflows for client users.


Qualifications

Required

• 3+ years of experience in a help desk, IT support, or technical support role (Tier 2 or equivalent escalation experience preferred).

• Strong working knowledge of Windows operating systems, Microsoft 365 administration, and core networking concepts.

• Familiarity with cybersecurity tooling and alert handling workflows.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical issues to non-technical users.

• Strong documentation habits and attention to detail in ticket handling.

• Reliable transportation and willingness to travel to client sites in the Denver metro area as needed.

Preferred

• CompTIA Network+, Security+, or equivalent certifications.

• Prior experience at a managed service provider (MSP) supporting multiple client environments.

• Hands-on experience with SIEM platforms and endpoint protection/EDR tools.

• Exposure to Kaseya products such as Autotask PSA and Datto RMM/BCDR.

• VoIP administration and troubleshooting experience.

• Familiarity with scripting for automation (PowerShell preferred).


What We Offer

• Salary of $80,000 – $90,000 per year, based on experience and certifications.

• Comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, and vision coverage.

• Paid time off and paid holidays.

• 401(k) retirement plan.

• Paid professional development, training, and certification reimbursement.

• A collaborative, security-conscious team where technicians are trusted to own their work.

• Convenient Denver Tech Center location at Dry Creek Rd and I-25, with easy highway and light rail access.

title: Casting Operator
description:
HOT, HEAVY & REWARDING — BUILD YOUR CAREER WITH TOYOTA INDUSTRIES GROUP!

Looking for a hands-on job where you can see the results of your work? Toyota Industries Group is hiring Casting Operators in Pendergrass, GA!

Our Casting teams help create key components used in the automotive compressors we manufacture every day. If you enjoy physical, fast-paced work and don’t mind turning up the heat, this could be the opportunity for you.

What does Casting look like?

In Die Cast, molten aluminum is used to produce three main components of our compressors: the front housing, rear housing, and cylinder. Associates work with equipment throughout the casting process as aluminum is formed and cooled into finished components.

In Sand Cast, sand molds are used to create components for our swash and lug plates. Associates help sort parts, operate equipment to smooth components, and inspect finished parts before they move on to Machining.

If you enjoy staying active, working with your hands, and being part of a fast-paced team, this could be the opportunity for you.

No manufacturing experience? No problem—we’ll train you! We’re looking for motivated individuals with a willingness to learn and a positive attitude.

title: Fueling Facilities Technician (Starship)
description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

FUELING FACILITIES TECHNICIAN (STARSHIP)

The Fueling Facilities Technician is a highly skilled and respected professional responsible for the maintenance, troubleshooting, and operational efficiency of fueling systems supporting Starship fleet operations. This role supports the Starship fleet maintenance team across a variety of fleet assets, including vehicles, heavy equipment, ground support equipment, generators, and related fuel storage and transfer systems. This role requires advanced technical expertise, leadership, and coordination across multiple teams to ensure mission-critical operations are executed flawlessly. The technician is a proactive leader who drives safety, mentors team members, and implements innovative solutions to enhance team performance and system reliability. SpaceX doesn’t shut down production for maintenance, and instead, we find ways to predict failures and perform the maintenance without interrupting production. This role will require direct work with the engineers and technicians who design and build unique machines and perform risk analysis together to map out the maintenance strategy and find the best condition monitoring systems to monitor the performance.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Troubleshoot, diagnose, and repair fueling systems, pumps, dispensers, filtration, and transfer equipment across a variety of fleet assets, ensuring team proficiency in these areas
  • Implementing process improvements and physical upgrades to improve reliability of fueling operations
  • Execute fueling, defueling, and emergency procedures for fleet vehicles, ground support equipment, and related systems
  • Create basic and complex work orders from scratch for fueling assemblies and support equipment
  • Provide preventative and corrective maintenance on fuel storage, transfer, filtration, and dispensing systems
  • Develop complex rework work order dispositions, including custom hardware installs without design references and functional/leak checks post-rework
  • Drive fuel trucks, forklifts, and other company equipment
  • Design and create specialized tooling to complete projects or tasks
  • Trains and mentors the operations team to ensure fleet operators are capable of self-diagnosing, troubleshooting, and performing common fueling and repair tasks

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • High school diploma or equivalency certificate
  • 2+ years of experience with fueling operations, fuel system service, or fleet maintenance

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Able to adapt to constantly changing work assignments and fast-paced work environment
  • Excellent concentration and attention to detail with outstanding work efficiency and accuracy
  • Work in compliance with the applicable SpaceX and industry standards and regulations
  • Understanding of hazardous materials handling, fuel quality control, and spill prevention best practices
  • Read and interpret engineering work instructions/drawings and verify that fueling, transfer, and loading/unloading processes are carried out successfully and in accordance with the fueling plan
  • Proven track record in high-pressure, mission-critical environments
  • 5+ years of experience as a maintenance technician or field service engineer

title: Staff Product Development Engineer
description:
ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD.

At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world’s most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future.

Whether you’re designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward. Join us and, together, we’ll advance your career.




THE ROLE:

AMD is seeking a highly motivated Member of Technical Staff (MTS), Post-Silicon Electrical Validation Engineer to join our Server Compute and Enterprise AI organization. In this role, you will be responsible for validating and characterizing high-speed I/O technologies on next-generation datacenter and AI platforms. You will work closely with cross-functional engineering teams to develop validation methodologies, execute comprehensive test plans, investigate complex system issues, and enable manufacturing test solutions that ensure product quality and reliability at scale.

The position offers broad exposure across silicon, platform, firmware, software, and manufacturing ecosystems, providing opportunities to influence products from early bring-up through production deployment.

THE PERSON:

The ideal candidate is passionate about complex technical challenges, enjoys hands-on lab debugging, and has strong fundamentals in high-speed electrical interfaces and system validation. You thrive in a fast-paced environment, can independently drive technical investigations, and possess the ability to translate ambiguous failures into structured debug plans and actionable solutions.

You are a collaborative engineer who combines technical depth, disciplined execution, and continuous learning while contributing to the success of global engineering teams.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Post-Silicon Validation & Characterization
    • Develop and execute validation strategies for high-speed interfaces and system interconnect technologies.
    • Define test plans, validation coverage, and characterization methodologies to ensure product functionality, performance, and reliability.
    • Perform electrical characterization, margin analysis, stress testing, interoperability validation, and feature verification.
    • Evaluate system behavior across various operating conditions and workloads to identify performance and robustness gaps.
    • Support silicon bring-up, platform enablement, and new technology introduction activities.

  • System Debug & Root Cause Analysis
    • Lead investigations of complex system-level issues spanning hardware, firmware, software, and platform interactions.
    • Utilize structured debug methodologies to identify root causes and drive resolution of product issues.
    • Collaborate with design, architecture, firmware, platform, and quality teams to implement corrective actions and long-term improvements.
    • Support product readiness assessments by identifying technical risks and driving mitigation plans.

  • Manufacturing Test & Product Quality Enablement
    • Partner with product engineering, manufacturing, and quality teams to develop scalable production screening and validation methodologies.
    • Translate engineering validation techniques into manufacturable test solutions that balance product quality, test coverage, and throughput requirements.
    • Support qualification, correlation, and deployment of production test content across multiple manufacturing environments.
    • Investigate manufacturing and product-quality issues, driving corrective actions and continuous improvement initiatives.

  • Automation & Methodology Development
    • Develop test automation, data analysis frameworks, and regression solutions to improve validation efficiency and coverage.
    • Drive improvements in validation methodologies, debug workflows, and characterization techniques.
    • Leverage data analytics to identify trends, improve decision-making, and accelerate issue resolution.
    • Contribute to scalable validation infrastructure supporting future product generations.

  • Cross-Functional Technical Leadership
    • Work closely with silicon design, architecture, signal integrity, platform, firmware, software, and manufacturing teams throughout the product lifecycle.
    • Communicate technical findings, validation status, and risk assessments to engineering stakeholders.
    • Provide technical mentorship and guidance to junior engineers.
    • Contribute to engineering best practices, technical documentation, and continuous learning initiatives.

PREFERRED EXPERIENCE:

  • Experience in post-silicon validation, electrical characterization, hardware development, or system-level debug.
  • Knowledge of high-speed interfaces and protocols such as PCIe, Ethernet, DDR, LPDDR, or related technologies.
  • Knowledge of manufacturing test strategies, product qualification processes, or quality methodologies.
  • Familiarity with scripting or programming languages such as Python, C/C++, Perl, or similar.
  • Strong analytical, debugging, and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills in a global engineering environment.
  • Experience with server, datacenter, or AI product validation.
  • Knowledge of JEDEC memory standards, PCIe compliance testing, signal integrity, and PHY characterization.
  • Experience with Linux and Windows Server environments.
    Familiarity with validation automation frameworks and large-scale regression systems.
  • Experience working with Jira, Confluence, SharePoint, or similar engineering collaboration tools.

ACADEMIC CREDENTIALS:

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related technical discipline.

  • Salaris volgens cao VVT, FWG 50: € 3.324 - € 3.502 (o.b.v. 36 uur).

Bij Careyn krijg je meer dan de arbeidsvoorwaarden uit de cao VVT. Meer weten? Bekijk onze arbeidsvoorwaarden.

  • Je hebt een passie voor de ouderenzorg en wil de kans aangrijpen opgeleid te worden.

Our values aren’t empty words – they inform our attitudes, actions and culture. At SCA Health, your work directly impacts patients, physicians and communities. At SCA Health, we offer a comprehensive benefits package to support your health, well-being, and financial future. Our offerings include medical, dental, and vision coverage, 401k plan with company match, paid time off, life and disability insurance, and more. Please visit, https://careers.sca.health/why-sca, to learn more about our benefits.

Your ideas should inspire change. If you join our team, they will.


Responsibilities

** The work schedule will be Monday - Friday with hours anywhere between 8am - 5pm EST / 7am - 4pm CST **

Insurance Verification:

  • Verify that sufficient information is available for accurate verification and eligibility. This step may require direct contact with the physician office and/or the patient.
  • Determine if a secondary insurance should be added to the patient account ensuring the appropriate payer is selected for Primary insurance.
  • Utilize the centers selected vendor for claims and eligibility and/or individual payer websites to obtain eligibility, benefits and/or pre-certs and authorization information.
  • Enter the patient insurance information into patient accounting system ensuring the selection is the appropriate payer and associated financial class.
  • When the patient’s insurance is Out of Network notify the manager immediately. Follow the Policies and Procedures when accepting Out of Network payers.
  • SCA’s goal for each patient’s insurance verification is complete and accurate. The insurance verifier will document the findings in the patient account and will contact the patient with either estimated co-insurance, co-pay and or deductible amounts due on or before the date of service as applicable
  • The Insurance Verifier will call each patient as part of center compliance with CMS Conditions for Coverage guidelines in contacting patient’s prior to the date of service to review, Physician Ownership, Advance Directives and Patient Rights.

Authorization:

  • Obtain authorizations from insurance companies/physician offices. Ensure complete and accurate information is entered into the patient accounting system and the procedure scheduled, date of service and facility name are on the authorization. Ensure the authorization has not expired.
  • Enter authorization into patient accounting system. Include the name/CPT codes effective date of the authorized procedures.
  • Ensure high cost implant/supply or equipment rental is included on authorization.
  • Check insurance company approved procedure lists/medical policies. If procedure is not payable, notify patient. If patient wants to proceed, obtain signature on Medicare ABN or other non-covered notification form.

Financial Orientation:

  • Calculate co-pay, and estimated co-insurance due from patients per the individual payer contract per the individual payer contract and plan as applicable.
  • Acceptance of in-network benefits for out-of-network payers must be pre-approved by SCA Compliance Dept.
  • Be familiar with individual payer guidelines and the process of collecting over the counter payments/deductibles/copay/co-insurance. Knowledge of payer contracts including Medicare, Medicaid and other government contracts and guidelines and workmen’s compensation fee schedule.
  • Contact the patient and communicate the center financial policy

Qualifications

  • Minimum of a High School Diploma or GED is required
  • Strong customer service experience is required
  • Previous Insurance Verification experience is required
  • Previous experience calculating out of pocket expenses is required
  • Healthcare experience is a must
USD $22.00/Hr. USD $24.00/Hr.

title: Director, Total Rewards
description:
Director, Total Rewards

Position Description

Nurix is seeking a Director, Total Rewards to lead the strategy, design, and execution of our compensation and benefits programs. This is a high-visibility, high-impact role reporting directly to the Chief Human Resources Officer, with the opportunity to shape and scale total rewards infrastructure. The ideal candidate combines deep technical expertise in compensation and benefits with strong business acumen and sound judgment.

The Opportunity

Compensation Strategy & Programs

  • Own the design, implementation, and administration of Nurix’s base pay, incentive compensation, equity, and executive compensation programs
  • Partner with the CHRO to lead annual compensation cycles, including merit increases, bonus funding and payout, and equity refresh grants
  • Conduct and manage market benchmarking and job leveling to ensure competitive, equitable pay practices across the organization
  • Monitor pay equity across the organization and lead proactive pay equity analyses and remediation
  • Stay current on evolving compensation regulations (e.g., pay transparency, pay equity laws) and ensure company practices remain compliant across jurisdictions

Benefits Strategy & Programs

  • Design and manage a competitive, cost-effective benefits portfolio, including health and welfare plans, retirement programs (401(k)), leave policies, and wellness offerings
  • Own vendor and broker relationships, lead renewal negotiations, and evaluate new offerings to ensure programs remain market-competitive and fiscally responsible
  • Ensure benefits programs are compliant with ERISA, ACA, ADA, FMLA, COBRA, and other applicable federal and state regulations
  • Lead open enrollment planning and execution, including employee communication and education strategies

Leadership & Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Serve as the subject-matter expert (SME) and trusted advisor to the CHRO, Head of Talent, HRBPs, and people managers on compensation and benefits matters
  • Partner closely with Finance on compensation budgeting, forecasting, and equity/stock plan expense modeling
  • Partner with Legal on equity plan administration, 409A matters, and regulatory compliance
  • Develop and deliver clear, effective communications and training to help managers and employees understand total rewards programs
  • In partnership with Head of HR Operations, evaluate and implement HRIS/compensation tools and systems to improve efficiency, data integrity, and reporting capabilities

What You’ll Bring

  • Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree or relevant certification (CCP, CBP, CEBS) preferred
  • 8-10+ years of progressive experience in compensation and benefits, including at least 3-5 years in a total rewards leadership role
  • Prior experience in biotech, pharmaceutical, or life sciences companies strongly preferred; experience in a clinical-stage or newly commercial company is a plus
  • Deep knowledge of equity compensation structures (RSUs, ISOs/NSOs, ESPP) common in biotech
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate complex data into clear insights and recommendations
  • Excellent judgment and discretion when handling highly sensitive compensation and personnel data
  • Proven ability to build programs and processes in a growing, fast-paced environment

title: Mid-Level Frontend Developer
description:
Mid-Level Frontend Developer (Vue 3 / Next.js)

Southport, Gold Coast QLD • Full-time • Technology

Join a growing national brand and help build the digital products that power the future of our business.

East Coast Car Rentals is one of Australia's established car rental brands, with 14 locations across the country. Behind the scenes, we're investing heavily in technology and building modern platforms in-house on AWS. It's an exciting time to join our software engineering team as we continue to develop products that support our customers, operations and future growth.

We're looking for a Frontend Developer who enjoys building clean, scalable user experiences and takes pride in writing high-quality code. Working closely with the Head of Software Engineering and collaborating with backend developers, you'll play a key role in designing, developing and improving the applications our customers and staff use every day.

If you're technically curious, enjoy solving problems, and want your work to have visible impact in a growing business, we'd love to hear from you.

What you'll do

• Build and maintain modern web applications using Vue 3, Next.js, React and TypeScript.

• Develop reusable components and frontend frameworks that improve consistency and speed across our products.

• Integrate APIs and collaborate closely with backend developers to deliver reliable, scalable features.

• Participate in code reviews and contribute to frontend development standards and best practices.

• Work on responsive user interfaces that perform well across desktop and mobile devices.

• Help plan and deliver new technology initiatives and customer-facing digital experiences.

• Contribute to application performance, usability, accessibility and maintainability.

• Identify opportunities to improve development workflows, tooling and automation.

What you'll bring

• 2 + Years commercial experience in a Frontend Developer role within a collaborative software development environment.

• Strong experience with Vue 3 (Composition API).

• Experience with Next.js and React.

• Solid JavaScript and TypeScript skills.

• Experience integrating REST APIs and working with backend services.

• Strong understanding of responsive design, component architecture and modern CSS practices.

• Experience using Git, pull requests and code review processes.

• A problem-solving mindset and commitment to building maintainable, high-quality software.

• Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively within a small, agile team.

Nice to have

• React Native development experience.

• Exposure to testing frameworks such as Vitest, Cypress or Playwright.

• Experience with Tailwind CSS.

• Familiarity with AWS services such as S3 and CloudFront.

• Experience working with Jira and Bitbucket.

• Interest in modern AI-powered development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor or Claude.

• Understanding of SEO and emerging AI search optimisation practices.

What success looks like

• Features are delivered on time and meet sprint commitments.

• Components are built once and reused across applications rather than duplicated.

• API integration challenges are identified early and resolved collaboratively.

• New releases are stable, reliable and minimise regressions.

• Documentation remains current and enables effective team collaboration.

• Code reviews improve quality while supporting knowledge sharing across the team.

Why East Coast Car Rentals

• Work on meaningful products used by customers and employees across Australia.

• A modern technology stack with the opportunity to influence how our platforms evolve.

• A collaborative engineering environment where your ideas are valued.

• A small, capable team where your contributions are visible and impactful.

• Opportunities to learn, grow and expand your technical skills.

• Based at our Corporate Southport head office on the Gold Coast.

How to apply

If this sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you. Please submit your Resume and a short Cover Letter telling us about a frontend project you're particularly proud of, what challenges it presented, and how you approached them.

East Coast Car Rentals is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds and are committed to creating a diverse, inclusive and supportive workplace.

title: Project Coordinator
description:
PLS is delivering on its vision to be a leading global producer of lithium, a mineral critical to enabling the world’s transition to a more sustainably powered future.

As the owner and operator of the Pilgangoora Operation, the world’s largest independent hard-rock lithium mine, we are expanding fast, investing boldly, and building a global portfolio that positions us at the forefront of the energy transition.

Most recently, we acquired Latin Resources, adding the Colina Project in Brazil to our portfolio — strengthening our international footprint and creating new pathways for growth.

With more than 900 people employed globally, we’re building a future-focused business where talented people can create real impact. At PLS, our Values aren’t just words on a wall, they drive how we work, how we lead, and how we grow: Safety First. Great People. We Deliver. One Team. Shaping Tomorrow.

If you want to be part of an organisation that is ambitious, innovative and shaping the next era of battery minerals, this is a once in a lifetime opportunity to join us.

What PLS offers

  • Annual short-term incentive bonus recognising individual and business performance
  • PLS employee share scheme
  • 18 weeks parental leave for primary carers and 4 weeks for secondary carers
  • Flexible working arrangements, including work from home options
  • Health and wellbeing allowance
  • Novated leasing through salary sacrifice
  • Paid community leave
  • Access to our Employee Assistance Program and Company Chaplains
  • Monthly employee recognition awards
  • Access to PLS’ KidsCo School Holiday Program

The opportunity

Reporting to the Manager Engineering and Procurement the will be responsible for coordinating of all procured equipment packages, associated documentation, reporting, and administration for the P2000 Expansion Project which is a proposed brownfield expansion by PLS Group at its 100% owned Pilgangoora Operation in Western Australia, aiming to boost spodumene concentrate production capacity to approximately 2.0 million tonnes per annum.

This role includes liaising with internal delivery team disciplines and external suppliers to ensure procured documentation, equipment, and materials are tracked, recorded, transported, and delivered in accordance with contracted delivery schedules. The position will also support the department with general administrative duties as required, including maintaining registers, coordinating information flow, preparing reports, and assisting with project documentation and records management.

This is a permanent full-time role based at our West Perth office, conveniently located near the City West train station.

Key responsibilities

  • Proactively expedite equipment and materials according to agreed procurement plans and associated expediting level.
  • Conduct Supplier visits and coordinate equipment inspections according to contract milestones and inspection test plans.
  • Keep Area Manager, Delivery Lead, Package Engineers, Cost Controllers, Construction Manager, and other project personnel informed of equipment and material delivery status and potential risk to delivery, developing and implementing plans and contingencies to meet project schedules.
  • Maintain the Project Expediting Status Report
  • Provide administrative support to the procurement and project delivery team, including maintaining registers, trackers, correspondence records, meeting notes, action lists, and filing systems.
  • Expedite Vendor documents ensuring timely submission and internal review.
  • Assist with the preparation, formatting, collation, and distribution of expediting updates, procurement reports, transmittals, and other project documentation as required.
  • Recommend improvements in expediting, inspection, and materials management activities.
  • Attendance at project related meetings, as directed, to represent the expediting function.
  • Maintain strong supplier and Project team relationships.
  • Work cohesively within a procurement delivery team to ensure project schedule requirements are met.
  • Complete general departmental administration tasks as required, including data entry, document control support, meeting coordination, action tracking, and follow-up of outstanding information.
  • Contribute to the improvement of Project expediting workflow practices to improve, quality, cost, efficiency and / or conveying of information to areas of the business as applicable, to enhance the delivery of Projects to schedule.

About you

  • 2-5-years’ experience in Major projects within the resources industry in any capacity
  • A sound working knowledge of procurement and business processes, out-of-the-box thinking and initiative, ability to work unsupervised
  • Strong, assertive communication skills and ability to work with Engineers, Commercial Representatives and Vendors.
  • Personality is key as you are required to work with External and Internal stakeholders on a regular basis via email, phone and in person.
  • Strong administration, document control, reporting, record keeping, and coordination skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and follow up outstanding actions.
  • Positive can-do attitude.
  • Proficiency in MS Office to develop automated and user-friendly reports

Supporting an inclusive and diverse workforce

PLS is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to creating a workplace that values, respects and supports diversity and inclusion. We believe diverse perspectives strengthen our business and help us deliver better outcomes for our people, our communities and the future we’re building. We foster an environment where everyone feels safe, included and able to contribute their best. Our recruitment processes are designed to be fair, equitable and accessible for all.

We encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, including Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples, people with disability, people from culturally and linguistically diverse backgrounds, all ages, and people of all genders and sexual orientations (LGBTQIA+).

We are committed to providing reasonable adjustments throughout the recruitment process and in the workplace to support all applicants and employees. If you require any adjustments, please let us know via the application process or inform our Careers team if you are contacted for an interview.


Our recruitment process

As part of our recruitment process, a number of checks will be conducted, including police / criminal background checks, medical assessments, drug and alcohol testing, due diligence, right to work checks and reference checks.

We respectfully request agencies not to submit unsolicited resumes.

Acknowledgement of Country

PLS respectfully acknowledges the Nyamal and Kariyarra People of the Pilbara, the Whadjuk Noongar People of the Perth region and all the Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples who are the Traditional Owners and First Nations peoples of these lands.

We pay our respects to Elders past and present and acknowledge their continuing connection and care for the land, water and Country.

If you would like to learn more about PLS or register for future opportunities, please visit www.pls.com.

title: Assembler
description:
Samenvatting van de functie
Wil jij werken in een innovatieve omgeving waar precisie en kwaliteit centraal staan?
Als Assembly Operator ben je verantwoordelijk voor het assembleren, configureren en controleren van elektronische componenten en producten. Je zorgt ervoor dat iedere stap in het productieproces voldoet aan de geldende kwaliteits- en veiligheidsnormen. In deze rol werk je met geavanceerde technologie en draag je bij aan de productie van betrouwbare sensoren en transmitters die wereldwijd door onze klanten worden gebruikt.

In deze rol ben je verantwoordelijk voor:

  • Assembleren, installeren en aansluiten van elektronische componenten, sensoren en gerelateerde producten.
  • Verwerken van transacties en registreren van kwaliteitsgegevens in Oracle en/of MES-systemen.
  • Uitvoeren van visuele inspecties om de kwaliteit van producten te waarborgen.
  • Signaleren en registreren van afwijkingen via het e-NC proces.
  • Ondersteunen van andere productieactiviteiten volgens de geldende functiematrix.
  • Reinigen en visueel controleren van producten voorafgaand aan verzending.
  • Actief bijdragen aan een veilige, efficiënte en kwalitatief hoogwaardige werkomgeving.
  • Naleven van kwaliteits-, veiligheids- en operationele procedures.

Wie jij bent
Je bent klantgericht en handelt met integriteit in alles wat je doet. Je neemt verantwoordelijkheid voor je werkzaamheden en levert consistent kwalitatief hoogwaardig werk. Je bent nauwkeurig, betrouwbaar en werkt zelfstandig, terwijl je ook effectief samenwerkt met collega's om gezamenlijke doelen te bereiken. Daarnaast toon je initiatief door kansen voor verbetering te signaleren en bij te dragen aan oplossingen die processen en prestaties versterken.

Voor deze functie heb je nodig:

  • Een VMBO-diploma of vergelijkbaar werk- en denkniveau.
  • Bereidheid om te werken in een productieomgeving.
  • Vermogen om zelfstandig en gestructureerd te werken.
  • Oog voor detail en een sterke focus op kwaliteit.
  • Goede beheersing van het Nederlands en/of Engels.
  • Mogelijkheid om een Verklaring Omtrent Gedrag (VOG) en minstens 2 relevante referenties aan te leveren indien vereist.

Wat jou onderscheidt:

  • Ervaring met assemblagewerkzaamheden of productieprocessen.
  • Kennis van kwaliteitscontroles en inspectieprocedures.
  • Ervaring met ERP- of Manufacturing Execution Systems (zoals Oracle of MES).
  • Ervaring met elektronica, sensoren of technische producten.
  • Affiniteit met continu verbeteren en het werken binnen een kwaliteitsgerichte omgeving.

Ook wanneer je niet aan alle voorkeuren voldoet, moedigen we je aan om te solliciteren. Wij waarderen verschillende achtergronden, ervaringen en perspectieven en geloven dat potentieel net zo belangrijk is als ervaring.


Onze cultuur en onze belofte aan jou:
Bij Emerson geloven we dat een diverse en inclusieve werkomgeving leidt tot betere resultaten en meer innovatie. We zetten ons in om een cultuur te creëren waarin iedereen zich welkom, gewaardeerd en gerespecteerd voelt. Je krijgt de kans om te werken met geavanceerde technologieën, jezelf verder te ontwikkelen en een bijdrage te leveren aan oplossingen die een positieve impact hebben op onze klanten en de wereld om ons heen.
Wij begrijpen het belang van een goede balans tussen werk en privé en zetten ons in om de persoonlijke en professionele ontwikkeling van onze medewerkers te ondersteunen. Van aantrekkelijke arbeidsvoorwaarden tot gelijke kansen voor groei en ontwikkeling: wij streven ernaar een werkomgeving te creëren die zowel ondersteunend als waardevol is.
Als onderdeel van ons arbeidsvoorwaardenpakket bieden wij onder andere:

  • PME-pensioenregeling
  • Reiskostenvergoeding
  • 27 vakantiedagen plus ADV
  • Winstdelingsregeling
  • Opleidings- en ontwikkelmogelijkheden

Wij bieden een werkomgeving waarin veiligheid, samenwerking, ontwikkeling en welzijn centraal staan. We moedigen medewerkers aan om hun talenten te benutten, nieuwe vaardigheden te ontwikkelen en mee te groeien met onze organisatie.

Heb je interesse? Solliciteer dan vandaag nog en ontdek hoe jij kunt bijdragen aan het succes van Emerson in Ede!

deally, you will bring:

title: Opleidingsplaats mbo Verpleegkunde
description:
Droom jij van een betekenisvolle carrièreswitch en wil je werken én leren combineren? Bij Careyn krijg je de kans om je mbo-diploma Verpleegkunde te behalen terwijl je direct praktijkervaring opdoet. Als grootste ouderenzorgorganisatie van Nederland bieden we zorg die ertoe doet. Intramuraal én extramuraal en daarbij investeren we in jouw groei. Voor onze locaties in Utrecht Stad zijn wij op zoek naar enthousiaste en leergierige mbo Verpleegkundigen die middels zij-instroom willen instromen.

Dit ga je doen als Leerling mbo verpleegkundige

Als Leerling mbo verpleegkundige combineer je opleiding en praktijk. De opleiding duurt gemiddeld 2,5 tot 3 jaar en start in ieder jaar in februari en september.

Concreet betekent dat:

  • Volgen van één dag per week theoretisch onderwijs.

  • Werken in de praktijk bij Careyn, op een van onze zorglocaties.

  • Je begeleidt de zorg rondom de bewoners en gaat steeds meer aan de slag met organiseren en coördineren.

  • Je signaleert gezondheidsproblemen en bent aanspreekpunt voor bewoners en hun naasten.

  • Je verleent zorg op basis van de zorgvraag en het zorgdossier van de bewoner.

  • Je bevordert de zelfredzaamheid van de bewoners zoveel als mogelijk door het verlenen van voorlichting, advies en instructies.

Wat werken in dit team aantrekkelijk maakt

Werken in Utrecht betekent leren en werken binnen een breed palet aan intramurale locaties en wijkteams. Je krijgt te maken met een diverse doelgroep: van zelfstandig wonende ouderen tot cliënten met complexe zorgvragen, waardoor geen dag hetzelfde is. In een professionele en warme werkomgeving werk je samen met betrokken collega’s die hun kennis en ervaring graag met je delen. Er is volop ruimte om te leren in de praktijk en stap voor stap te groeien in je rol. Zo ontwikkel je jezelf tot mbo Verpleegkundige terwijl je direct bijdraagt aan passende zorg voor cliënten.

Wat je van ons mag verwachten

  • Salaris volgens cao VVT, FWG 45: € 2.981 - € 3.324 (o.b.v. 36 uur).

  • Een leerarbeidsovereenkomst voor 24 tot 32 uur per week, met uitzicht op een vaste aanstelling na het afronden van je opleiding.

  • Reiskostenvergoeding, 8% vakantietoeslag en 8,33% eindejaarsuitkering.

  • Volledige vergoeding van lesgeld, studiemateriaal en reiskosten.

  • Mogelijkheid om gebruik te maken van het meerkeuzesysteem, zoals extra verlof of een fietsregeling.

  • Toegang tot o.a. HeyCoach, budgetcoach en DigiCoach voor jouw ontwikkeling.

  • Bij Careyn krijg je meer dan de arbeidsvoorwaarden uit de cao VVT. Meer weten? Bekijk onze arbeidsvoorwaarden.

Om de veiligheid van onze cliënten en medewerkers te waarborgen, is voor alle medewerkers die bij Careyn in dienst komen een Verklaring Omtrent Gedrag (VOG) vereist. Bij gelijke geschiktheid krijgen interne sollicitanten voorrang ten opzichte van externe kandidaten.

title: Product Manager
description:
About the role

As Product Manager, you'll own the roadmap and day-to-day delivery for one or more of Senatra's carer-facing product areas. You'll work closely with engineering, design and content to turn real carer problems into clear, buildable requirements — and make sure the team always has what it needs to ship. This is a hands-on role in a small team: you'll be close to users, close to delivery, and close to the decisions.

Key responsibilities

  • Own product priorities and roadmap for your area, in partnership with engineering and design.

  • Run regular user research — interviews, usability testing, feedback synthesis — and turn findings into decisions.

  • Write clear PRDs, user stories and acceptance criteria that engineering and design can build from without back-and-forth.

  • Make sure content, design and engineering always have the context and source material they need before work starts.

  • Define content and safety requirements for AI-driven journeys — approved sources, uncertainty language, escalation pathways, ownership for ongoing review.

  • Track and report on product metrics, and use them to guide what gets built next.

  • Keep documentation and backlog current in our tools and easy for the team to navigate.

  • Make commercially informed prioritisation calls — including saying no to smaller requests when a bigger, more repeatable opportunity is on the table.

About you

  • 4+ years experience owning a consumer product area from discovery through to shipped, iterated features.

  • Comfortable running user research yourself — in the room with real users, not just reading someone else's synthesis.

  • Strong written communicator — you can turn ambiguity into a document someone else can act on.

  • A team player who leads through clarity and initiative, not just title — we're small, so everyone leads something.

  • Genuinely cares about carers and older Australians, and wants to build something that actually helps them.

  • Comfortable with the pace and ambiguity of an early-stage team.

About us

Senatra is a young, growing Australian technology company building AI-powered tools — including a consumer app and voice-AI experience — that help family carers support an older parent and navigate the aged-care system with more confidence. We're a small team that cares deeply about the people we're building for, and about building something genuinely good for the world.

title: Backend Engineer, Control Plane
description:
Thank you for considering Tailscale. If this job description resonates with you, please apply. Frequently cited statistics show that people who identify with historically marginalized groups are likely to apply to jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. We encourage you to help us break that statistic!

About Tailscale

Tailscale is making safe connection effortless by delivering software that makes it easy to securely interconnect people and their devices, no matter where they are. From hobbyists to multinational corporations, teams of every size use Tailscale each day to protect their networks, share access to internal tools, and more. We're building a future for the Internet that's easy, sensible, and safe, like it used to be. Founded in 2019 and fully distributed, we're backed by Accel, CRV, Insight, Heavybit, and Uncork Capital.

Job Description

We’re seeking a skilled and diligent full-time Software Engineer to join our growing Control Plane Team. You will work as part of the engineering team to:

  • Develop the Tailscale product, contributing to both open source client code and related backend services;
  • Take ownership of the entire product lifecycle, from writing code to product ideation and strategic decision-making;
  • Work closely with UX/UI designers and product managers to shape features.

Because we’re an early-stage and fully remote company, we’re looking for a strongly motivated individual who can help move the product forward at crucial intersections of the technology and organization: in this case, the control plane and the various services it comprises and supports. The ability to think on your feet, collaborate with highly technical teams, and comfort working asynchronously are essential.

Key Responsibilities

What We Are Looking For

  • Familiarity with networking (IP addressing, routing, etc.)

As a company, we strive to maintain fair and equitable compensation practices within our team across all roles and all levels.
