title: Master Data Analyst
description:
Why Renovo?
Renovo Solutions is a nationwide healthcare and life sciences technology management company. We offer a range of opportunities for employees to grow within the company. With a presence in 40+ states and a growing international footprint, we provide comprehensive solutions for managing and maintaining the equipment our clients depend on. We prioritize investing in our employees’ development, offering various phases and advancement paths. Through ongoing training, mentorship programs, and a supportive work environment, we foster professional growth and promote from within. Join our team to make a difference while advancing your career with Renovo.

Summary:
The Master Data Analyst owns the accuracy of asset, entitlement, and service data across Renovo life sciences accounts. Records arrive from separate client systems with inconsistent nomenclature and gaps. This seat does the work that turns that into a data set the business can bill, report, and defend in an audit.

The job is the data, not the tool. Platforms change. The standard, the mapping rules, and the discipline behind them carry across whatever system holds the records.

The role reports to the Manager, Master Data and Systems and works with Site Operations Managers, coordinators, Technical Supervisors, Sourcing and Payments, and Quality and Compliance. Platform integration and development sit with IT and the product team. This role owns the data inside the platform.

What you will do:
Data quality and maintenance:

Maintain asset, site, and hierarchy records to the documented data standard.

Identify and resolve duplicates, blank required fields, orphaned records, and stale data.

Improve nomenclature match rate against the serviceable asset baseline through systematic remapping.

Run recurring data quality checks and report exceptions with an owner and a due date.

Treat a wrong record as a defect: fix the source, not just the report.

Data loads and migration:

Execute asset and entitlement data loads and validate them against source and contract.

Reconcile records where the same asset appears differently across source systems, and apply the documented resolution rule.

Prepare and test data before a site is declared ready, against defined acceptance criteria.

Document every transformation applied to a data set so it can be reproduced.

Support data cleanup ahead of platform changes and validate the result on the other side.

Entitlement and coverage data:

Maintain entitlement and coverage records by service type in partnership with Sourcing and Payments.

Flag coverage records that do not match contract and track them to correction.

Support needs assessment and coverage change work with accurate asset data.

Reporting support and documentation:

Produce data extracts and pulls supporting KPI reporting, audits, and client requests.

Maintain documented data standards, definitions, and mapping rules.

Support user questions on data structure and record standards.

Escalate platform limitations and integration needs rather than building workarounds outside the system.

Follow GXP requirements, applicable quality systems, and OSHA and site safety procedures when working at a client site.

Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in a technical, scientific, data, or business field preferred; equivalent experience considered.

3+ years of master data, CMMS administration, data analysis, or data quality experience.

Advanced Excel required, including large data set handling, lookups, and pivot analysis.

Experience with a CMMS or field service platform and its data structures required.

Demonstrated experience on a data migration or large data cleanup effort.

Working knowledge of asset or equipment data, service records, and nomenclature standards.

Experience in a GXP or other regulated environment where data supports audit preferred.

Working knowledge of a reporting or business intelligence tool preferred.

Proficient with Microsoft and Google software applications.

Existing right to work in the United States required.

Education/Special Training:

Bachelor’s degree preferred; relevant experience considered in place of a degree.

Training in data management, data analysis, or reporting tools preferred.

Where this role is based at a client site, escort of OEM and third-party engineers applies as it does to every site-based role, and escort qualification is required.

Required Competencies:

Accountability - takes ownership of assigned work and responsibilities, follows through, and closes the loop.

Data Integrity - treats a wrong record as a defect and fixes the source.

Attention to Detail - catches the exception in a large data set.

Process Discipline - documents transformations so work can be reproduced and audited.

Persistence - finishes a cleanup rather than leaving the difficult remainder.

Customer Service - treats internal data and reporting requests as real work with real deadlines.

Priority Setting - sequences competing data requests and cleanup work by impact.

Communication - explains data findings and record standards clearly to non-technical users.

Integrity - can admit mistakes, is direct and truthful, and acts in the best interest of customers, employees, and Renovo.

Success Measures:

Nomenclature match rate improvement against the serviceable baseline

Duplicate and blank required field reduction

Data load accuracy and acceptance against defined criteria

Entitlement record accuracy against contract

Turnaround time on data extract and pull requests

Currency of data standard and mapping documentation

Audit outcomes on data completeness and record accuracy

Safety Requirements:

Abide by and follow Renovo safety policies, procedures, and injury and illness prevention expectations.

Maintain a safe working environment for self and others when visiting customer sites, laboratories, offices, or operational environments.

Follow applicable customer site safety requirements, OSHA guidelines, and laboratory or facility-specific procedures as required.

Complete required safety training assignments on time.

Physical Requirements:

The role requires the ability to speak, hear, see, read, write, type, travel, sit, stand, walk, reach, bend, and participate in customer site and laboratory visits as needed.

Must be able to use standard office equipment and technology tools, including computer, phone, video conferencing, dashboards, and reporting systems.

Travel approximately 5-15% for site data validation, deployment support, and training.

FLSA: Exempt

title: Python Developer
description:
Python Developer

Location : London

Experience: 2-5 years

**UK based candidates only** - CITIZEN & DEPENDENTS

We are seeking an innovative and results-driven Data Scientist with a strong focus on Machine Learning and deep proficiency in Python. You will be instrumental in transforming complex data into actionable insights, building predictive models, and driving business strategy using cutting‑edge analytical techniques. This role is for a hands‑on individual who is excited to move models from the lab into production.

Key Responsibilities

  • Model Development & Implementation: Design, develop, train, validate, and deploy advanced Machine Learning models (e.g., classification, regression, clustering, deep learning) to solve complex business problems.
  • Data Wrangling & Analysis: Perform comprehensive Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA), data cleaning, feature engineering, and transformation on large, complex, and sometimes unstructured datasets.
  • Coding & Automation: Write production-quality, highly efficient, and scalable code primarily in Python for data processing, analysis, and model creation.
  • Experimentation & Optimization: Conduct A/B testing, hypothesis testing, and rigorous model validation, continually iterating and tuning algorithms to maximize performance, accuracy, and efficiency.
  • Collaboration & Communication: Work closely with cross-functional teams (e.g., product managers, engineers, business stakeholders) to define project scope, interpret model results, and clearly present data-driven recommendations to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Deployment & MLOps: Collaborate with ML/Data Engineers to deploy, monitor, and maintain ML models in a production environment, ensuring stability and performance over time.

title: Data Engineer Market Analysis
description:
Waar kom je terecht?


Je komt te werken bij de business unit ‘Design’ in het Market Analysis Team, waar we de energietransitie vorm geven. We ontwerpen het klimaatneutrale energiesysteem van de toekomst, analyseren wat daar voor nodig is en plannen de daarvoor benodigde infrastructuur. Binnen deze business unit onderzoekt en analyseert het Market Analysis team met 18 personen de verwachte veranderingen in vraag en aanbod van elektriciteit op de kortere (2026-2035) en langere (2035-2050) termijn en de gevolgen daarvan voor de taken van TenneT op het gebied van elektriciteitstransport, netbeheer en marktfacilitering.

De activiteiten van het team bestaan uit de ontwikkeling en kwantificering van scenario’s voor het energiesysteem, modellering van marktgedrag en economische haalbaarheid, stochastische berekening van onzekerheden en beoordeling van voorzieningszekerheid. Belangrijke producten die het team levert / aan bijdraagt zijn: voorzieningszekerheidsstudies op nationaal en Europees niveau (Monitor Voorzieningszekerheid, ERAA); marktsimulaties en systeemoptimalisaties voor infrastructuurplanning (investeringsplan, TYNDP, Target Grid); en modellering en kwantificering voor diverse ad-hoc verkenningen en impactanalyses.

Met dit alles leveren we onmisbare informatie voor strategische beslissingen van TenneT en belangrijke stakeholders zoals de Nederlandse overheid.

Dit team is o.a. verantwoordelijk voor het maken van scenario’s voor het energiesysteem van de toekomst en het uitvoeren van analyses en marktsimulaties over hoe dat systeem zou kunnen functioneren. Daarmee wordt de basis gelegd om allerlei infrastructuurgerelateerde vragen te kunnen beantwoorden (zoals waar kunnen het beste kerncentrales komen, en wat betekent dit voor het elektriciteitsnet).

In deze rol zorg je ervoor dat grote en diverse datasets betrouwbaar, efficiënt en reproduceerbaar beschikbaar komen voor analyses, modelruns en besluitvorming over het energiesysteem van de toekomst. Je ondersteunt analisten, modelleurs en inhoudelijke experts door data te verzamelen, te structureren, te transformeren, te valideren en te ontsluiten. Denk hierbij aan marktdata, klimaatdata, scenario-aannames, netwerkinformatie en resultaten uit simulatiemodellen. Je verbindt verschillende interne en externe modellen met elkaar, en zorgt dat scenario- en simulatiedata soepel en betrouwbaar tussen modellen stroomt zonder handmatige interventies.

Je bent vanuit het team ook de verbindende schakel met relevante DevOps teams bij TenneT’s Digital & Technology Transformation afdeling. Zo zorg je ervoor dat wat jij opzet, aansluit bij bredere TenneT IT-standaarden en ontwikkelprincipes, en dat jouw prototypes succesvol door hen naar productie kunnen worden gebracht.

Met dit alles speel je een sleutelrol in het versnellen en opschalen van onze analyses en daarmee het creëren van goed onderbouwde inzichten waar TenneT en de Nederlandse overheid belangrijke keuzes voor het toekomstig energiesysteem op kunnen baseren.

Als Data Engineer Market Analysis ben je onder andere verantwoordelijk voor:

  • Ontwerpen, bouwen en onderhouden van prototype ETL/ELT-pipelines voor marktsimulaties en energiesysteemanalyses.
  • Verwerken, opschonen, combineren en valideren van grote datasets uit interne en externe bronnen;
  • Automatiseren van dataverwerking, kwaliteitscontroles, logging en monitoring rondom modelinput en modeloutput;
  • Opzetten en beheren van gestructureerde datasets, datamodellen en documentatie zodat analyses reproduceerbaar en traceerbaar zijn;
  • Samenwerken met marktanalyse-experts, modelleurs en data scientists om prototype dataoplossingen te maken en requirements op te stellen voor doorontwikkeling door de relevante DevOps teams;
  • Ondersteunen bij het voorbereiden, uitvoeren en analyseren van marktsimulaties met tools zoals PLEXOS, PyPSA, het ETM of vergelijkbare modellen;
  • Bijdragen aan standaardisatie, versiebeheer, testing, CI/CD en best practices binnen de data- en modelleerketen;
  • Signaleren van verbeterkansen in bestaande processen, tooling en datakwaliteit.

title: Engineer II (Mechanical Design)
company: SEAGATE SINGAPORE INTERNATIONAL HEADQUARTERS PTE. LTD.
description:
About our group:

The Sputter Equipment Development Engineering (SpEDE) team at Seagate designs and develops next generation sputter process equipment that supports global HDD media manufacturing. We operate at the intersection of mechanical design, vacuum technology, thermal engineering, automation, and process integration, transforming early stage concepts into fully validated systems deployed across Seagate factories worldwide.

As part of a global engineering organization, SpEDE partners closely with R&D, manufacturing, and process engineering teams to deliver equipment solutions that drive performance, reliability, and manufacturing efficiency at scale.

In this role, you will be embedded in a highly collaborative engineering environment that values strong fundamentals, hands on problem solving, and continuous learning. You will gain exposure across the full engineering lifecycle—from prototype builds and testing to troubleshooting and design validation—playing a key role in transitioning concepts into manufacturing ready equipment.

About the role - you will:

  • Develop, test, and document mechanical designs for transport mechanisms, vacuum systems, and process stations, including deposition chambers and substrate heating, cooling, and cleaning systems.
  • Take ownership of technical assignments involving applied research and the design, fabrication, modification, and evaluation of mechanical and electromechanical devices, components, and systems.
  • Develop initial concepts for assigned devices, components, or systems and contribute to detailed product design.
  • Participate in design reviews and provide mechanical engineering input on design for manufacturability (DFM), design for assembly (DFA), reliability, and serviceability.
  • Create, review, and release accurate 3D solid models, engineering drawings, and related design documentation.
  • Work closely with local vendors and internal stakeholders to support fabrication, resolve technical issues, and facilitate the timely delivery of parts and assemblies.
  • Support prototype builds, testing, troubleshooting, verification, validation, and the transition of designs into production.

About you:

  • Collaborates effectively in the selection of materials, interfaces, and surface finishes that are appropriate for precision engineering and clean manufacturing environments.
  • Produces clear engineering specifications, drawings, and documentation that accurately communicate design intent to internal stakeholders, cross-functional teams, and external suppliers.
  • Demonstrates the ability to understand technical requirements, identify design constraints, and translate them into practical, manufacturable engineering solutions.
  • Applies a structured and methodical approach to problem-solving, leveraging prototypes, test data, analysis, and experimentation to support evidence-based design decisions.
  • Exhibits curiosity, creativity, and a growth mindset, with a strong commitment to continuous learning, process improvement, and solving complex engineering challenges.
  • Possesses a genuine passion for engineering, a willingness to learn, and enthusiasm for contributing to the development of meaningful products that deliver value to customers and improve outcomes.

Your experience includes:

  • Bachelor’s Degree plus 3 – 5 years’ experience in Mechanical Engineering.
  • Proficiency in SolidWorks or comparable 3D CAD software, with experience creating solid models and production-ready engineering drawings.
  • Familiarity with the complete engineering design process, including feasibility studies, conceptual design, detailed design, design reviews, verification, validation, and production realization.
  • Knowledge of engineering change control processes, including Engineering Change Orders (ECOs), Engineering Change Notices (ECNs), and the release of manufacturing-quality documentation.
  • Experience designing dynamic electromechanical systems or precision mechanical equipment.
  • Experience applying DFM and DFA principles and working with vendors or fabrication partners.
  • Experience in high-vacuum system design and heat-transfer applications is an advantage.

title: AI/ML Data Scientist
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an AI/ML Data Scientist based in India.

This is an opportunity to develop advanced machine learning solutions that support enterprise decision-making and customer-facing products.
You will work with large-scale structured and unstructured datasets to uncover patterns, build predictive features, and develop analytical models.
The role spans machine learning, deep learning, statistical analysis, time-series forecasting, and predictive modeling.
You will also contribute to automated data and ML pipelines, applying MLOps practices to support reliable and scalable production models.
Close collaboration with software engineering teams will be essential to integrate models directly into real-world applications.
You will translate complex statistical findings and model performance into clear insights, visualizations, and actionable business recommendations.
This role is well suited to a data scientist who combines strong technical depth with analytical thinking and a practical, business-oriented mindset.

Accountabilities:

  • Design, train, evaluate, and optimize machine learning and deep learning models across use cases including classification, regression, clustering, predictive analytics, and time-series forecasting.
  • Extract, clean, transform, and engineer high-value predictive features from large-scale structured and unstructured datasets to improve model performance and business outcomes.
  • Build robust end-to-end data ingestion and model training pipelines, incorporating MLOps best practices and automated retraining processes to support scalable machine learning operations.
  • Conduct rigorous model validation and optimization through hyperparameter tuning, cross-validation, bias-variance analysis, and other evaluation techniques to ensure production models remain accurate and stable.
  • Analyze complex datasets and statistical outputs to identify meaningful patterns, trends, and opportunities that can inform strategic and operational decision-making.
  • Translate technical findings, predictive metrics, and statistical insights into clear dashboards, reports, and actionable recommendations for business stakeholders.
  • Collaborate with software engineering teams to integrate statistical and machine learning models into customer-facing software products and production environments.

    • Requirements:

    • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Data Science, or another quantitative discipline, combined with approximately 3–7 years of relevant professional experience.
    • Advanced Python programming skills with strong hands-on experience using data science and machine learning libraries such as Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-Learn, PyTorch, and/or TensorFlow.
    • Strong knowledge of statistical concepts and methodologies, including probability, statistical testing, hypothesis validation, predictive modeling, and time-series analysis.
    • Practical experience developing machine learning and deep learning models, including model evaluation, feature engineering, hyperparameter optimization, and validation techniques.
    • Experience building or contributing to automated data and machine learning pipelines, with an understanding of MLOps principles and production-oriented model development.
    • Working knowledge of SQL databases, Git version control, and cloud-based data platforms such as Snowflake, BigQuery, or AWS Redshift.
    • Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities, with the ability to work with complex datasets and communicate technical findings clearly to both technical and business stakeholders.

      • Benefits:

      • Annual compensation ranging from INR 2,400,000 to INR 3,800,000 CTC, depending on relevant experience and qualifications.
      • Full-time employment opportunity within a mid-senior-level AI and data science environment.
      • Remote work flexibility across India, with opportunities to work from Bangalore or Pune under a hybrid or remote-flexible arrangement.
      • Opportunity to work on predictive analytics, machine learning, deep learning, forecasting, and MLOps initiatives with direct impact on enterprise decision-making.
      • Exposure to large-scale datasets, modern data platforms, and customer-facing software products while collaborating closely with software engineering teams.

title: Level 1/2 Service Desk Engineer - Mining Operational Technology
description:
This is a great opportunity to join a global market leader in mining equipment and technology, supporting advanced Mining Operational Technology (OT) used by major mining operations around the world.

We are looking for an early-career to mid-career Level 1/2 Service Desk Engineer to join the team at its office located near Perth Airport. This is an office-based position requiring you to work in the office five days per week.

You'll become part of a high-performing global support organisation with support professionals located across the globe. The organisation provides 24/7 support using a follow-the-sun model, with support responsibilities transitioning between teams in different regions as the working day moves around the world.

Your primary focus will be supporting Driver Safety Systems (DSS), including the technologies used to monitor operator awareness, detect fatigue and distraction, and improve safety outcomes in live mining environments around the world.

As your knowledge develops, you'll also gain exposure to and learn other systems within the company's broader Mining Operational Technology suite. This provides an excellent opportunity to develop a broad understanding of the sophisticated technology being used to automate, optimise and manage modern mining operations.

You don't need to know everything on day one. What matters most is curiosity, collaboration, strong troubleshooting skills and a willingness to learn. You'll receive structured training, hands-on mentoring and support from experienced colleagues while you build your knowledge of these sophisticated Mining OT products.

This role is ideal if you're looking to build strong technical capability in a structured and supportive environment, gain exposure to world-leading mining technology and potentially progress into specialist technical roles over time.

What we're looking for

To be successful, you will have:
  • An industry certification or tertiary qualification in IT
  • Experience in a Service Desk or IT support environment, and/or on-site mining or Mining Dealer experience
  • Exposure to enterprise systems and structured support processes using ITIL practices, including incident management and root cause analysis
  • An analytical and methodical approach to troubleshooting
  • Excellent attention to detail
  • A genuine customer-focused mindset
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills
  • The ability and willingness to work from the office near Perth Airport five days per week
Highly regarded experience

It would be advantageous to have exposure to one or more of the following:
  • Microsoft Server environments, including virtualisation
  • SQL Server
  • TCP/IP networking
  • Mining or heavy-industry systems such as MineStar, Modular Dispatch, Leica Jigsaw, or similar
  • Technology interacting with hardware, electronics or operational environments
  • Large-scale, real-world operational systems
Training, hours & weekend support

Initially, you will work Monday to Friday, 8:00am–4:00pm, from the office near Perth Airport.

The role is office-based five days per week, providing comprehensive product training, hands-on mentoring and close support from experienced team members while you become familiar with the Mining OT products you'll be supporting.

Your initial focus will be developing strong technical knowledge of the Driver Safety Systems (DSS) application, before progressively learning other systems across the broader Mining OT suite.

The organisation operates a 24/7 follow-the-sun support model, with support teams located in different regions around the world providing continuous coverage.

Once you are fully trained and have developed sufficient product knowledge, the role will include approximately one weekend day per month as part of the team's global support coverage. Further details regarding the weekend support arrangements will be discussed during the interview process.

Weekend support is shared across the team, with specialist technical support available for escalation when required.

Strong onboarding, mentoring and continuous learning are embedded into the role, giving you the opportunity to progressively broaden your Mining OT knowledge and develop specialist technical expertise.

The opportunity

This is an initial 12-month contract with a very strong possibility of extensions or transition to a permanent role for strong performers.

This is not a hybrid or work-from-home position. You will be required to work onsite at the office near Perth Airport five days per week.

There is also the opportunity for optional ad-hoc travel to mine sites for those interested, although mine site travel is not mandatory.

Candidates must hold Australian or New Zealand citizenship or Australian Permanent Residency to be considered.

title: Senior/Staff Engineer STPG Product Engineering - Probe
company: MICRON SEMICONDUCTOR ASIA OPERATIONS PTE. LTD.
description:
Job Description Summary

The Probe Product Engineer in STPG Product Engineering owns probe strategy and silicon learning at wafer test, spanning pre‑silicon design‑to‑probe staging, first‑silicon bring‑up, qualification, and high‑volume manufacturing (HVM).

This role is accountable for defining probe coverage intent, establishing limits and guard‑bands grounded in silicon behavior, and driving yield, quality, and test‑cost outcomes. The focus is on interpreting design intent, device operation, and process interactions, and translating product risk into robust, manufacturable probe strategies aligned with downstream test and customer requirements.

The engineer works closely with Design, DFT, Design Validation (DV), Process Integration, Backend Test, and Reliability teams to ensure probe solutions are technically sound, scalable, and product‑centric across the lifecycle.

Key Responsibilities

Probe Coverage Strategy & Ownership

  • Define and own probe coverage intent by mapping design features, device behavior, and process risks into probe observability, screening mechanisms, trims, and guard‑bands.

  • Define, release, and sustain probe test flows from first silicon through qualification and HVM, ensuring coverage objectives are met without unnecessary test overhead.

  • Establish probe limits and guard‑bands based on silicon characterization, design intent, and customer specifications, with clear alignment to downstream test.

  • Lead probe enablement for new product introductions (NPI) and technology ramps, identifying coverage and manufacturability risks early and driving mitigation plans.

Pre‑Silicon Design‑to‑Probe Staging & DFT Readiness

  • Partner with Design, DFT, and DV teams during pre‑silicon phases to drive effective design‑to‑probe staging.

  • Review and influence DFT architecture, test hooks, observability, redundancy, and trim structures to enable efficient and manufacturable probe coverage.

  • Participate in pre‑silicon verification and simulation reviews to reduce first‑silicon debug risk.

  • Define probe coverage intent early and ensure continuity from design features through probe and downstream test (shift‑left learning).

First Silicon Bring‑Up & Device Characterization

  • Support first‑silicon bring‑up using engineering probe platforms and lab‑based characterization setups.

  • Perform silicon and device‑level characterization (parametric behavior, margins, trims, stress response) to inform probe limits and screening strategy.

  • Correlate early silicon behavior with probe results to validate coverage intent, identify gaps, and eliminate redundant content.

  • Provide early silicon learning to accelerate probe flow stabilization and yield ramp.

Yield, Quality & Reliability Enablement

  • Drive wafer‑level yield learning, bin definitions, and failure‑mode analysis at probe.

  • Enable intrinsic and extrinsic screening strategies in collaboration with Reliability teams.

  • Provide structured, data‑backed feedback to Fab, Process Integration, Design, and DV teams to close learning loops efficiently.

Test Efficiency & Cost Optimization

  • Drive test efficiency improvements through coverage right‑sizing and flow optimization, aligned to product and market needs.

  • Support wafer‑level speed (WLS) activities as part of broader probe optimization efforts.

  • Balance coverage, yield, quality, and cost trade‑offs using silicon data and product risk understanding.

Data, Analytics & AI Enablement

  • Leverage probe, inline, and reliability data for yield analysis, anomaly detection, and decision support.

  • Contribute to AI/ML initiatives such as predictive probe, smart sampling, and test optimization.

  • Apply data‑driven insights to continuously improve probe effectiveness and efficiency.

Artificial Intelligence

  • Using, applying, and leveraging AI, identify opportunities to streamline workflows, optimize processes, and support innovation by incorporating AI-driven solutions and enabling data-driven decision-making across projects and teams

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s, Master’s degree, or Phd in Electrical / Electronics Engineering, Computer Engineering (with strong hardware, circuits, or semiconductor focus), Semiconductor Physics, or related field.

  • Strong fundamentals in semiconductor devices, wafer test, and product engineering.

  • Demonstrated ability to use silicon behavior and characterization data to make informed probe, yield, and coverage decisions.

  • Experience or strong interest in silicon learning, device behavior, yield mechanisms, DFT intent, or design‑to‑manufacturing integration.

  • Strong analytical skills and ability to drive structured root‑cause analysis.

  • Effective communication skills and ability to work across global, cross‑functional teams.

Career Growth & Impact

  • Direct ownership of probe strategy and quality outcomes across the product lifecycle.

  • Exposure to advanced technology nodes, customer‑driven requirements, and large‑scale manufacturing systems.

  • Clear growth paths across senior technical contributor, product leadership, or people management tracks within STPG Product Engineering.

title: Senior Threat & Attack Researcher
description:
Optus is an Australian telecommunications company, delivering more than 11 million services to our customers every day across mobile, broadband, and digital solutions.

This is an exciting opportunity for a Senior Threat & Attack Researcher to become part of our dynamic team. As a senior member, you will play a pivotal role in identifying, researching, and tracking threats relevant to our organisation. You will operate in a setting that values excellence and integrity, where your contributions will have a meaningful impact.

Due to the requirements of this role, we are currently only able to consider applications from Australian Citizens.

What You’ll Do

  • Researching the TTPs, tooling, and infrastructure of threats relevant to Optus.

  • Finding opportunities to detect, disrupt and deny threat activity in a proactive manner.

  • Producing intelligence products for a range of stakeholders to enable threat-informed decisions.

  • Providing assessments on the broader threat landscape to maintain situational awareness amongst stakeholders and senior leadership through regular briefings.

  • Analysing malware samples and code to understand their functionality, behaviour, propagation methods, and evasion techniques.

  • Leading team research and capability uplift initiatives.

  • Instilling and encouraging a culture of excellence, integrity, and professionalism; one that works toward the highest standards in cyber security.

  • Identifying, researching, and tracking significant threats to our organisation.

  • Taking initiative to guide and implement countermeasures that find, obstruct, and block threats.

  • Providing threat intelligence support to incident response investigations.

  • Providing verbal briefings to both technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Collaborating with partners to share intelligence and tradecraft.

  • Assisting in the development of junior people through mentorship and guidance.

  • Crafting and maintaining relevant processes or tools to ensure efficient and scalable operations.

What You Bring

  • Tertiary qualifications or similar experience in computer science, information systems, engineering, or cyber security.

  • 5+ years of experience in Cyber Threat Intelligence or a related cyber security role.

  • Detailed knowledge of offensive operations, geopolitical drivers, and attack techniques.

  • Proficiency with scripting languages such as Python for automation and custom tooling creation.

  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills with the ability to work with stakeholders at all levels.

  • The ability to distill technical concepts into clear, risk-focused messaging for diverse audiences.

  • Proven capability to perform effectively under pressure, adhere to deadlines, and adjust to change.

The good stuff….

  • Competitive remuneration and colleague discounts. Make life easier (and more affordable) with $80 monthly credit and 25% off Optus products and outstanding shopping discounts with our retail partners.

  • Flexible working arrangements with opportunities to work three days in the office and two days remote or at home.

  • Competitive leave policies, including additional 'Connected’ days to focus on culture, family, health, community, or whatever’s important to you.

title: D365 Finance Functional Architect | Contract | Outside IR35
description:
D365 Finance Functional Architect – AR / Payments / Tax / Subscription Billing | Contract

We are looking for a highly experienced Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance Functional Architect to join a major enterprise finance transformation.

This is a specialist Finance role rather than a broad D365 F&O position. We need someone with genuine depth across Accounts Receivable, Cash & Bank Management, taxation, payments and Subscription Billing, capable of designing solutions for complex and sometimes non-standard accounting scenarios.

The programme is moving a large home installations finance operation onto an existing D365 F&O environment, covering billing, deposits, revenue recognition, consumer finance, payments, refunds, reconciliation and financial reporting.

Many of the target processes are still to be defined, making this a hands-on functional architecture and discovery role rather than simply implementing an established design.

The Role

You will own the detailed D365 Finance functional and accounting design, working alongside the Solution Architect, Finance stakeholders and technical teams.

Key responsibilities will include:
  • Design D365 Finance configuration across Accounts Receivable, General Ledger and Cash & Bank Management.
  • Define financial dimensions, chart-of-account additions, bank accounts and associated finance structures.
  • Design customer deposit/prepayment processes including VAT recognition at receipt, deferred income and subsequent application against invoices.
  • Define revenue recognition and posting approaches for installation-based billing.
  • Configure and design Subscription Billing / billing schedules for one-off rather than traditional recurring transactions.
  • Design tax configuration supporting multiple VAT treatments, mixed-rate invoices and date-effective tax changes.
  • Own functional design for invoice amendments, cancel-and-reissue processes, credit notes, refunds, compensation and customer credit balances.
  • Design bank reconciliation, settlement matching, suspense handling and finance exception reporting.
  • Define the accounting and allocation model for consumer-finance/lender settlements, including high-volume remittance files, lender debtor accounts and commission recognition.
  • Support payment allocation across card, lender finance, BACS, cheque and digital payment methods.
  • Define standard and custom financial reporting requirements and support Trial Balance integration into SAP S/4HANA.
  • Translate complex Finance requirements into robust D365 functional designs and clearly identify where standard functionality is insufficient.
Key Experience

This role requires significantly more depth than a generalist D365 Finance consultant. We are looking for:
  • Deep functional architecture experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance / D365 F&O Finance.
  • Expert knowledge of Accounts Receivable and customer accounting.
  • Strong Cash & Bank Management, settlement and reconciliation experience.
  • Strong understanding of UK VAT and D365 tax configuration, ideally including mixed-rate and date-effective tax scenarios.
  • Experience with customer deposits, prepayments, deferred income and revenue recognition.
  • Strong knowledge of Subscription Billing / billing schedules within D365 Finance.
  • Experience designing complex credit, rebilling, refund and invoice-correction processes.
  • Experience with high-volume payment/remittance allocation or complex debtor settlement processes.
  • Ability to understand and defend the accounting treatment behind the proposed system design rather than simply configure requirements provided by others.
Experience with Worldpay or comparable payment providers, consumer-finance/lender settlements, SAP S/4HANA integration, utilities or high-volume consumer billing would be particularly valuable.

This is a role for a genuinely senior D365 Finance specialist who can sit with Finance stakeholders, understand the accounting problem and determine how it should be represented within Dynamics — including recognising when standard F&O functionality will not be enough.

Our 2023-2027 strategy outlines the world we want to see and our role in advancing it. We aspire for all women, girls, and families to be safe, well, strong, and connected. We strive for equity, dignity and social justice for women, girls and families by collaborating globally and acting locally, supporting our communities in Australia and New Zealand to thrive.

We want women, girls and families to live full and dignified lives, have dignified income and enjoy financial wellbeing. We aim to provide place-based, people-centred, holistic services while working at the system level to achieve bold and audacious reform. We currently offer microfinance programs and products, financial counselling and coaching, family and domestic violence support services, family and youth programs, playgroups, education programs and community houses. These services are complemented by research and strong advocacy to address the underlying structural causes of injustice, exclusion, and inequality.

Good Shepherd Australia New Zealand (GSANZ) respects the dignity of all people, draws strength from, and celebrates the diversity of our community. At GSANZ, we strive for an inclusive culture where all identities feel safe and that they belong. We welcome and actively seek applications from Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander people, people of all sexual orientations and gender expressions and identities, people with disability, and culturally and racially marginalised people. Each person’s individual decision regarding disclosure will be fully respected.

title: Security & Compliance Engineer
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Security & Compliance Engineer based in India.

We are looking for an experienced security professional to strengthen information security operations, compliance, governance, and risk management initiatives.
The role combines hands-on incident response with broader responsibilities across security governance, information management, and regulatory compliance.
You will help maintain a strong security posture by responding to incidents, coordinating investigations, and improving security processes and controls.
You will also contribute to ISO 27001 and PDPL compliance, audits, risk assessments, and information governance activities.
The position provides an opportunity to work closely with SOC/MDR, IT, governance, compliance, and business teams in a collaborative environment.
You will have an important role in strengthening incident readiness, privileged access governance, and security documentation and reporting.
This is a full-time remote opportunity for a security professional with 5+ years of relevant experience.

Accountabilities:

  • Provide first-response and operational support for information security incidents, including containment, escalation, response, and recovery activities.
  • Develop, maintain, and continuously improve security incident response runbooks, procedures, and operational processes.
  • Coordinate with SOC, MDR, and managed security service teams to investigate, contain, and resolve security incidents.
  • Support incident investigations, documentation, root-cause analysis, post-incident reviews, and remediation tracking.
  • Monitor and track security incidents, actions, escalations, remediation activities, and resolution status.
  • Support ISO 27001 information security management and compliance activities, including security controls and documentation.
  • Contribute to PDPL compliance initiatives, assessments, security controls, and related documentation.
  • Support information classification, handling requirements, records management, and broader information governance processes.
  • Coordinate internal and external security audits and provide accurate evidence and supporting documentation.
  • Maintain security risk registers and track risk mitigation and remediation activities.
  • Prepare monthly security metrics, dashboards, management reports, and governance updates.
  • Support periodic security and governance reviews, including Y1.2 reviews and related assessment activities.
  • Administer and support BeyondTrust Privileged Access Management (PAM), including privileged access reviews and governance.
  • Review privileged access, access controls, approvals, and associated security requirements.
  • Coordinate security initiatives with governance, compliance, IT, security, and business stakeholders.
  • Support security control assessments, compliance reviews, and remediation tracking.
  • Maintain accurate security policies, procedures, records, audit evidence, and governance documentation.
  • Identify opportunities to strengthen security operations, incident readiness, information governance, and compliance processes.

    • Requirements:

    • 5+ years of professional experience in IT security, information security, cybersecurity, security governance, compliance, or a related field.
    • 3+ years of hands-on experience in incident response and security operations.
    • 2+ years of experience working with ISO 27001 and PDPL compliance or comparable information-security regulatory frameworks.
    • 2+ years of experience in information governance, including information classification and records management.
    • Strong understanding of security incident response, including containment, escalation, investigation, recovery, and post-incident activities.
    • Experience developing and maintaining incident response runbooks, procedures, and operational documentation.
    • Experience coordinating with SOC, MDR, or managed security service providers.
    • Hands-on experience administering BeyondTrust Privileged Access Management (PAM).
    • Strong understanding of privileged access management, access governance, and security controls.
    • Experience maintaining security risk registers, supporting risk assessments, and tracking remediation activities.
    • Experience preparing security metrics, management reports, audit evidence, compliance documentation, and governance reports.
    • Strong knowledge of ISO 27001, information security governance, risk management, and audit processes.
    • Practical knowledge of PDPL requirements and information governance principles.
    • Strong coordination and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to collaborate across security, governance, compliance, IT, and business functions.
    • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
    • Strong analytical, documentation, problem-solving, and organizational abilities.
    • Ability to work independently in a remote environment while managing multiple security and compliance priorities.

      • Benefits:

      • Salary range of INR 10–20 LPA (approximately ₹1,000,000–₹2,000,000 per year).
      • Full-time employment.
      • Fully remote position based in India.
      • Opportunity to work across information security operations, incident response, compliance, governance, and risk management.
      • Exposure to security frameworks and regulatory requirements including ISO 27001 and PDPL.
      • Opportunity to work with privileged access management and security operations technologies.
      • Cross-functional collaboration with security, IT, governance, compliance, and business teams.
      • Opportunity to contribute to security process improvements, incident readiness, and scalable governance practices.

title: Retail Team Lead
description:
Job Title: Retail Team Lead (RTL)

Department: Donated Goods Program(DGP)

Reports To: Store Manager

FLSA Status: Non-Exempt



Mission Support:

Goodwill Houston (GWH) is leading change, connecting people, and improving the potential for the future of work. We educate, train, and hire individuals with barriers to employment to help them thrive. We connect people, families, and communities to improve lives and meet today's and tomorrow's workforce needs. Powered, in part, by donations and retail customers, we change lives through the power of work.

Position Summary:

Under the leadership of the Store Manager and District Director, the RTL will assist with the day-to-day operations and management of the store and donation area. To ensure efficient and cost-effective operation through world-class customer service, processing donated goods, quality control, and maintaining a productive workforce.



Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

· Assume management responsibilities in the absence of the Manager or Assistant Manager, including opening/closing and all day-to-day store operations.

· Manage and influence the team by communicating clear company goals daily, weekly, and monthly.

· Accurately and efficiently complete all sales transactions and maintain proper cash accountabilities at POS registers/safe.

· Supervise and assist with the training and development of Team Members.

· Ensure the proper handling and processing of incoming donation flow in and out of the store according to GWH policies and procedures.

· Help ensure the timeliness of proper apparel and hard goods rotation according to GWH policies and procedures.

· Accurately operate store systems and ensure financial and statistical counts are completed (donor counts, production standards, etc.).

· Performs other duties as assigned by Management.

Additional Responsibilities

· Demonstrates a high degree of professionalism in communication, attitude, and teamwork with customers and team members.

· Ability to multi-task, make quick decisions, adapt to change, and work in a team-oriented, fast-paced environment.

· Adheres to all GWH Policies & Procedures, Loss Prevention & Safety Regulations, and GWH Guiding Principles.

· Must be punctual and have dependable attendance, and maintain an appropriate appearance.

· Must safely conduct work; maintain good housekeeping standards, have all aisles and pathways to fire exits clear and free from clutter, and keep work areas neat and clean.

· Adheres to local, state, and federal laws and regulations.



Minimum Qualifications:

· High school diploma or equivalent preferred.

· One (1) to two (2) years of retail sales experience is preferred.

· Management/Supervisor with one (1) or more years of experience is preferred.

· Basic computer skills.

· Good time management and organizational skills.

· Ability to communicate and interact well with a variety of personality types.

· Ability to work a flexible schedule to meet the needs of the business, including holiday, evening, overnight, and weekend shifts.

· Must have reliable transportation.



Key Performing Indicators (KPI):

1. Transaction Value (Assigned District vs. goal)

2. Donor Value (Assigned District vs. budget)

3. Donors Integrity and Growth (Assigned District vs. budget)

4. Budget Sales vs. Actual Sales (Assigned District vs. budget)

5. Payroll as a Percent of Revenue (Assigned District vs. goal)

6. Budgeted Profit vs. Actual Profit (Assigned District vs. goal)

7. Retention Rate (Measured by annual leadership retention vs. LY, 30-New Hire date vs. goal, and Annual Retention Rate vs. LY)

8. Customer Service (Feedback from team, secret shopper, and donor ratings for assigned district)

9. Change Roundup as a % of Transactions (>30% and higher than the previous year)

10. Active with Zero hours TMs vs Goal (Zero (0) – 28+ days) (Assigned District)

11. Administration - Performance management/Training (Assigned District at <5%)

12. Reporting-, Team Meeting Minutes, Safety, Over/Short (Assigned District)

13. Safety – 95% quarterly safety metric score

14. GWH LMS Training completion



Physical Requirements/Work Environment:

The ability to continuously stand/walk for the duration of the shift, frequently push/pull, occasionally bend/stoop/crawl/kneel/reach above shoulders, and climb a ladder. Able to lift, up to, 40 lbs. (fixture parts, cartons of product).



An indoor work environment with exposure to outside temperatures. The noise level in the normal work environment is usually moderate.
